articleTitle: A Monthly Urban Electricity Consumption Prediction Algorithm Based on Self-Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Urban electricity consumption prediction is an important basis for power grid enterprises to formulate power dispatch plans, plan future distribution network development, and promote power reform. However, the temporal characteristics of urban electricity consumption are highly nonlinear and seasonal. Previous urban electricity consumption prediction models do not fully analyze and utilize features. Deep Learning is a type of algorithm that can adaptively and self-organize learn non-linear features of data, and can effectively predict and analyze urban electricity consumption. This paper uses the Self-Attention model to analyze and extract the characteristics of urban electricity consumption data, which is a type of deep learning algorithm. By using the XGBoost algorithm, the prediction results of Self-Attention are integrated with other models to achieve better predictive analysis of urban electricity consumption. Afterwards, the electricity consumption model proposed in this paper is validated using urban electricity consumption data, demonstrating good predictive accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Optimization Research on Vegetable Sales in Supermarkets Based on Greedy Algorithm and ARIMA Time Series Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of digitalization, it is particularly important to provide superstores with accurate information on market demand and trends, and to help them develop reasonable replenishment plans and pricing strategies. This paper aims to improve the competitiveness and operational efficiency of superstores by establishing various mathematical models. For the vegetable merchandising problem, firstly, data cleaning, analysis and visualization are carried out to analyze the relationship between the sales of six categories of vegetables using Pearson's correlation coefficient and construct a multiple linear regression model to describe the sales volume; secondly, considering the cyclical relationship between the vegetable sales volume and the time, the sales volume and the wholesale price of the coming week are predicted by the ARIMA time-series model, and a mathematical planning model; finally, the greedy algorithm was applied to solve the model to derive the daily replenishment and pricing strategy for the coming week.

articleTitle: Early Screening Prediction System of Breast Cancer MRI Images Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the increasing incidence rate of breast cancer in China, how to effectively improve the accuracy and sensitivity of breast cancer diagnosis has become an important issue facing the Chinese medical industry. In recent years, the application of computer deep learning technology in medical images has become increasingly widespread. It can automatically extract features from images and classify and predict them. At present, deep learning has made significant breakthroughs in the field of medical image analysis. Deep learning algorithms can automatically discover disease features in massive image data, and their performance has also been significantly improved. The purpose of this study was to study and analyze breast cancer MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) images by using deep learning algorithm, hoping to provide help for early diagnosis of breast cancer. The results showed that the accuracy of the early screening prediction system for breast cancer MRI images based on deep learning reached 95.6%, which laid the foundation for the early diagnosis and treatment of breast cancer.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Animation Technology in Short Video Production
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduces a computer-based artificial intelligence short video generation system. A stepwise optimization conversion algorithm is presented. This algorithm can realize the fast calculation of large Angle offset and greatly improve the efficiency of short video generation. The complexity of the existing prediction unit is determined by its correlation with time, space and parent neighbor PUs, and the corresponding prediction model is quickly selected according to its complexity, so as to improve the compression efficiency. The system has the functions of content collection to release process, multi-format material synthesis, transcoding processing and so on. The software mainly realizes face recognition, speech recognition, speech synthesis, text recognition, sensitive information recognition, natural language processing and so on. It can better achieve content aggregation, classification and retrieval, thus improving the production effect. The results show that this method has strong functions of learning and intelligent processing. The system can quickly retrieve and organize the text, so as to improve the efficiency of writing, editing and publishing.

articleTitle: Optimizing Workforce Demand Forecasting in Enterprises: A Novel Approach with SF-SOA-based Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) stands out in machine learning as a powerful tool for approximating complex nonlinear mappings. However, challenges arise from the inherent randomness in weight initialization, impacting consistency and optimality. This work introduces a novel optimization approach, the Spiral Flight Seagull Optimization Algorithm-based ELM (SF-SOA-based ELM), leveraging the Seagull Optimization Algorithm (SOA) for global and local search capabilities. SF-SOA optimizes weights and thresholds, addressing traditional SOA limitations with three key strategies: chaotic sequences, optimization of spiral flight paths and local search based on convergence conditions. Applied to practical workforce demand forecasting in enterprises, SF-SOA demonstrates significant improvements in convergence accuracy, speed, and error reduction. The refined SF-SOAbased ELM showcases enhanced performance, highlighting its potential to overcome challenges in random weight initialization within traditional networks.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Agricultural Decision System Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Firstly, the application status and problems of machine learning in modern intelligent agricultural production were introduced. A smart agricultural monitoring system design based on Internet of Things technology and machine learning algorithm was proposed. A sensor node for collecting agricultural environment information is designed, and a wireless sensor network composed of ZigBee nodes is used to sense and detect agricultural environment information. The application software system developed by Qt software technology can manage and display the agricultural environment information. Secondly, a smart agricultural decision system based on machine learning is constructed by using decision tree algorithm to analyze the problem. The communication method based on blackboard model is adopted to avoid the complicated communication design of session layer. In the decision-making process of knowledge, ontology is combined with the current mature rule-based reasoning technology. It is proved that this system can make timely and accurate decision according to the change of agricultural environment, and carry out dynamic adaptive learning according to historical data.

articleTitle: Research on Supermarket Vegetable Sales Optimization Based on Grey Prediction Model and Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the comprehensive research of vegetable sales data in a supermarket, using statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and optimization algorithms to explore the distribution of vegetable sales, pricing strategies, and replenishment planning. Firstly, by analyzing the category sales data of different years, it is found that holidays have a significant impact on vegetable sales, and the grey correlation between each category is strong. Secondly, based on the cost-plus pricing theory, the ARIMA model is used to predict future sales, and the replenishment quantity and sales pricing of each category are determined by single-objective programming. Finally, considering the actual constraints, the grey prediction model and improved differential evolution algorithm are used to optimize the purchase quantity and pricing strategy of single item. The study of this paper provides scientific decision support for supermarket vegetable sales and helps to improve sales efficiency and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Prediction Optimization Model Based on Convolutional Neural Network of Time-Domain Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Urban traffic flow prediction is an important part of building a green, low-carbon, safe and efficient intelligent transportation system. Spatiotemporal graph neural networks are widely used in urban traffic flow prediction due to their strong spatiotemporal data representation capabilities. However, most of the current models have a series of problems such as insufficient spatial information mining of traffic flow data, and based on this, a traffic flow prediction model based on convolutional neural network of time-domain graph is proposed. With the help of dilated causal convolution, the perceptual field is expanded, and the time information is extracted by combining with the residual network. Finally, the specific dataset is used for evaluation, and the results show that the model has better performance than the graph convolutional network model and the multi-spatiotemporal graph convolutional network model.

articleTitle: Design of Piano Timbre Recognition System Based on Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A set of piano tone recognition and electronic synthesis system suitable for modern Musical Instruments was established to better apply computer technology to the music industry. Firstly, the sound quality characteristic model of music works based on digital identification is proposed, and the overall structure and function of the system are analyzed. The sound quality identification and electronic synthesis system of piano are studied by using Boriet analysis. First of all, it must solve the problem of sound quality identification. Secondly, it uses digital identification technology to extract the multiplication points of piano sound from the characteristic matrix of piano sound color. In this way, the envelope which can reflect the evolution law of sound intensity with time is extracted, so as to improve the recognition effect of piano sound quality. Through the experimental and theoretical research, it is proved that the method can achieve high accuracy and SNR in the range of 600~2100 Hz. The correct recognition rate of sound shows that the system has good perfection.

articleTitle: The Environment Construction and Test Research of Diesel Engine ECU Hardware in the Loop Test System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test principle of diesel engine electronic control unit (ECU), the HIL test system environment of diesel engine ECU is built from the hardware platform and software platform of the test system. The related signals of the test system were tested, and the emission results of the system were analyzed by the universal characteristic test. The results show that the built HIL test system environment can correctly simulate the sensor signals required for ECU operation, and accurately measure the control signals sent by ECU, and the diesel engine emission test based on this environment has high accuracy. The effectiveness of the HIL test system environment and the feasibility of the HIL test method are verified.

articleTitle: Study on Fault Section Localisation in DG-Containing Distribution Network Based on Hybrid BAS-PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The large-scale access to the power grid by distributed power sources makes the complexity of the distribution network increase, and the direction of the line trend is complex, which causes the accuracy of the fault location algorithm to be greatly reduced. Aiming at this problem, based on the increasingly improved distribution network automation system, this paper proposes a fault location method for Beetle Antennae Search based on an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm. In order to improve the convergence speed of the algorithm, this paper firstly introduces the adaptive inertia weights and initialises the population by using Tent chaotic mapping to avoid falling into the local optimal solution; furthermore, the switching function and the fitness function are established in order to locate the faults of the distribution network containing the DG; finally, the algorithm optimization is verified by using the MATLAB simulation program with the IEEE-33 node as the model of the faults of the distribution network. The results show that: the algorithm has higher search speed and accuracy in locating faulty segments in DG-containing distribution networks, and has good fault tolerance in case of signal distortion. Therefore, the hybrid BAS-PSO algorithm can locate faulty segments in distribution networks in a more scientific and reasonable way, which provides an effective implementation path to improve the ability to capture fault information and rapidly locate faulty segments.

Author Keywords: Particle Swarm Optimization based on Beetle Antennae Search

articleTitle: Research on the Optimization of Supermarket Staff Scheduling Based on Intelligent Algorithm Combined with Binary Coding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper delves into the core problem of supermarket staff scheduling optimization, especially in terms of reducing human resource costs and increasing corporate profits. Genetic algorithm is adopted as the solution method, and the raw data are exhaustively preprocessed and converted into formats at the initial stage. During the application of the genetic algorithm, the Binary 0–1 gene coding method and targeted fitness function were designed. The staff scheduling was successfully optimized through genetic crossover, mutation, and elimination mechanisms. On this basis, employee qualification and efficiency are introduced as new optimization indexes, and the model and fitness function are adjusted accordingly to further enhance the effectiveness of the scheduling scheme.

articleTitle: Research on New Economic Marketing Model System Based on Computer Intelligent Recommendation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the knowledge based on decision tree and user context is combined to give a financial product portfolio recommendation method based on matrix decomposition. This project aims to improve the recommendation accuracy of personal finance products. Then, the matrix decomposition method of scenario preference is introduced to obtain a preliminary list of financial product suggestions. The initial recommendation list is filtered twice according to the preferences of users in specific situations obtained by the classification model to get the final recommendation result. For each person's different choices in a specific situation, the initial recommendation list is filtered in a second round to obtain the final recommendation result. Compared with the conventional collaborative filtering algorithm, matrix decomposition algorithm and Baseline algorithm, the situational cognition improves the recommendation accuracy. This algorithm improves the performance of the recommendation system.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Commercial Load Data Using Bidirectional LSTM and Autoencoders
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This study proposes an anomaly detection algorithm, employing Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and autoencoders, to address data quality issues in commercial load data. The process involves constructing an LSTM autoencoder model for input reconstruction to derive fitted values. Anomalous instances are detected by calculating the average absolute error between these fitted and actual values. Applied to real load datasets from shopping centers and commercial buildings, this method demonstrates superior anomaly detection performance compared to conventional benchmark methods.

articleTitle: Automatic Pricing and Replenishment Decision for Vegetable Products Based on ARIMA Model and Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the improvement of human requirements for quality of life, economic development and urbanization, the automatic pricing and replenishment decisions of vegetable categories and single products in supermarkets have more reasonable planning. To optimize the profitability of supermarkets, help them expand their market share, and determine their market position, this paper aims to explore the correlation between vegetable categories and single products, and to set a more reasonable replenishment and pricing strategy for supermarkets. Firstly, according to the distribution law and interrelationship of the sales volume of various categories and single products of vegetables, the sales volume of each category and single product was quantitatively analyzed, and because there was no normal distribution relationship in the data, the Spearman correlation mathematical model was established to obtain the monotonic relationship between vegetable categories. Then, the relationship between the total sales volume of each vegetable category and the cost-plus pricing was analyzed, and the dimensionality reduction of the data was carried out by using the calculation data to determine whether it conformed to the multivariate linear relationship, and the discount situation was added as a special for observation and fitting, and the total sales volume and the cost-plus pricing were inversely proportional. Finally, by optimizing the total number of single products sold, the minimum display quantity, and the single product replenishment number of saleable varieties, the existing conditions are fixed and compressed, and the greedy algorithm is modified to obtain a new supermarket revenue and single product replenishment planning model, and the optimal replenishment strategy and pricing method are obtained by solving the model.

Author Keywords: Supermarket Revenue and Single Product Replenishment Planning Model

articleTitle: Design of Atmospheric Environment Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The existing air pollution monitoring system cannot accurately and real-time monitor the air pollution status in each region. Therefore, this paper puts forward a method based on SCADA, which combines configuration software, computer and database to realize real-time monitoring system of air environment. This system uses the portable air pollutant concentration detector as the upper computer to monitor the pollutant concentration in real time. The central monitoring platform is established through the configuration software to receive, process and analyze the collected data. Sensing nodes are set up at each monitoring position. The data is collected in real time through 4G mobile communication system and then transmitted to the monitoring center. In this way, the functions of information collection, real-time monitoring and historical query are completed. The monitoring device can realize the real-time storage and display of temperature and humidity, CO, N0<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, PM2.5 and other concentration data.

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence (AI) Recognition Automated Soft-Shell Crab Breeding System under “Internet +” Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This project aims to use artificial intelligence technology to raise crabs in land equipment, so as to easily obtain soft-shell crabs, to increase the supply of new aquatic products in the market, to meet the needs of market consumption upgrading, and finally to achieve the goal of economic benefits. This project is based on artificial intelligence to identify automatic soft-shell crab cultivation technology, combined with scientific breeding management methods, the general crab to soft-shell crab cultivation. The equipment uses the Internet of Things, big data, cloud computing, computer vision and other technologies to design five systems, including soft shell crab mounting identification system, water quality monitoring system, three-dimensional breeding system, automatic feeding system, integrated control system, to realize the local and remote all-round intelligent monitoring of soft-shell crab breeding base. In this paper, STC15F2K60S2 as the core of the design of MCU based hardware platform is presented. RS485 communication mode is used to collect data of each sensor in real time, and multiple environmental parameters can be monitored in real time. Using video surveillance technology, the pond can be secured, and the pond can be photographed on the surface and underwater. The feeding device is controlled by PLC and the feeding machine and aerator are controlled intelligential. The network uses ESP8266 wireless network to realize network connection to AP. Through the establishment of the “server” management software, we enable users to remote query through the computer browser, mobile APP and other ways in the case of network.

articleTitle: Graph Neural Networks: Application in Air Pollution Imputation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The issue of complete air pollution data has been receiving increasing attention in recent years. Imputing missing air pollution data is a crucial challenge in modern life. Existing methods typically rarely consider spatial correlation data attained by air pollution monitoring stations and use less additional information in each station such as meteorological data and geographic location data. In this paper, we propose a more advanced model for imputing missing data that leverages graph neural networks (GNNs). We formulate Matrix Completion on Graph structure by using Delaunay triangulations to construct clustering graph structure based on the geographic location data of different air pollution monitoring station, where the each edge between different nodes represents the similarity between two station. In terms of the neural network, we take the Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) to complete this task, which takes advantage of the connectivity information between nodes in a graph to update their feature representations. Furthermore, we compare it with conventional imputation models, such as convolutional neural network (CNN) and random forest. The lower Mean Squared Error (MSE) in our model, specifically 0.22 for SO2 and 0.0074 for CO, demonstrates the robustness of our method in imputing missing pollution data.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of career planning system based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To better cater to the needs of job seekers and provide enhanced career development directions, this study proposes a novel employment guidance and career planning system integrating machine learning algorithms, along with the creation of a career matchmaking framework. Firstly, leveraging the RippleNet algorithm model, we construct a knowledge graph-based career planning recommendation system. The system-building process involves investigating key technologies in data processing and recommendation algorithms. Subsequently, through the implementation of database security design, we ensure the information security of users within the system, thereby maintaining the efficient operation of the system. The results indicate that the system is well-functioning, exhibits stable performance, and is capable of meeting the fundamental requirements of a career planning system.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Agriculture Internet of Things System Based on ZigBee and CC2530 Module
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on ZigBee, wireless sensor network, CC2530 module and other technologies, and according to the actual situation of agricultural environment, this paper designs and implements an agricultural Internet of Things management system based on ZigBee wireless sensor network, which realizes remote real-time monitoring and adjustment control of agricultural production, reduces the input of human resources and improves the production efficiency. The system can be externally connected with control equipment for environmental regulation or sensors for environmental data acquisition, which has good expansibility.

articleTitle: Research on Image Processing and Recognition Algorithms in Software Information Systems Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of deep learning technology, its application in image processing and recognition has become a hot research topic. The application of these technologies in software information systems such as automatic image classification, facial recognition, and medical image analysis not only improves processing efficiency but also enhances recognition accuracy. This article focuses on the training and deployment of adversarial generative network models in deep learning algorithms for graphic processing and recognition applications. Finally, two sets of simulation experiments were conducted, and the results are as follows: in the face recognition system, the recognition accuracy optimized by the deep learning algorithm based on adversarial generative networks improved by an average of 8.9% compared to traditional methods. In the traffic sign recognition system, the overall average recall index improved by 12.45%. This article proposes an improved network architecture and training strategy, which significantly improves the quality of image generation and the accuracy of recognition models in software information systems.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Monitoring and Maintenance System of Power Grid Equipment Online Status under Internet of Things Platform Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The existing power grid fault information acquisition methods are inefficient, slow and inaccurate, which are difficult to adapt to the growing demand of the power grid in the Internet of Things environment. In order to realize the intelligent monitoring and management of large-scale power equipment, the paper can start from the sensor level of the network, and use front-end sensors and ZigBee wireless line networking to complete the collection, aggregation and upload of information. This paper designs a power grid equipment fault monitoring system which is suitable for power grid monitoring. The circuit reset diagram is designed accordingly. According to the characteristics of wide distribution of data collection, the software function model to ensure the accuracy of data collection is established. The experimental results show that the fault information acquisition system can realize a large number of processing.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Recommendation Algorithm Based on Cluster Analysis and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The demand for personalized recommendation systems is gradually increasing under the backdrop of big data. This paper aims to enhance the effectiveness of personalized recommendation algorithms, better cater to users' individual needs, and provide support for constructing an improved content recommendation system. It proposes that a personalized algorithm based on cluster analysis and artificial intelligence can address the cold start problem faced by traditional recommendation algorithms, thereby further enhancing the efficacy of personalized content recommendations and user satisfaction. Additionally, it introduces the fundamental concept and implementation process of the algorithm while evaluating and analyzing its performance. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm outperforms traditional approaches in terms of accuracy, stability, and efficiency. The research findings not only enrich existing theoretical advancements in personalized recommendation algorithms but also offer decision-making guidance for enhancing recommendation system accuracy.

articleTitle: Commodity Price Fluctuation Prediction Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of electronic commerce, the accurate prediction of commodity price becomes particularly crucial for formulating market strategy and improving business efficiency. With the theme of “Commodity price forecasting based on neural network”, this research aims to improve the accuracy and practicability of commodity price forecasting with the help of deep learning technology. First of all, through the analysis of a large number of historical transaction data of commodities on the e-commerce platform, the research deeply explores the various factors affecting commodity prices, including commodity attributes, market supply and demand relations, seasonal changes, etc. On this basis, a comprehensive and comprehensive commodity price forecasting model is constructed to better reflect the complex correlation behind commodity prices. Secondly, this study uses neural networks as the main forecasting tool. Neural networks have been successful in many fields because of their powerful nonlinear modeling ability, especially on complex large-scale data sets. We design a deep neural network structure that can effectively capture nonlinear patterns and potential correlations in commodity price changes. By learning the patterns in historical data, the model has strong generalization ability and can adapt to the task of price prediction under different commodity and market conditions. Finally, we verify and test the proposed neural network model through experiments. Experiments show that the commodity price prediction model based on neural network has higher prediction accuracy and robustness than traditional methods. The model can quickly adapt to market changes, capture subtle changes in commodity price fluctuations, and provide more reliable price decision support for enterprises.

articleTitle: Enhancing Federated Learning: Transfer Learning Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is a decentralized machine learning framework that builds a shared model by distributing training data across mobile devices and aggregating updates from local computation. This technology is becoming increasingly popular in distributed medical research collaborations. Although FL performs well in the medical field, medical datasets are usually small, which limits the FL algorithms in terms of performance. Therefore, a challenge associated with datasets is how to select appropriate models to mitigate the possible impact of small datasets. The advantage of transfer learning is that it is borrowing the architecture of a trained model and then fine-tuning certain layers to reduce the computational cost of the training task. However, whether or not transfer learning is more effective than simply using a convolutional neural network model is still a question worth investigating for many applications. In this task, this article proposes an approach that applies a modified transfer learning model on small medical datasets. Theoretically, by utilizing existing robust models, it can capture important features of relevant data to compensate for small datasets. In experiments, this article compares the performance of models using transfer learning with models not using transfer learning in the FL framework. Specifically, this article compared the accuracy of three algorithms under both models, and the results show that the model using transfer learning does not perform as well as the simple convolutional neural network model in terms of performance. So this article explored and analyzed the possible remote causes in depth.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Intelligent Nursing Home Service Quality Assessment Factor Scoring Feedback System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper designs the function and database of the health service quality evaluation system of medical and nursing institutions. It includes the evaluation of the structure, service process and effect of the elderly care service. The game mechanism between government supervision departments, pension institutions and the elderly are constructed. This paper introduces how to implement the compatibility and extension of UDDI. In this paper, domain management, index management, service management, service ranking and service evaluation are discussed in detail from three aspects: domain expert, service provider and service demander. The research results can lay a foundation for the selection of elderly care institutions, the evaluation of medical service quality, the supervision and grading of medical service quality.

articleTitle: Research on Data Platform Construction and Security of Information Network Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The idea of blockchain is introduced, and the security of computer network is studied. Its main goal is to enhance the confidentiality and privacy of the data transfer and sharing process in the network. This project intends to convert the generated contract into a network-based expression of block coding and block information fusion, and combine this information expression with the security of computer networks to form an information security intelligent contract. This paper presents the process of identity authentication in network-based information system. Demand aggregation and buffering are used to reduce the amount of redundant communication in the network and speed up the transmission of communication. The use of off-chain storage can not only reduce the storage burden on the blockchain, but also ensure the safety and security of the data. The experimental simulation verifies that the trust distribution method based on blockchain and attribute can effectively control the access to data, and provide users with more secure and reliable information sharing and publishing services.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Enterprise Sales Prediction: Haressing CNN-LSTM-Attention Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This study introduces a novel CNN-LSTM-Attention model to address limitations in traditional LSTM architectures, particularly in scenarios impacted by small weights. Leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks and a multi-head attention mechanism with Dropout, the model optimizes the LSTM component for improved predictive capabilities. Experimental results on enterprise revenue prediction demonstrate a substantial decrease in RMSE and MAPE, indicating the model's superior accuracy compared to traditional LSTM and LSTM-Attention models. The proposed approach presents a promising avenue for advancing time series forecasting in scenarios where nuanced dependencies affect predictive outcomes.

articleTitle: Application of an Ensemble Method Based on XGBoost and Transformer in Predicting Sugarcane and Dragon Fruit Yields in Guangxi Region
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This study proposes an ensemble method specifically designed for predicting sugarcane and dragon fruit yields in the Guangxi region, based on XGBoost and Transformer. After exploring the complex relationship between meteorological factors (such as temperature, humidity, and precipitation) and the yields of sugarcane and dragon fruit, we developed this innovative predictive model. By combining the strong predictive power of XGBoost with the temporal pattern recognition ability of Transformer-based models, the ensemble model demonstrated excellent accuracy, stability, and convergence during both training and testing stages. We also conducted extensive data preprocessing and feature engineering to further enhance the model's performance. Practical applications demonstrate that this method is not only applicable to the Guangxi region but also widely used in other aspects of agricultural planning, risk management, and sustainable development. Moreover, compared to a single model, the flexibility and robustness of the ensemble method have been improved. Future research directions will include the assessment of model generalization ability, the increase of interpretability, and the possibility of extending this method to more crops and regions. Overall, this study provides not only an advanced and effective method for climate-driven crop yield prediction but also robust support for cross-disciplinary research in agricultural science and economics.

articleTitle: Based on the Super-Helical Sliding Mode Algorithm PMLSM Sensorless Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A super-helical sliding mode observer is designed in this paper to address the problems of high cost, inconvenient maintenance and susceptibility to perturbation of permanent magnet synchronous linear motor sensors. Since the speed of the motor estimated by the traditional sliding mode observer has serious jitter and hysteresis, the super-helical sliding mode observer is used to overcome these problems. From the simulation experiments, it can be seen that after the optimization of the super-helical sliding mode observer, the accuracy of the velocity observation is significantly improved, and the jitter problem and the robustness of the system caused by the sliding mode observer are effectively improved.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Media Image Processing and Enhancement System for Computer Deep Learning Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Combining the object-oriented technology and tree view function of VB6, a graphical control method based on tree view is presented. The information about the algorithm is wrapped in these graphical controls by means of wrapping. The boundary characteristics of the original image are extracted by filtering it based on the deep belief net. The mathematical model of deep belief net and its probability distribution function are established. In this project, the method of combining neural network transformation and sparse representation is proposed to carry out multi-feature fusion of image boundaries, and sigma function is added to the output layer of deep confidence network model to reduce the complexity of iterative training process. By extracting the shape gradient feature of the image boundary, the edge discrete feature is removed and the digital image boundary enhancement is realized. Experiments show that the improved image has better boundary characteristics. Under the same sample conditions, the number of iterative training steps is less, and the image edge processing effect is better than the traditional scheme.

articleTitle: High-Fidelity StyleGAN Inversion and Attribute Editing for Low Light Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Recently, many studies have been explored the latent space of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), especially the W-space of StyleGAN. Real-world image manipulation has made great progress, and most of them follow the “invert first, edit later” methodology. These methods use well light images as input, but it is challenging for low light image captured in extremely weak illumination conditions. Therefore, applying the existing StyleGAN inversion techniques under such conditions leads to serious image distortion. In this study, an embedding module is proposed for image inversion and editing of dark faces in the real world. The module can be embedded in popular StyleGAN inversion techniques to enhance low-quality dark face images and provide high-quality input for subsequent inversion editing. It is called the SE module. The structure of the SE module is designed by combining the U-N et structure with the CBAM attention module. This has two benefits. First, it facilitates capturing complete information from the images. Second, the incorporation of the attention mechanism enables the network model to focus more on the crucial features of the images. This generalized embedding module effectively alleviates the shortcomings of dark face image inversion, achieve high-quality inversion of dark images. The experiments demonstrate the superiority of the module.

articleTitle: Target - Attention Network for Click - Through Rate Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In Click-Through Rate (CTR) prediction scenario, deep neural network based learning algorithms provide leading-edge performance. Most of the algorithms embed target user and target item into vectors, then learning the click probability through deep neural networks. However, for sparse users, (i.e. users with less behaviour), or sparse items (i.e. new products, which are viewed by few users), they learn the embeddings not well enough due to the lack of specific samples, and thus affects the CTR prediction performance. To address the issue, we propose Target-Attention NetworK (TANK), a recommendation framework based on target attention technique. The framework includes information expansion for the user, information expansion for the item, and information expansion for the interaction between them. In user information extension part, considering that the target user's historical behaviour can be sparse, we use the historical users to extend target (sparse) user's information. In the item information expansion part, we use the historical items to expand target (sparse) item's information. In the user-item interaction expansion part, we consider both the historical user-item interactions of target user and historical interactions of target item. Our method's efficiency is ultimately proven using the public Amazon dataset.

articleTitle: Interference Suppression of Radio Signals in Urban Buildings
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The structure, height, and density of urban buildings, as well as the electromagnetic radiation generated by the electronic devices and electronic circuits within the building, can have an impact on radio signals, leading to selective fading in frequency and affecting the quality of communication. Therefore, a suboptimal blind MSE detection method is proposed. When suppressing broadband interference (multiple access and inter-symbol interference) in a communication system, narrowband interference (including sine wave signals, autoregressive signals, digital signals in multi-speed signal systems, etc.) and environmental noise generated by narrowband communication systems are eliminated, and subspace decomposition techniques and auxiliary vectors are used to simplify the traditional detectors. Simulation results show that the detector has a bit error rate of about 3 dB lower than that of conventional detectors at a signal-to-noise ratio of 10 dB.

Author Keywords: Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA) Intersymbol Interference (LSL)

articleTitle: Classification Prediction Study of Underwater Vehicle Fitness Zone Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, under the background of China's “Ocean Power” strategy, focusing on improving the navigation and positioning accuracy of underwater vehicles, a set of prediction models is established by processing gravity anomaly data, and the prediction technique of fitness zone classification is optimized. Firstly, the Kriging method is applied to improve the fineness of the gravity anomaly reference map, and the K-Means algorithm is used to realize the area division, and the polynomial regression model is used for the fitness calibration, which verifies its accuracy and reliability; secondly, the random forest algorithm is used to train the classification prediction model by combining the correlation analysis and feature importance assessment, which shows high accuracy and good generalization ability; finally, the model is validated. Finally, the applicability and prediction ability of the model on new datasets are verified by migration learning. Finally, the applicability and prediction ability of the model on new data sets are verified by migration learning. The research results in this paper are highly efficient and practical in the classification and prediction of marine gravity anomaly fitness zones, which is of great significance to the improvement of the underwater navigation accuracy and the marine environment management.

articleTitle: English Translation System Design Based on Adaptive Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper studies how to construct the conversion unit effectively in the process of binary conversion in English translation. A hardware-based cross-language conversion module construction method based on ATUC is proposed and monitored in real time. The corresponding decoding is carried out, and the corresponding mathematical model is established. According to the characteristics of software operation, dynamic adaptive adjustment of each conversion component is carried out to improve the success rate of compilation operation and maximize the efficiency of compilation operation. A hardware-based persistent commit address cache is proposed to help binary converter monitor program performance. The validity of the proposed method is verified by SPEC2000 simulation. In the translation program, the software translation part is generally completed by the conversion module, because the conversion module is the basis of the entire program, so the performance of the conversion module directly affects the speed and efficiency of the entire software. This paper proposes a hardware-based approach for building cross-language translation modules. In binary stream translation, persistent commit address cache is used to reduce network transmission and improve translation performance. The experimental results show that the proposed method has good performance.

articleTitle: Design of Electric Power Operation and Maintenance System Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The 3D operating environment of substation is established by virtual display method. By texturing it, the storage space is reduced and the realism of the model is improved. A standardized and functional interactive functional device model base is proposed to improve the simulation capability of 3D substation. Secondly, man-machine dialogue mechanism based on virtual instrument is used to realize the whole process of operation and maintenance training of virtual substation. The research contents include power quality classification, voltage classification, power grid voltage classification based on high-frequency words, and fault diagnosis of power grid based on SVM model. Finally, the functions of equipment operation, regular inspection and failure analysis are realized, and the simulation of operation process is realized in virtual environment. The system has 3D display, real-time interaction, dynamic simulation and other functions, but also can work on PC and Windows and other operating systems, so it has low cost, high efficiency, easy to use and other advantages.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power and Voltage Cooperative Optimization and Composite Control System in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This project aims to minimize the active power loss and voltage fluctuation of the substation. Using the counting algorithm, under the given constraint conditions, the transformer turn-off, tap regulation and static reactive power compensation equipment are comprehensively analyzed, and they are applied to economic operation. With the goal of minimum network loss and maximum voltage pass rate of each node, tap and capacitor switching of on-load regulator transformer in each substation are taken as control objectives. Using SCADA function in dispatching automation system, the optimal automatic regulation of power grid is carried out. Through practical application, the economical operation is proved, the fluctuation of voltage and reactive power is stabilized, and the power supply quality of substation is improved. This method can significantly improve the voltage qualification rate of each node of the regional power grid, reduce the line loss, and has great popularization value.

articleTitle: Research on Multibeam Line Planning Based on Affine Transformation and Softmax Improved K-Means Clustering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)

articleTitle: Tracking Algorithm Based on Attention Mechanism and Template Update
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: We propose a tracking algorithm based on attention mechanisms and template updating to solve problems like target deformation, occlusion, and poor tracking performance in complex background conditions caused by the Fully Convolutional Siamese Network's (SiamFC) simple structure. Introducing channel attention mechanisms directs the neural network's focus towards crucial channel information, thereby enhancing the network's discriminative ability. Utilizing a template updating strategy dynamically refreshes the template, improving the model's resilience against drift and refining the network's precision in localization and adaptability. Experimental results on the OTB100 target tracking dataset validate the efficacy of the proposed algorithm. Compared to the baseline SiamFC algorithm, the improved algorithm demonstrates a 6.1% increase in success rate and a 9.2% increase in precision rate.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Big Data Technology in the Evaluation System of Track and Field Auxiliary Training
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Using a hybrid gene neural network, this paper introduces the special data of track and field athletes. According to the adjustment between the internal nodes of the system, the special data information of athletes is processed, and the grey prediction model of technical level is constructed. In this paper, the sprinting technique in track and field in China is studied by using neural network technique. The statistical theory is used to predict the time series of sprint performance in different periods. Secondly, the phase space reconstruction of the motion performance in different periods is carried out based on the phase space theory. Finally, a dynamic analytical model of the evolution trend of motion performance is constructed based on neural network and interval phase space theory. In this way, the dynamic analysis of the motion state is realized. In the process of data processing, the advantages of the structure of the data are used to parallel the data that cannot be associated in the original data. The simulation results show that the algorithm provides accurate reference data and usage attributes for the prediction process.

articleTitle: The Guiding Function of Different SAR Image Quality Indicators on Object Detection Tasks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the big data era, Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery has become increasingly critical, particularly for data-driven object detection tasks. Various downstream tasks are extremely sensitive to SAR image quality because the SAR image is extremely influenced by diverse factors such as speckle noise. Therefore, the quality assessment of SAR images is crucial, especially in the context of no-reference image quality metrics. However, there is no universal standard to quantitatively assess the SAR image quality, and how these metrics influence the SAR detection tasks is ambiguous. This paper emphasizes the guiding function of different SAR image quality assessment metrics on SAR target detection tasks. A comprehensive comparison of several widely used SAR image quality metrics is undertaken, including entropy, RMS contrast, equivalent number of looks (ENL), Laplacian and Tenengrad sharpness, and frequency domain sharpness. First, utilizing the MSAR large-scale dataset, we analyze these metrics to identify the most suitable ones for object detection tasks. Further, we demonstrate the practical application of these metrics by integrating them into the YOLOv5 object detection framework. This research not only offers a new perspective on SAR image quality assessment but also provides practical guidance for future applications, aligning with the broader need for efficient and accurate no-reference quality assessment methods in areas like remote sensing, where image distortions and the unavailability of reference images are common challenges.

articleTitle: Research on Weather Process Similarity Based on 3D CNN Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article proposes a weather process similarity and retrieval algorithm based on a 3D CNN Autoencoder. It uses 3D CNN to extract features of weather elements in multi-dimensional space. The encoder outputs a one-dimensional vector of size 512. The cosine similarity between two weather processes is then calculated based on the two one-dimensional vectors, representing their similarity. Experimental data demonstrates the effectiveness of this algorithm. By searching historical weather processes based on the forecast date and referring to the evolution of historical weather processes, it provides positive guidance for current weather forecasts.

articleTitle: Research on Disease Prediction Based on Daily Data Analysis of the Elderly Based on Neural Network Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, with the gradual arrival of an aging society, the health status of the elderly has attracted widespread attention. Against this background, this study aims to explore the potential value of these data for disease prediction by collecting and analyzing daily data of the elderly based on neural network algorithms. First, by using technical means such as smart sensing devices and mobile applications, we collected multi-dimensional data on the elderly's daily life, including but not limited to physiological indicators, activity levels, social interactions, and sleep patterns. These data are considered potential disease predictors because they provide comprehensive information about the physical condition and lifestyle of older adults. Second, we apply the collected data to a neural network algorithm, which has powerful learning and pattern recognition capabilities. By training models, neural networks can learn potential patterns and regularities from large amounts of complex data, thereby providing strong support for disease prediction. We pay special attention to the superiority of neural networks in processing multi-source heterogeneous data to more comprehensively understand the multi-faceted information of the elderly's health status. Through experiments and verification, we evaluate the performance of neural network algorithms in disease prediction in the elderly. This study explores disease prediction based on the daily data of the elderly based on neural network algorithms, aiming to provide scientific basis for establishing a more intelligent and accurate elderly health management system to promote the health and well-being of the elderly.

articleTitle: Research on the Difficulty Mining Algorithm for the Integration of Multiple Sets of Data Platforms Based on Big Data Analysis in Smart Factories
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the continuous development of intelligent manufacturing technology, smart factories have become an important direction of manufacturing transformation and upgrading. The integration of multiple sets of data platforms in the smart factory is a key part of realizing the smart factory. In this paper, the difficulty mining and automatic algorithm research of multiple data platforms in smart factory integration are discussed. Firstly, this paper analyzes and summarizes several sets of data platforms in the smart factory. The data platform in smart factory includes production data platform, equipment data platform, quality data platform and many other aspects. There are some problems among these data platforms, such as the inconsistency of data format, large amount of data and fast update of data, which brings challenges to the data fusion of multi-platforms. Secondly, this paper puts forward the difficulty mining method of multi-set data platform integration based on big data analysis. By analyzing the problems and faults in the process of data fusion on different platforms, the difficulties of data fusion are found out. The algorithm realizes automatic fusion between data platforms through intelligent analysis and processing of data. Finally, this paper verifies the proposed method and algorithm through a practical case. Through the application of the proposed method and algorithm in the actual smart factory, good results are obtained. The data fusion between data platforms is more efficient and accurate, providing strong support for the production and management of smart factories.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Synchronous Production Automation System of Animation Manual Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduces a method of combining virtual reality and Unity3D to conduct animation demonstration of animation products. The purpose is to improve the digital display on animation products. The embedded development software based on Visual C++ realizes the virtual reality of the animation demonstration system based on Vega Prime of the visual simulation. The system includes the 3D animation module of the animation manual, including the information collection module, the database model, the 3D reconstruction module, and the visual simulation module. By using VR programming method, the 3D animation demonstration system of cartoon hand is designed in virtual reality, and the entity modeling of the animation demonstration system and the effect of the animation demonstration are analyzed by using 3 dsMAX. Simulation experiments show that the proposed algorithm has good output performance and display effect.

articleTitle: Time Series Based Decision Making Problem of Vegetable Replenishment and Pricing in Superstores
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the progress of living standards, people are more and more thirsty for green and healthy life, for the purchase of vegetables also has a higher pursuit of hope to buy fresh and cheap vegetables, and due to the short freshness period of vegetables, seasonal characteristics, super sales space is very limited. In this paper, through the quantification of the previous sales data, we explored the relationship between vegetable categories and analyzed the vegetable pricing strategy. First of all, the sales volume of vegetable categories is analyzed from the perspective of year, season and month, and the correlation is verified by Spearman's test, and the sales volume of individual products is divided according to the month, and then clustering analysis is carried out by using K-Means cluster analysis based on PSO particle swarm algorithm. Then, the final replenishment quantity is obtained by time series forecasting using the combined time series model based on LSTM-XGBoost, the average wholesale price is obtained by using the ARIMA time series forecasting model, a nonlinear planning model is built out, and finally the single-item sales strategy is derived by a heuristic algorithm. Finally, taking whether to stock the vegetable on the shelves on a single day as the decision variable, this paper maximizes revenue as the objective function, defines the sales space and the loss rate threshold as the constraints, establishes a 0–1 planning model, and solves to obtain the single-day sales strategy by using the heuristic algorithm. The vegetable replenishment and pricing model established in this paper can be closely linked with the actual situation, can be combined with the actual situation to solve the problem, the model has good generality and popularization.

articleTitle: XGBoost and ANOVA-based Analysis of Sailboat Prices and Their Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The sailboat market is a dynamic industry characterized by fluctuations in demand and pricing due to factors such as economic conditions, area as well as the hull. Analyzing the factors influencing the listing price of sailboats has its pros and cons; the pros include a better understanding of market trends, informed decision-making for buyers and sellers, and insights into the most significant value drivers. The purpose of this study is to analyze the multiple influences on sailboat pricing. First, this paper finds that sailboat characteristics have little impact on pricing and other factors are more critical. The analysis shows that geographic region has an impact on pricing, but not significantly, while different sailboat types have different impacts in different regions. Finally, this paper finds that catamarans have a significantly greater impact on price than monohulls, emphasizing the importance of hull type in pricing. These findings deepen the understanding of sailboat pricing factors and have important implications for the market and consumer demand.

articleTitle: Optimization of Network Layout and Cost Calculation Rules for Power Warehousing Business Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Warehouse management is a very important aspect of goods and materials management, and its position in modern power grid enterprise goods and materials management is becoming increasingly high. With the development of information technology, warehousing has moved towards the direction of information technology. The traditional management mode of power warehousing is single, and information technology is outdated. There are often problems such as repeated storage of goods and materials, inability to effectively mobilize, unreasonable design of warehousing scale, unreasonable layout of power warehousing network, and difficulty in predicting the operating and construction costs of logistics for power grid enterprises. Cloud computing is a service related to information technology and the internet, which can provide a hardware foundation for internet information processing. To solve the problems existing in traditional power warehousing, this article conducts research on cloud computing, aiming to optimize the network layout of power warehousing business and the rules for cost calculation, and reduce the construction and operation costs of power enterprises. Experiments have shown that optimizing the network layout of power warehousing business using cloud computing can improve operational efficiency by about 20% and save operational costs to save total costs. After optimizing cost calculation rules using cloud computing, the predicted results are very accurate.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Parallelization of Improved Spectral Clustering Algorithm for Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the field of data mining, clustering algorithms play a key role in extracting valuable insights from vast datasets without incorporating learning mechanisms. One such classical clustering approach is the spectral clustering algorithm. This algorithm effectively converts a clustering challenge into the segmentation of an undirected graph, enabling it to handle intricate non-convex datasets adeptly and avoid getting trapped in local optimization pitfalls. Nevertheless, the conventional spectral clustering technique relies on the Gaussian kernel function, which uses Euclidean distance to determine sample similarities. This method proves overly sensitive to the Gaussian kernel's parameters and fails to accurately represent inter-sample relationships. To address the drawbacks related to similarity measurement and the computational inefficiencies inherent in the traditional spectral clustering method, enhancements have been made to refine the clustering outcomes. The enhanced spectral clustering algorithm has been redesigned to be distributed and parallelized, a strategic move intended to bolster the processing ability when handling enormous datasets.

articleTitle: Maximum Power Study of Wave Energy Device Based on MPPT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the in-depth study of the energy conversion efficiency of the built-in PTO-type wave energy device and explores the dynamic response and maximum power output of the device by using theoretical analysis and MATLAB simulation model. Firstly, the study determines the vertical oscillation displacement and velocity of the float and oscillator under different wave conditions and the longitudinal swing angular displacement and angular velocity, which reveals the basic characteristics of the dynamic response; secondly, the average output power of the PTO system is improved by constructing a mathematical model and optimizing the damping coefficients of the linear and rotary dampers; lastly, the experimental results validate the validity of the perturbation observation method of the hierarchical adjusting step size for power tracking. Finally, the experimental results verify the effectiveness of the perturbation observation method with graded adjustment step for power tracking, which clarifies that the maximum output power of the system under different damping coefficients can be up to 754625.1285w, which provides a new theoretical basis and technological path for the development of wave energy conversion technology.

articleTitle: Flight Safety Research Based on GBDT Regression and Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper focuses on an in-depth study of flight safety in the civil aviation transportation industry. Considering the great impact of serious flight accidents on the safety of airlines and passengers, this study first reviewed the public information of the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) and conducted a reliability study on the relevant data. Firstly, we questioned the problems in the data set through mathematical and statistical methods and found that the “elevation and pitch rate” is a key factor affecting flight safety using GBDT regression analysis. Secondly, using a graphical neural network model enhanced by cluster analysis and attention mechanism, this paper identifies the main operational factors affecting aircraft flight as stick volume and attitude, and points out that incorrect stick release operation is the cause of abnormal landing G-value. Finally, this paper explores flight overrun events through qualitative and quantitative analysis and finds that most overrun events occur at landing, especially on the takeoff-to-landing route from Airport 68 to Airport 9. Although the chi-square test showed that aircraft number and route had a significant effect on the type of overrun, the effect was small. These findings provide an important basis for understanding and improving flight safety issues.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Highway Traffic Congestion and Accident Risk Early Warning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to change the passive monitoring mode of the current road network operation, a portable and reusable traffic congestion and traffic accident risk pre-prediction and active early warning model was studied. After comprehensive research and study of domestic and international traffic operation state early warning algorithms, a dynamic Bayesian network was selected to build the early warning model. Firstly, nearly 4 million traffic control station and vehicle detector detection data from May to December 2019 were integrated, and data integrity test and multi-source data association were carried out to mine the risk characteristics of traffic congestion and traffic accidents on the highway network, which were used as sample data to train the dynamic Bayesian network. Through testing and analysis, the model can realize short-term traffic congestion and traffic accident risk early warning, and the early warning accuracy rate exceeds 85%. The developed model shares the early warning results with the existing business system in real time through the data interface to improve the scope of application of the model.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multi-Source Heterogeneous Integrated Equipment for Environmental Monitoring of Cultural Relics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In view of the numerous heterogeneous devices and protocols in the environmental monitoring system for the preservation of cultural relics, the overall architecture and scheme of multi-source heterogeneous network integration were proposed. Based on the analysis of the overall framework of the environmental monitoring system, the overall scheme of heterogeneous network integration equipment is proposed and the implementation scheme is introduced by modules based on modularization thinking. Through software design and transplantation, the feasibility of the scheme is proved. The heterogeneous network fusion equipment can realize the collection and integration of heterogeneous data from multiple sources, and can promote the integrated development of environmental monitoring system for cultural relics and other museum holdings.

articleTitle: Research and Evaluation Based on Principal Component Analysis and BP Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, based on the GBET dataset, 12 factors are used as secondary indicators, and then the 12 indicators are extracted into 3 primary indicators, and then the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is used for principal component analysis. Taking the 3 indicators as inputs and the evaluation results as outputs, the BP neural network model is used to establish the evaluation model. Considering the shortcomings of the BP neural network with low accuracy, we used a computer to analyze its error and improve the accuracy. Finally, we performed model testing to ensure the usability of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Carbon Emission Characteristics of Coal-Fired Units Under Peak Shaving Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to study the carbon emission characteristics of coal-fired units under peak shaving conditions, the carbon accounting method based on energy balance and the conservation of materials is adopted to realize the minute level continuous monitoring of carbon emission intensity of coal-fired units. Then the carbon emission intensity of 4 × 600MW and 1 000MW units is monitored and analyzed. The results show that the carbon emission characteristics of each unit have significant differences. The carbon emission intensity for some units will increase sharply when the load is reduced to less than 50%. But for other units, the carbon emission intensity change gently under the condition of deep peak regulation. The carbon emission intensity of lean coal units is higher than that of bituminous coal units of the same grade. These research results can provide references for power grid low-carbon scheduling, and support the power grid to consume new energy and reduce the overall carbon emission of coal-fired units through adjusting the generator set combination.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Retrieval System of Intelligent Computer AI in Post-Moore Era
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper proposes a big data search platform in the post-Moore period. The algorithm can adapt to the storage and calculation of large-scale data, and can search video data quickly. The aim of this research is low accuracy and low recall rate of existing retrieval algorithms based on artificial neural networks. Cite Space technology is used to obtain the corresponding information through the statistical analysis of the keywords in the massive data. This project intends to MapReduce to analyze the correlation characteristics of massive data. The large-scale data analysis method of MapReduce is studied, so as to achieve the automatic query of massive data. And we pre-inspect it before entering the warehouse and use a variety of tools for data access and management. Simulation results show that the new method proposed in this project can effectively improve the computational performance of spatiotemporal big data, and improve its application in massive, multi-source, heterogeneous and other complex data.

articleTitle: Refining Machine Learning for Employee Turnover Classification: A CAP-BOA-Based Probability Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach, the CAP-BOA-based Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN), aimed at optimizing the smoothing factor of PNN to address the suboptimal performance issues encountered by traditional methods in handling complex classification problems. The CAP-BOA algorithm leverages the global and local search capabilities of the Butterfly Optimization Algorithm (BOA) and integrates Cauchy mutation, adaptive weight optimization, and dynamic switching probability strategy to enhance the rationality of computation and switching strategies during the optimization process. Compared to conventional PNN optimization methods, the CAP-BOA-based PNN demonstrates a significant improvement in convergence accuracy. Experimental results validate the efficacy of this approach in overcoming traditional limitations, particularly in the scenario of classifying employee turnover within enterprises. The findings showcase the effectiveness of the CAP-BOA-based PNN in achieving enhanced overall convergence accuracy.

articleTitle: Development of Multi-Interface Compatibility Technology and Storage Device for Power Optical Fiber Jumper
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the multi-interface compatibility technology and the portable coiled storage device for power optical fiber jumper is studied. The developed device not only meets all the onsite emergency repair requirements for the substation optical fiber interfaces working scenarios, but also reduces damages during transportation and avoid disorderly storage. It provides an efficient and economical tools for optical fiber communication equipment connection, and can greatly save the debugging/abnormal handling time.

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in Enterprise Financial Accounting Risk Warning System
