publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper establishes an effective early-warning system framework of corporate financial risk. This paper discusses the early-warning model of financial risk. On this basis, Bayes-SVM algorithm is applied to the classification of financial crisis events. We timely detect and alarm the abnormal situation in the company's financial system. Finally, an example is given to prove that the proposed algorithm is correct. This model provides a new way of thinking for the early warning and prevention of enterprise financial risk.

Author Keywords: enterprise finance and accounting risk early warning system

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Visualization of Multibeam Survey Lines Based on Theoretical Derivation and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper studies the modeling and application of multibeam bathymetry. Firstly, considering the influence of slope on the multibeam bathymetric system, mathematical models of coverage width and overlap rate between adjacent strips of multibeam bathymetry are established, and parameters such as seawater depth, coverage width and overlap rate corresponding to the distance of different survey lines from the center point are calculated. Then, the influence of the angle between the direction of the survey line and the projection of the normal direction of the seabed slope in the horizontal plane is taken into account to evaluate the effect of multibeam bathymetry in a more complex three-dimensional environment, and the size of the coverage widths corresponding to the distances at different angles is calculated. Again, a set of survey lines with the shortest measuring length, which can completely cover the whole sea area to be measured and with an overlap rate of 100%~20%, are designed according to the parameters of the sea area conditions, and the methods of calculating the coverage width and the spacing of the lines are determined through mathematical models to give the surveying line scheme. Finally, a three-dimensional seabed topographic model was constructed to depict the seabed topographic features in detail. In order to meet the requirements of minimizing the total length of the survey lines, covering the entire sea area to be surveyed, and controlling the overlap rate of adjacent strips to be less than 20%, the optimal direction and spacing of the survey lines were defined, and an iterative method was used to find the optimal direction and spacing of the survey lines.

articleTitle: Research and Application Based on Principal Component Analysis Model and XGBoost Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the entropy weight method was first used to calculate the weights of different indicators based on PRES Dataset, and then the influence factors were analyzed using principal component regression to verify the feasibility of the method used. Based on the scores the scoring object is divided and the categorized data is visualized and a skewed distribution is observed, so the SMOTE method is used to oversample to increase the number of samples and obtain unbiased data. Based on this, the feature importance score is calculated using XGBoost and the feature importance score is analyzed and interpreted through the analysis.

articleTitle: Data Analysis of Cross-Border E-Commerce Entrepreneurship Based on User Portraits
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper proposes a transnational e-commerce platform based on user portrait. The system adopts Spring Mvc+ spring+ mybatis architecture. Using MySQL5.7 database, Tomcat7.0 server, redis cache and other methods, customers and merchants are seamlessly connected to provide prototypes. A method based on “word frequency-text frequency-tag weight” is proposed to model business records of a large number of customers in cross-border e-commerce enterprises. This project establishes a personalized marking system based on customer portraits to conduct in-depth research on the customer service activities of multinational e-commerce enterprises. We tap into the hidden high-risk information and present it to consumers. Practice has proved that dangerous behaviors can be found effectively by modeling user characteristics in the network, which help cross-border e-commerce to achieve data security operation dynamic monitoring. Based on word frequency statistics, the algorithm based on word frequency and PDF is convenient for statistics and calculation, and it is used to calculate the E-mail text frequency. In the project, we propose a clustering algorithm based on user behavior, which can extract user interest model from raw data. Through the analysis of user behavior, we can better understand the user's behavior pattern. And through the understanding of users, we discover the potential needs of users, which can provide valuable services for enterprises.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of an Intelligent Home Health Service Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the increase in the aging population in China, there is a growing demand for medical services, highlighting the uneven distribution of medical resources and posing significant challenges to the health care capabilities of hospitals. Consequently, designing an intelligent home health service robot that provides online diagnostics for family members can help alleviate the shortage of medical resources. This paper establishes a model of the robot using Solid Works, conducts finite element simulation analysis on key components, and the results show that the robot operates within safe limits. Additionally, important components were optimized for weight reduction using Fusion360. The final design integrates basic patient treatment, medicine storage, intelligent companionship, and security alarm functions into one intelligent home health service robot. This paper can provide a theoretical reference for the design of intelligent home service robots.

articleTitle: Research on optimal scheduling of distributed flexible resources based on regional energy autonomous balancing architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of optimizing distributed flexible resources, a distributed flexible resource optimization scheduling model based on regional energy self-balancing architecture is proposed. The regional energy autonomous architecture is analyzed, focusing on the role of edge computing in the architecture, and explaining the basic principles of autonomous scheduling. The basic connotation of flexible resources is analyzed and the basic characteristics of flexible resources are explained. A multi-objective optimization model based on cloud-side distributed power capacity optimization, side-side model cost optimization, and end-side model revenue optimization is proposed, and is solved using the augmented Lagrangian function. Finally, simulation analysis was conducted based on the 39-node model to demonstrate the effectiveness of the model proposed in this article.

articleTitle: Shape Statistical Model-Based Regression for Predicting Anatomical Landmarks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Determining appropriate shapes and establishing corresponding relationships based on 3D models remains a significant challenge. This research employs shape statistical models and direct correspondence between two morphologies via support vector regression. The displacement of sampled points to the standard model, calculated through non-rigid registration, represents the shape state. Constructing shape statistical models based on the deformation fields of sampled points from different models and subsequently mapping high-dimensional cranial features using support vector regression allows for establishing relationships between different models. The study used 77 mandibles and maxillas for the validation. Predicting the mandible using the maxilla resulted in a 2.43mm average error, while predicting the maxilla using the mandible yielded a 1.95mm average error. It offers potential avenues for further research and applications in craniofacial reconstruction.

articleTitle: Research on the Whole Route Risk Control Technology for Ferry Vehicles Based on AI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at the insufficient supervision of ferry vehicles during navigation, the demand for safety supervision of ferry vehicles is analyzed. Meanwhile, a risk control architecture for the whole route of ferry vehicles based on Artificial Intelligence (AI) is constructed on these grounds. Relying on version 8.0 of You Only Look Once (YOLO) technique the overall risk management and control technology of ferry vehicles, the detection and identification technology of mixed vehicles, the detection and identification technology of vehicle slippery slope, and the detection and identification technology of early start-up are researched. And these detection technologies are applied to develop a whole route risk management system for ferry vehicles. The validation test shows that the accuracy of risk identification of the whole route of ferry vehicles is up to 80%, which indicates that the system can be applied to guide the safety production work of ferry transportation. Finally, the conclusion points to further research work on ferry safety in the future.

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in Image Search and Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the data transfer rate and identification search efficiency of image recognition, a software driver interface design architecture based on FACADE is established in this paper. The PCI device is driven by MDL memory and the vector identification software is designed. Then, a background occlusion method based on microscopic search is proposed to find an efficient decision subset to replace the traditional decision set. This allows efficient retrieval of high-precision image matting. The comparison with the classical matting method proves that the proposed method can effectively overcome the occlusion problem when the foreground and background are highly similar. At the same time, it can effectively reduce the dimension of high-score image matting problem, so as to improve the accuracy of foreground occlusion extraction.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonic Suppression Strategy Based on Three-Phase Voltage Source Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Electric energy is a necessary condition for the stable and orderly operation of today's society, so the issue of power quality has also received significant attention from scholars. With the development of power electronics technology and the widespread application of power electronics equipment, the harmonic problems that arise have become increasingly serious. At the same time, with the increasing demand for high power quality in industry, building a safe and reliable power grid environment has become particularly important. Therefore, harmonic and reactive power control of the power grid has become a hot research topic for scholars. Passive power filters are mainly composed of passive components such as capacitors, inductors, resistors, etc. Although the passive power filter has a simple structure and can effectively filter out certain harmonics, its structure has a large volume, and the design of capacitance and inductance parameters is relatively complex, which is prone to resonance problems. Its application has certain limitations. Compared with passive filters, active power filters have superior dynamic performance, fast response speed, small circuit size, and good compensation effect. Therefore, they are more widely used in circuits. So active filters are generally used in industry. In response to the problem of AC side current waveform distortion, this article calculates the parameters of the passive filter, which effectively eliminates 5th, 7th, and 11th harmonics, and compares them with the adopted active filter strategy, effectively improving the waveform quality of AC side current. Finally, experimental verification was conducted on the active filtering scheme, proving its correctness and superiority.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Technology and Its Performance Evaluation in Power Inspection Work Order Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Digital twin technology is an advanced data simulation and analysis tool with great potential for power inspection work order processing. It can help inspectors identify and solve problems more accurately and efficiently by conducting high-precision simulations of the power system. The role of digital twin technology is mainly reflected in real-time data monitoring, fault prediction, and optimization decision-making. By comparing the data with the actual power system, inspectors can promptly identify abnormal situations and take corresponding measures. By simulating and analyzing the power system, inspectors can predict potential faults in advance and take preventive measures. In addition, digital twin technology can also evaluate the effectiveness of different decision-making solutions and select the optimal solution to solve the problem. In the future, the development direction of digital twin technology includes improving accuracy and accuracy, optimizing models and algorithms, improving data collection and transmission efficiency, and strengthening data security and privacy protection. Through experiments, it can be seen that the growth rates of enterprises that do not use digital twin technology combined with power inspection work order processing were 2.59%~3.21 %, 3.48%~4.52%, and 3.10%~5.51 %, respectively. The growth rates of enterprises that use digital twin technology combined with power inspection work order processing were 3.11 %–7.95~, 4.57%~7.66%, and 5.13%~8.45%. From this, it can be seen that with the continuous development and application of technology, digital twin technology would play an increasingly important role in the processing of power inspection work orders, providing strong support for the safe and stable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Tourism Visual Analysis Platform Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the continuous development and application of new technologies such as big data, Internet of Things, cloud computing, virtual reality and artificial intelligence, intelligent tourism has ushered in new development opportunities. More and more cities begin to pay attention to the information construction of scenic spots, and look forward to new technologies to provide scientific and effective analytical data for the tourism industry. In view of the above problems, the smart tourism visual analysis platform based on digital twins is designed to conduct a comprehensive and detailed analysis of the tourist destination's traffic situation, security supervision, resource information, weather environment monitoring and epidemic prevention and control through the method of data visualization and visual analysis. The results indicate that the platform presents information to users in a digital twin and visualized manner, with characteristics such as scientific information management and intelligent processing and analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the Automatic Recheck System and Maintenance Technology for Dismantled Electric Energy Meters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper designs an intelligent management system for millions of dismantled and returned electricity meters to achieve automatic sorting and evaluation of dismantled and used electricity meters. The system includes storage connection unit, automatic loading and unloading unit, system conveying unit, automatic disassembly unit, automatic identification unit, appearance inspection unit, labeling unit, manual labeling unit, automatic sorting unit and scrap disposal unit. By categorizing the faults in the installation components of the dismantled energy meter, the maintenance value is determined based on the fault situation, maintenance cost, and remaining life.

articleTitle: Research of Embedded Mobile Information Precision Push in Power Marketing System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of power communication network, in the digital transformation of state Grid marketing system, there are large problems such as the feedback of system use, the unclear approval process, and the inability to work on mobile terminal. In view of this problem, this paper proposes an embedded mobile information precision push system. First of all, the definition of the embedded mobile accurate information and the characteristics of the push are sorted out. Then, the principle and solution of information push are analyzed. Finally, the application of the design information push in the mobile office of marketing service, including the design of the system software and hardware platform. Through experiments, it is proved that the system design has fully reached the expected function and performance indicators. It provides solutions for enterprise employees to timely view the enterprise business update information in mobile terminals anytime and anywhere, so as to realize convenient and efficient mobile office.

articleTitle: Research on Educational Intelligence Platform Integrating Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper proposes a big data intelligent teaching system for teachers and students of the whole school. The core function of the education cloud system is to collect various service data using the network, sensors and other devices, and store service data in large storage devices. The students were tested using a fusion collection algorithm of multiple features. 4.49% of the students gave a high evaluation after the trial of this platform. It has been proved that this system can greatly improve communication in spare time, and its application effect is also relatively good. Through the implementation of this project, the problem of storing massive teaching information resources can be solved well. Teaching resources are available to anyone, anywhere, anytime. It can solve the problem that the data storage in the current network is too large, which leads to the user's access delay, and the legitimacy, integrity and availability of the data are not guaranteed. This method improves the performance of permanent storage of educational data.

articleTitle: Research on the Intelligent Question-Answering Model of Electric Power Knowledge Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the context of digital economy era, power marketing data information is called the barometer of economic operation stability, which to a large extent represents the development trend and situation of social economy[l]. In recent years, with the continuous improvement of the attention of power marketing data, the opening and sharing of power marketing data has become one of the hot social topics[2]. In view of the shortcomings of the current knowledge base intelligent interaction, we put forward intelligent knowledge base model based on deep learning. By joining the BiGRU layer it can be extracted from the BERT output vector sequence up and down the correlation information, real-time update problem dynamic processing scheme of information improves the knowledge base, and accelerates the information transmission and sharing[3].

articleTitle: Electric Field Safety Planning Method under Urban Power Grid based on Improved ELECTRE
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The distribution of electric fields around transmission lines is one of the key concerns in urban power supply. This paper focuses on the impact of electric fields from transmission lines on sensitive points in urban buildings and houses, and proposes corresponding control methods. The distribution patterns of electric fields near different types of buildings and urban clusters are summarized for both AC and DC transmission lines sharing the same tower structure. Taking into account the electric field requirements at the top and inside sensitive points of buildings, a combined approach using shielding wires and trees for electric field control is proposed. The control results under various methods are quantitatively calculated using COMSOL software. Finally, the ELECTRE method and entropy weight method are employed to select the optimal electric field control planning scheme, demonstrating the effectiveness and practical significance of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: Electric field layout in multiple buildings

articleTitle: Research on English Online Classroom Learning System Based on Computer Intelligent Assistive Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The English learning system structure designed in this article is mainly based on the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$B/S$</tex> three-level architecture. A relational database uses SQLite as the data layer. The system uses the Bootstrap system to automatically recognize English words, and uses custom tags to enable teachers to quickly review test papers and provide feedback. An automatic image recognition technology that combines similarity comparison based on field context and CNN+BLSTM is proposed. This paper analyzes the user registration model and query process, uses multiple information technologies to ensure the stability of online teaching and further expand teaching methods. Experiments have proven that the proposed English intelligent dictionary recommendation system has the same characteristics as the age similarity weight, and both show an increasing trend as the parameters increase. The system can clearly display the records of words that the learning object has learned after logging into the system, including the number of times the word has been used, achieving intelligent effects.

articleTitle: Intelligent Medication System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Nowadays, many common diseases are managed through the use of prolonged medication, and even many newborns rely on medicine to sustain their lives from the moment of birth. Currently, there are many smart medicine boxes, smart medicine kits and other devices for patients in the market. However, the prescription operation for individual patients lacks more personalized medication reminders, which is not conducive to improving the level of pharmaceutical services in the hospital. In order to remind patients to take medicine on time and monitor the physical condition of users after taking medicine, in this paper, we take the intelligent medication system of the Internet of Things and its working method as the research subject, and propose a novel medication reminder system of doctor-patient interconnection. The system includes a medicine box, a hospital system platform, and a smart bracelet for the user to wear. It can remind the user to take medicine when needed and monitor their physical condition after medication. Meanwhile, the hospital system platform accurately receives information, such as medication time, dosage and other details, and provides timely feedback and assistance to patients.

articleTitle: Enterprise Performance Prediction Based on FASSA Elman Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The Elman Neural Network, known for its distinctive architecture with recurrent connections, is a tool for dynamic modeling and capturing temporal dependencies. To enhance its capabilities, this paper introduces an innovative optimization approach, addressing challenges related to random weight initialization. We propose an enhanced Elman Neural Network optimization strategy using the Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA), recognizing its global search capabilities and improved precision. To overcome SSA's drawbacks, a novel Firefly Optimized Sparrow Search Algorithm is introduced, integrating the Firefly Algorithm to enhance optimization complexity. The FA-SSA optimized Elman Neural Network is applied to predict enterprise performance, showcasing benefits in capturing temporal dynamics and intricate patterns. In summary, the proposed Firefly Optimized Sparrow Search Algorithm offers a robust solution for systematic weight and threshold optimization, enhancing the Elman Neural Network's performance.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Power Grid Data Transmission System Based on LoRa Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This study introduces LoRa technology to build a new generation of power grid data transmission communication platform, studies the direct communication method between the main station system and the electricity meter, and studies the feasibility of using LoRa technology instead of GPRS/CDMA technology in the data transmission system of the power grid. The communication network formed by LoRa technology can play an increasingly important role in the fields of smart grid lines, smart distribution networks, smart power supply networks, and smart electricity safety in the future, providing a “last mile” wireless communication network capability supplement for the existing wired private network of Southern Power Grid.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Scientific Research Management System Based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the increasing development of technology, research activities and capabilities of universities have become important indicators for measuring their comprehensive strength. The assessment of scientific research achievements has also become one of the indicators for measuring the year-end performance of university teachers. Therefore, this article proposes using ASP Design a four layer network architecture research management system using NET as the development platform, C# development language, and B/S structure programming model. The system uses an improved association rule Apriori algorithm to perform association analysis on scientific research assessment information, and quantifies the analysis results. The results indicate that the system can provide reference for the design of dynamic indicators for scientific research assessment of teachers, and provide reference conditions for the school's scientific research incentive policies.

articleTitle: Research on POI Data System for External Breakdown Prediction of Distribution Network Based on Computer Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, an external fault location method of kernel POI data system is proposed. First, auxiliary operators are used to increase the likelihood of individuals in the group. The genotype is both male and female. This method greatly improves the optimization performance of this method. Then, an optimization method based on hierarchical process is proposed. First, the distribution network is partitioned. It is divided into multiple trunk lines and multiple partitions that are isolated from each other. Then this method is applied to determine the fault point of each individual partition. This algorithm reduce the size of the problem and speed up the search. Computer simulation method is feasible for the multi-point faults in distribution networks with distributed power supply. The results show the conventional genetic algorithm in stability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Management System for Building Intelligent Information Team of Talents in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduces a university personnel information management system based on service-oriented architecture access mode and cloud storage technology. Through the construction of the system architecture and database E- R diagram, the cloud storage and access of college human resource management are realized. It is well integrated with the current university human resource management model based on its mature business logic and data architecture. The system can not only solve the information requirements of the school staff, but also provide detailed information statistics for the school leaders to help them make scientific decisions.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Marketing Classification System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces some machine learning methods used in the field of data mining. The method of data mining is discussed by taking market segmentation algorithm as an example. This paper presents an improved support vector machine method. By judging the similarity between each sampling point and its closest class, the classifier is obtained by training it with support vector machine. A method based on stepwise approximation method is proposed to solve the problem of too large size of KNN training samples. The experimental results show that non-SVM is superior to SVM in classification accuracy and classification speed. In addition, this project will also adopt artificial intelligence technology to build a data analysis system for high-end wine, analyze, compare and match massive information data of high-end wine through data mining, and discover the comparison information and market potential of main ingredients in high-end wine. It is compared with the chemical composition of high-grade red wine, and the relevant marketing treatment of high-grade red wine is obtained. It can help high-grade red wine manufacturers to analyze the composition content and quality of high-grade red wine.

articleTitle: Analytical Study on the Optimization of Heliostat Field Layout Based on the Ray Tracing Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this study, we propose plausible models for the heliostat field configuration, apply ray tracing to map the sun's light paths, and explore how the heliostat's distance and the quantity of effective intersections impact the interplay of incident and reflected sunlight. Furthermore, we leverage this approach to correlate a single heliostat's optical performance to its cosine efficiency, shadow-blockage efficiency, atmospheric transmissivity, receiver aperture efficiency, and mirror reflectivity. This study presents a mathematical model which employs mechanism analysis and vector transformation to build upon the Campo and radial staggered configurations of fixed-sun mirror fields. And utilizing geometric relationships, the model formulates a single-objective nonlinear optimization framework aimed at maximizing the annual average thermal power output per unit area of the mirror. Finally, under the constraints of the mirror field boundary, a heuristic algorithm is used to iterate the parameters of the heliostat in each region in order to determine the optimal size and number of mirrors, and an optimisation strategy is given.

articleTitle: Research on Campus Digital Teaching System of Smart u Based on Data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the continuous development of data mining technology, the informatization level of colleges and universities is gradually improving. However, the traditional digital teaching system has many problems such as low utilization rate of data resources, non-sharing of information and data between systems, and it is difficult to meet the emerging new needs of colleges and universities. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the smart u campus digital teaching system based on data mining. Aiming at the problems of many links, serious information islands and low data utilization rate in traditional university teaching, this paper studies the smart u campus digital teaching system based on data mining. The core module of the system is the decision analysis module, which is based on the C4.5 algorithm framework, reduces the decision number of threshold points according to the Fayyad boundary point decision principle, and uses the equivalent infinitesimal principle to simplify the calculation of information entropy, overcoming the disadvantages of C4.5 algorithm. The module generates decision tree, generates classification rules through IF-THEN form, and realizes achievement prediction. The experimental data in this paper is the teaching data of a university. The experimental results show that the designed system can effectively realize data preprocessing, complete the learning effect prediction, provide personalized guidance for students, and realize the digital teaching work of smart u campus.

articleTitle: English Translation Model and System Design Based on Semantic Similarity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: An approximate mathematical expression is established by combining the synthetic semantics of English and Chinese languages. Integrating the semantic similarity of English and Chinese into the translation can effectively improve the quality of the translation. Firstly, the source text and the destination text are segmented by a distributed algorithm, and the corresponding phrase semantic vector is extracted. These features are mapped into the same semantic space by artificial neural network, and the comprehensive semantic vector of English and Chinese is obtained. An object-oriented similarity measurement model is constructed to realize semantic representation from lexical level to phrase level, and the relationship between source-end semantic vector and translation is realized by nonlinear mapping. The similarity of the original word and its corresponding phrase is measured according to the compound semantic vector. And we need to add it to the new feature. Compared with the standard system, the translation similarity model constructed by using English-Chinese composite semantics achieves a significant improvement of 0.36 and 0.25 in NIST06 and NIST08, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Recommendation System for E-Commerce Products Based on Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Research from aspects such as user consumption habits can help merchants better understand consumers' consumption needs. This article takes a large e-commerce website as the research object and analyzes user shopping behavior by studying shopping data over the past year. A hybrid recommendation model based on product recommendation and friend recommendation is proposed to achieve personalized recommendations for enterprise groups. This paper calculates the user's location similarity based on the user's location and the distance between locations, and then weights it with the user's interest similarity to obtain a new user similarity. This paper predicts the products that users are likely to purchase this month. Taking the fast-moving consumer goods e-commerce platform as an example, an empirical analysis of the proposed method was conducted. The performance of the algorithm was simulated using offline experiments. Experiments show that compared with the collaborative filtering method based on cosine similarity, the accuracy of this method can be 3.74% higher, and the recall rate reaches 3.91%. This method cannot only improve the user's selection efficiency, but also improve the performance of collaborative filtering.

articleTitle: Computer Virtual Reality Technology in 3D Digital Polymer Material Printing System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As a new advanced manufacturing method, 3D (Three Dimensional) printing technology has been widely used in industrial production because of its unique advantages. The rapid development of digital polymer materials has put forward higher-level requirements for virtual reality printing technology. In the actual production and processing process, the computer virtual environment will be used for process design and printing manufacturing. In order to solve the problems of traditional 3D printing such as edge warping, object skew, ripple shadows, and top layer scratches, this article uses digital polymer materials as printing materials, and uses virtual reality technology to analyze and adjust the process of the mechanical products to be printed, thereby improving product quality and reducing or avoiding common problems. After analyzing carbon fiber resin composite materials, this article describes its 3D printing molding process, and compares the performance of the strategy iteration algorithm and the learning algorithm based on simulated annealing through optimization experiments. This article discusses average cost, processing rate, waiting time, print usage and average quality. Experimental data shows that under the simulated annealing learning algorithm, the average cost is -1.84, the processing rate is 0.97, the average waiting time is 1.614, the printing space utilization is 0.752, and the average quality is 0.033.

articleTitle: Construction Method of Intelligent Analysis Rule Library for Monitoring Information Under Power Supply Reliability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to build a real-time intelligent analysis rule base of distribution network monitoring information, a construction method of intelligent analysis rule base of distribution network monitoring information based on machine learning is proposed. All the monitoring rule heads in the rule base are sorted and set as the main chain, and the rules are imported into the linked list to generate the rule set, so as to ensure that each monitoring information packet has an analysis rule; the machine learning based fault data classification method of distribution network is used to identify the fault data in the monitoring information of distribution network, and extract the frequent item sets of fault data. The parallel incremental updating algorithm of association rules based on MapReduce is used to update the information intelligent analysis rules in the analysis rule based, so as to ensure the real-time performance of the information intelligent analysis rules in the analysis rule base. The experimental results show that the accuracy and the average detection rate of the proposed method are greater than 0.97, and the false positive rate is 0.01. The proposed method can identify the real-time fault information of the distribution network monitoring system in time, and ensure the real-time updating of information intelligent analysis rules.

articleTitle: The Real-Time High-Voltage Switch Position Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This method discloses the real-time high-voltage switch position detection method, which is implemented in accordance with the following steps: installing a coms photoelectric sensor on the video acquisition unit, and installing the video acquisition unit at a specified position on the isolation switch housing; illuminating the inside of the isolation switch through LED devices in the switch detection device, and collecting the action video of the isolation switch as the raw video signal through the video acquisition unit. The video acquisition unit collects the action video of the isolating switch as the original video signal; the coms photoelectric sensor converts the light signal in the original video signal into an electric signal, and then sends the electric signal to the video server for processing to get the RGB spatial area image; the RGB spatial area image is transmitted to the on-line monitoring backstage system, and the movement trajectory of the high-voltage switch is judged through the LK optical flow method to get the actual position of the contacts. This detection method solves the hidden problem of GIS equipment operation and maintenance that the current GIS products need manual observation and the data cannot be transmitted to the background in real time.

articleTitle: Application Research of Differential Privacy Protection Mechanism for Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper first introduces the concept and challenges of privacy protection, as well as the definition and characteristics of differential privacy. Then, the measurement and analysis methods of differential privacy are discussed. Then, for cloud storage environment, a differential privacy protection mechanism based on data disturbance and query response disturbance is proposed, and the mechanism based on noise addition and data transformation, and the mechanism based on local sensitive hash, generalization and sampling are introduced in detail. Finally, the experiment is designed to provide an effective privacy protection mechanism for cloud storage platform to help users enj oy the convenience of cloud storage services and protect their privacy from being leaked.

articleTitle: Agricultural Machinery Tillage Area Calculation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Firstly, this paper analyzes the disadvantages of the current agricultural machine tillage area calculation algorithm, and finds some problems. In order to solve these problems, this paper presents a new rectangular analytic area estimation algorithm and applies it to the judgment of the replowed part of the trajectory. By using this algorithm, the accuracy of measuring area is greatly improved. There are some errors and inaccuracies in the traditional tillage area estimation algorithm. The rectangular analytic area calculation algorithm proposed in this paper is more accurate and precise in the calculation process. The algorithm can identify the actual area of the tillage area better by judging the replowing part of the track. Compared with the previous algorithms, the advantage of the rectangular analytic area measurement algorithm lies in its higher precision and accuracy. This method is expected to be widely used in the field of agricultural machine tillage, and provides a new idea for related research.

articleTitle: Platform Merchant Demand Prediction Based on Decision Tree and Multi-Layer Perceptron Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Under the background of platform merchant multidimensional demand prediction, there is the rise of the e-commerce industry and the development of the logistics industry, the need to accurately predict the supply chain demand, e-commerce platforms can effectively arrange logistics, inventory and other resources to improve operational efficiency and meet consumer demand. In this paper, we need to use historical data to predict the future demand for products using a time-series feature-based prediction model. Data preprocessing is performed first. In the next step, this paper trains four regression models, XGBoost [1], Random Forest [2], Decision Tree [3] [4], and Multi-Layer Perceptron Regression [5] [6], by using the first 90% of the data in the data table, and selects Decision Tree as the optimal regression model using the second 10% of the data in the data table, and the model has a better overall prediction effect using the 1-wmape as the criterion. Finally, this paper predicts the demand for each merchant's goods in each warehouse from 2023-05-16 to 2023-05-30. For the classification of time series formed by merchants, warehouses, and commodities, this paper determines the optimal number of clusters as 5 classes using the K-means clustering algorithm, and the same class of time series data has the most similar characteristics in terms of demand.

articleTitle: Multibeam Optimal Line Planning Based on Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Multibeam bathymetric system is an important technology in the field of ocean exploration, which expands the range of depth measurement and improves the efficiency by transmitting multiple acoustic beams at the same time. This paper mainly starts from the geometric relationship between the beams and the seabed slope, the relationship between the coverage width and the depth, and explores the optimal layout design of the survey line by using optimization methods such as planning model, differential iteration and particle swarm algorithm. Specifically, firstly, a planar coordinate system is established to model the coverage width, analyze the geometrical relationship between the coverage width, transducer opening angle and seawater depth, and finally construct the model about the transducer opening angle and seawater depth through the sinusoidal theorem and angle transformation. Then the three-plane two-coordinate system is established to construct the model between the coverage width and the direction of the measuring line. Finally, the model is improved to get the establishment of the optimal survey line laying model in general.

articleTitle: Research on Aerodynamic Layout System of Small UAV Based on Computer Intelligent Flight Control Software
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the one-click full-function detection scheme is adopted to realize the comprehensive test method of the flight control system. Firstly, the hardware design of interface board, power board, signal adjusting board and test board is completed based on 586 driver board. Then the layered software architecture is given. The method adopts the modular design idea and completes the task decomposition. Then the communication mode based on ORB is proposed, and the idea of state machine is used to deal with emergencies. The system has the functions of bottom drive, timing control, power-on control, current detection, function detection and so on. It can detect the flight control computer automatically according to the preset timing logic without human intervention. Four different test cases are presented. The results of computer simulation verify that the chosen test route is consistent with the real one. The experiment proves that the scheme can complete the reliability test of the system well.

articleTitle: Automatic Pricing and Replenishment Strategy for Vegetable Products Based on Time Series and NSGA-III Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the distribution pattern and interrelationship of the sales volume of each category and single product of vegetables, using the time series prediction model to forecast the cost and sales volume of different categories, using the Cook distance to analyze the outliers of the data. Setting up linear regression equations to fit the relationship between total sales volume and cost plus pricing of vegetables in each category, this paper establishes a nonlinear planning model of the time- series relationship, and gives the total daily replenishment volume and pricing strategy that makes the superstore benefit the most.

articleTitle: Construction of University Education Cloud Platform Server Based on Resource Sharing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: At present, the common single server site mode has limited storage space and slow access speed, which makes it difficult to realize resource sharing among universities. In order to realize the effective utilization of existing teaching resources, a cloud-based teaching resources management system is proposed. Then each function module of the system is analyzed in detail. The web page of JSP system is based on the server side of Linux system and is designed by Apache technology, creating an SQL Server database. The database contains user-specific statistical and analytical capabilities. The traditional stand-alone textbook reference platform has been upgraded. The results show that the system can be realized. The construction of college teaching resources is an important part of the information construction of college education and an important way to improve the quality of college education. The teaching resource management system of colleges and universities should include the functions of curriculum setting and curriculum evaluation to promote the information construction of higher education and improve the quality of education and teaching.

articleTitle: Design of On-Board Data Download and Application Platform of EMU Based on 5G
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The on-board data of EMU is the parameter information collected by the sensor during the operation of EMU, which plays an important role in evaluating the operating state of EMU and analyzing the cause of fault in depth. By analyzing the situation of vehicle data and combining the characteristics of 5G technology, this paper puts forward a method of vehicle data download based on 5G, designs an EMU vehicle data download and application platform, and adopts key technologies such as massive data processing and monitoring, batch efficient data analysis and large amount of data storage. To achieve vehicle data collection and transmission, data monitoring, data analysis, data sharing and comprehensive display and other functions. The realization of the platform is helpful to further promote the application of on-board data of EMU, which is of great significance to promote the fault analysis of EMU and the application of state evaluation and prediction.

articleTitle: Key Feature Recognition Algorithm for Energy Meters under Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: During the inspection process, a large number of massive images of power equipment would be generated. Therefore, the first problem to be solved is how to extract effective data for acceptance and operation management of power equipment more accurately and efficiently. The research purpose of this article is to use Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and image recognition technology, and on the basis of investigating and analyzing the current application status of energy meter processing processes. It provides a new targeted image recognition scheme for electricity meters, which can achieve the recognition of electricity meter photography, barcode and reading, as well as the verification and storage of electricity meter information. This article conducts color image grayscale processing, image enhancement, binarization processing, image recognition area positioning, and selection of light sources for electric energy meters. The image recognition area positioning includes the positioning of the electricity meter barcode area and the positioning of the electricity meter barcode area. The recognition rate of the CNN for the entire instrument can reach 98.5%. Among them, the barcode recognition rate can reach 97.8%, and the recognition rate of the bottom reading of the electricity meter can reach 99.2%. This article helps to reduce errors caused by human factors and is of great significance for achieving the intelligence of electricity meters.

articleTitle: Reliability Testing Technology and Equiment for Interconnection between PCB and Chips
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Solder joints are the nodes connecting circuit boards and chips, as well as ensuring the normal operation of electrical signals and circuit functions, and their importance is self-evident. This article mentions an electronic device that can be used to monitor the interconnection and health status of pins in circuits. The device implant lightweight diagnostic logic and test auxiliary circuits into the monitored object base FPGA. It uses the impedance characteristics introduced by solder joint failure to perform signal transformation, real-time monitoring and capture of solder joint faults are carried out, raw data are sent to acquisition terminal. The acquisition terminal analyzes, fits, and predicts the trend of feature data changes, achieving early identification and warning. This technology and equipment can be applied in testing tracking or random analysis warning of major equipment or devices.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Art Assistant Teaching System Based on IOS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The system is developed for the convenience of users. Online teaching system is based on IOS platform development environment. It can provide rich and diverse information resource sharing functions and interactive functions. This paper aims at the design and development of the IOS-based art assisted teaching system. After studying and analyzing the system requirements, functional modules, and using Java language to model the data, the results are obtained. This paper mainly uses the methods of experiment and comparison to analyze the teaching quality and system performance. The experimental data shows that the response time of the system designed in this paper is within 10s, when the number of concurrency exceeds 500, and it can still meet the basic requirements.

articleTitle: Surveillance Information Processing Strategy of Distribution Network Under Power Supply Reliability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to solve problems of computer delay and low information batch storage load of the intelligent distribution network system, a machine learning-based distribution network monitoring information batch processing method is proposed. The method uses the HDFS distributed file system to measure the data transmission records, builds the distribution network monitoring information scheduling cluster, measure the latency of the computer system, and fills system delay time with the data response task. It plans the processing mode of the monitoring information interface, divides the large-scale flow calculation of machine learning, and builds the monitoring information batch processing model. It increases and counts the information batch accumulation nodes, and expands the distribution network to develop the learning path of intelligent analysis machine through the cloud computing service level. It calculates the telemetry information and effective event information, plans the layout of telemetry coordination nodes through HDFS. It divides the storage space of monitoring information, monitors the storage space with remote control metabase, and completes the batch processing and storage of accumulation V002 distribution network monitoring information with the manager. The experimental results show that the highest storage load rate of the information cluster processing is 95%, and the batch processing effect of the distribution network monitoring information is guaranteed.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Wind Energy Resources on Electric Power and Wireless Communication Shared Towers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As a type of clean energy, the evaluation of wind energy resources is crucial for the multidimensional development of energy, environmental protection, and economy. As a facility for sharing power and wireless communication, the shared tower has multiple advantages in wind energy resource assessment. This article compares the RMSE (Root Mean Square Error) evaluation mode based on power and wireless communication shared tower with the MCP (Measure-correlated-prediction) evaluation mode. In the end, it reached the following conclusion: in MCP mode, it is 2.06 m/s, and in shared tower mode, it is 1.97 m/s. The shared tower mode undoubtedly has lower RMSE and higher evaluation accuracy. Therefore, this study found that the power and wireless communication shared tower model has sufficient advantages for evaluating wind energy resources.

articleTitle: Prediction of Power Material Demand with Small Samples Based on a Combination Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In current, the high demands of power from various industries require power companies to manage power materials efficiently. Optimizing resource allocation is crucial for effective procurement planning and cost reduction. To this end, we propose, in this paper, a combination model to accurately predict the material demand in case of small samples provided by an electric power company. At first, three independent models were used to predict demand for four materials. Then the deviation comparison was carried out to determine the most reliable model. To further enhance the accuracy and dependability of material demand prediction, we combine the three independent models to generate a combination model, which outperforms the independent models. By using scientific material demand prediction, power enterprises can better understand the needs of the power market and make better procurement planning.

articleTitle: Design of English-Chinese Translation System Based on User Feature Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper designs the network structure of E-C translation and establishes the semantic map of E-C translation. The clustering and attribute judgment are carried out to complete the establishment of feature extraction algorithm for English-Chinese translation. The software flow includes the underlying database module, the iot control protocol module, the cross-compilation module and the output interface module of translation and conversion. An information processing method based on network environment is proposed. The automatic switching system between English and Chinese machines is realized by using bus automatic control and bottom adaption technology. The experimental results show that the overall translation accuracy of this method has been significantly improved, and it shows good stability and good convergence performance in terms of improving efficiency. Its comprehensive performance can meet the design requirements of effectiveness, and can effectively solve the problems of low accuracy and success rate of electronic translation in E-C mutual translation.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent high air anti-fall device based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the improvement of safety requirements of high altitude operation, the research and development of efficient anti-fall devices has become an important task in the industrial field. In this paper, an intelligent high-altitude antifall device based on neural network is proposed to improve the safety and efficiency of high-altitude operation. First, we use convolutional neural networks (CNN) and Secret sharing (SS) techniques to train and model operator behavior patterns. By analyzing and learning from key patterns and trends in the data, our systems are able to monitor the operator's status in real time, predict potential fall risks, and take timely protective measures. In addition, we introduce a new neural network model, the Secret Neural Model (CNS), by combining the above two techniques and improving them. The new model not only enhances the adaptability and response speed of the anti-fall device in the complex environment, but also greatly reduces the fall accident and cost. Through a series of experiments and performance evaluation, we prove the effectiveness of the intelligent high air fall prevention device in improving the safety of working at altitude. The experimental results show that the neural network-based system can not only effectively prevent fall accidents, but also reduce false positives through intelligent adjustment, thus reducing the overall operating cost. This research provides new technical support for the safety of working at altitude, and has important practical application value for promoting industrial safety production and preventing the risk of working at altitude.

articleTitle: Research on Sports Competition Result Prediction System Based on Computer Big Data Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Using big data theory to analyze athletes' performance data, this paper finds out the changing characteristics of athletes' performance. Using the principle of big data, we find the performance characteristics of athletes in the training process. The particle swarm optimization (PSO) method is used to predict the network parameters of support vector machine (SVM) online. The validity of this method is verified by testing on college students. This method can track athletes' performance characteristics more accurately, so as to build an excellent sports performance prediction model. The model can detect future trends from athletes' performance data in data mining and machine learning. This kind of system has a wide application prospect, and can greatly improve the efficiency and quality. The method combines machine learning theory with support vector machine network, which can effectively improve the prediction accuracy. This method has a very broad application prospect.

articleTitle: Analysis and Suppression of AC Faults in Receiving-End of Hybrid Cascaded Multi-Terminal HVDC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Hybrid Cascaded Multi-Terminal HVDC (HC-MTDC) combines the advantages of Line Commutated Converters (LCC) and Modular Multilevel Converters (MMC). However, the coupling between LCC and MMC on the AC/DC side also brings new challenges. Additionally, the transient recovery characteristics after receiving-end AC grid faults adversely affect the DC fault clearance capability. Therefore, this paper analyzes the impact and coupling effects of AC faults on the LCC side and MMC side when they occur at the receiving end. It explains the mechanism of DC overvoltage generation. A suppression strategy is proposed to reduce the risk of controllable surge arrester exceeding its energy limit in HC-MTDC. An electromechanical-electromagnetic transient hybrid simulation model is constructed to validate the correctness of the mechanism analysis in this paper and the effectiveness of the suppression strategy.

articleTitle: Simulation of Structured Natural Language Algorithm on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: From the sentiment analysis of social media to the monitoring of public opinion in the financial field, the application of natural language analysis continues to expand, and people's demand for natural language processing technology is also increasing. However, traditional natural language analysis algorithms face performance bottlenecks and energy consumption. Therefore, this paper proposes a structured natural language analysis algorithm based on cloud computing. Through simulation experiments, the performance and energy consumption of the algorithm are tested and evaluated. After a comprehensive experimental scheme design, the experimental group is compared with the control group by selecting the appropriate data set and establishing appropriate evaluation indicators, while configuring the experimental environment. The experimental results show that the lowest energy consumption of the algorithm in this paper is 2.41%, and the structured natural language analysis algorithm based on cloud computing has obvious advantages over traditional methods. The proportion of energy consumption in the experimental group is lower than that of the control group, indicating that the algorithm of the experimental group is better in terms of energy utilization efficiency. The performance degradation of the experimental group is lower when processing large-scale data, indicating that the experimental group algorithm has better extensibility and efficiency. These results provide strong support for the application of structured natural language analysis algorithms based on cloud computing, which helps to improve system efficiency and sustainability.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Modal Artificial Intelligence Information Fusion Technology in Embedded Computer Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Multi-scale decomposition (MSD) has some problems, such as missing details and generating noise. This project aims to study multi-modal image based on texture decomposition model and using improved convolutional network and phase-shift consistency techniques. Aiming at the problem that MSD is easy to produce noise, low-pass filter optimization function and structure texture decomposition model are introduced to effectively solve the problem of decomposition technology. An adaptive filtering algorithm based on least square method is proposed, and the structure-texture analysis method based on image is combined to overcome the noise problem of traditional algorithms theoretically. Secondly, for structured texture, the fusion algorithm of convolutional neural network and Gaussian fairing is studied to enhance the effective acquisition of image details and remove noise. The phase-shift matching algorithm is used for high frequency band to achieve effective fusion of high frequency signals. Then the inversion is carried out to obtain the final composite image. The images are studied qualitatively and quantitatively from the perspectives of visual effect, mutual information, feature mutual information, structural similarity, information entropy, PSNR, etc.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Recommendation Algorithm of Online Learning Platform Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As science and technology continue to advance, artificial intelligence technology is progressively being applied in diverse fields, among which the development of online learning platform has become a convenient way for people to obtain knowledge. With the theme of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${}^{\prime}$</tex> Research on Intelligent Recommendation Algorithm of online learning Platform based on Artificial Intelligence <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${}^{\prime\prime}$</tex>, this research is devoted to explore how to improve the user experience of online learning platform through advanced artificial intelligence technology. With the popularity of online learning, the problems of information overload and difficulty in course selection are becoming more and more prominent. In order to solve this problem, we introduce intelligent recommendation algorithm, which aims to provide personalized and efficient learning resource recommendation for each learner through the powerful learning and analysis ability of artificial intelligence. The core idea of this research is to comprehensively analyze learners' historical learning behavior, interest preference and subject level through artificial intelligence technologies such as deep learning and data mining. Based on this information, we built an intelligent recommendation system that can accurately predict the needs of learners and recommend the courses, textbooks and learning resources that best fit the personalized learning trajectory. In our research, we employ advanced algorithms such as deep neural networks to model and train large amounts of learning data. Through these algorithms, we can dig out the potential learning patterns and rules, and tailor the most suitable learning path for each learner. The research results show that the intelligent recommendation algorithm of online learning platform based on artificial intelligence has achieved remarkable results in improving the recommendation accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Pipeline Optimization System Combining Mathematical Modeling and Visual Inspection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of large-scale production lines, a machine vision inspection system with inner and outer dimensions was developed. High precision detection of workpiece boundary based on polynomial interpolation algorithm is studied, and rapid and accurate extraction of inner and outer diameter of product image is realized by re-filtering after sharp. Experiments show that the method has the advantages of no contact, on-line real-time, fast speed and high precision. It has good field anti-jamming ability and can achieve the purpose of no waste manufacturing.

articleTitle: Research on Network Management System of University Human Resources Based on Computer Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the business process of university personnel information management system. Then, based on the university cloud platform, combined with big data, combined with business services and diversified business services, the university personnel management system was established. Based on Microsoft Biztalk server, this system builds a new type of university human resource management system. Taking Microsoft Biztalk Server as an example, a service mode based on Biztalk server is proposed to solve the problems existing in the current university personnel work. To solve this problem, an optimization method based on genetic algorithm is proposed. On this basis, a new intelligent sorting algorithm is proposed. Compared with the existing algorithm, this algorithm saves 7.261s operation time. The algorithm is implemented on Biztalk server and its validity is verified. By experimental test, compared with the existing algorithms, the proposed optimization method can shorten the inference time. In this study, the optimization method based on genetic algorithm is used to optimize Biztalk server. Experimental results show that the running time of the algorithm is shorter. This has a certain reference significance for the design of Biztalk server. This method can effectively reduce the manual allocation task in the big data environment. The thesis has certain reference significance for promoting the informatization construction of school personnel work.

articleTitle: SGBCD: A Data Discretization Algorithm Based on Granular-ball Computing and Attribute Significance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As an important method in data preprocessing, discretization can effectively reduce the size of data, generate concise semantic representation, obtain valuable knowledge and information contained in big data, which is of great significance in the fields of data mining and machine learning. Nevertheless, most of the traditional discretization algorithms don't consider the distribution of sample and difficulty in setting parameters during interval partitioning, which leads to a decrease in efficiency and classification accuracy. A data discretization algorithm based on granular-ball computing and attribute significance is proposed in this paper, which is a multi-granularity method. Firstly, by introducing the granular-ball computing, the difficulty of parameter optimization is reduced and the efficiency of the algorithm is improved. At the same time, interval partitioning adaptively fits the original data distribution, reducing the occurrence of uneven interval partitioning and improving classification accuracy. Then, the randomness of attribute selection leads to instability in interval partitioning results. By introducing attribute significance and prioritizing the selection of attributes with high importance, this paper further improves the classification accuracy. Compared to other excellent discretization algorithms in the experiments, the proposed algorithm shows an ideal performance.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Digital Information System Under Computer Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper studies and designs the digital management system of intelligent building. In this paper, a fusion application method of digital twin and intelligent building system integration is proposed. By collecting building information, weak current information and safety information inside the building, the real building entity digital model is established. According to the needs of the whole life cycle of the construction project, the corresponding simulation and demonstration models are established. A 3D visualization modeling method based on BIM is proposed and applied to the hardware and software of construction equipment. It can meet the integration needs of multiple devices, and can be used for intelligent applications of a single device. The system monitors and centrally manages all the facilities in the building. Then several important links such as management and business process are comprehensively collected and controlled, making it a unified, intensive and efficient information management system. The system can effectively improve the efficiency and quality of equipment operation, reduce energy consumption and maintenance costs. The experimental results prove the correctness and practicability of this scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Image Art Creation System of Integrated 3D Computer Image Vision Digital Media
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The accuracy and real-time performance of existing image labeling algorithms are not high. This project intends to study the video sequence feature labeling algorithm for digital multimedia images. A digital multimedia image segmentation method based on wavelet transform is proposed. Then the system adopts the color video segmentation method based on edge detection. Based on visual salience features, the model combines color features and gradient features to describe local image quality. The method fuses the brightness channels of the reference image and the corresponding distorted image, and calculates the similarity between the gradient map of the channel and the gradient map of the reference/distorted image. Target detection is realized by matching the target image with the gray information. Then the color feature and gradient feature are combined organically by means of the mean offset weight method, and a better image quality evaluation effect is obtained. The performance of many evaluation algorithms and has some advantages compared with the existing evaluation methods.

articleTitle: Study on Control Scheme of Isolation Valve for Containment Ventilation System in Nuclear Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The containment isolation valve of containment ventilation system in nuclear power plant is the key equipment to avoid the release of radioactivity substances. In the process from pneumatic valve to electric valve, some problems are faced. This paper puts forward two control strategies with different motor action mechanism according to the principle of valve. Based on analyzing and evaluating the control schemes, the reasonable and feasible implementation schemes for the future control mode of containment isolation valve is offered in this paper. It also provides ideas for product design and control interface design.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Efficient Mesh Networking Algorithm in Wireless Communication of Power Supply Station Area
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, there are many researches and applications on establishing wireless network monitoring around the private network of power supply station area, but most wireless communication methods transmit a small amount of data.
