In this paper, mesh networking is the core, and it is studied and analyzed. On this basis, combined with the changing law of service characteristics and network delay characteristics, the network performance of single and dual-frequency networks in mesh networking structure is studied, which provides a theoretical basis for the research of network design, and the efficient mesh networking mode in wireless communication in power supply area is adjusted accordingly with the changes of environment and load, thus constructing an ideal mesh network scheme. In the throughput of Mesh cluster, the throughput of Mesh Device A is twice that of single AP.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization Analysis of a Certain Type of Centrifugal Aviation Compressor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article conducts research on the overall design, data simulation, and multidisciplinary coupling analysis of a centrifugal aviation compressor based on the demand for performance optimization. Firstly, by analyzing and summarizing the previous research results, the basic structure and working principle of centrifugal compressors were clarified, and the research objectives and methods of this article were determined. Subsequently, based on the requirements and comparative analysis of various performance indicators, the overall design of the compressor size, number of blades, blade clearance, etc. was carried out. This article is based on the Vista CCD software in Workbench for preliminary blade design and performance analysis, and has designed a set of centrifugal compressor schemes. Based on this, data simulation considering various coupling factors has been conducted, and the design points of the designed centrifugal impeller have been simulated and calculated using CFX flow field analysis software. The simulation of pressure field changes, velocity field changes, and temperature distribution in various regions during the rotation process of compressor components lays the foundation for subsequent optimization. Finally, through the analysis and comparison of simulation results, the performance of the compressor was optimized, resulting in a certain improvement in the performance of the compressor. The research results of this article have certain engineering practical value and universality, and have certain reference significance for improving the performance and application level of centrifugal compressors.

articleTitle: Mechanical equipment fault identification based on machine learning algorithm under unbalanced data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at the fault diagnosis of mechanical equipment under category imbalance, a combined model XGBoost-SMOTEENN-Decision Tree was constructed to identify mechanical equipment faults. Firstly, SMOTEENN algorithm is used to deal with the unbalanced distribution of “normal operation” and “fault” samples in mechanical equipment data; Secondly, the Decision Tree algorithm is used to evaluate the importance of features. Then we compare the three machine learning models XGBoost, AdaBoost and Random Forest by accuracy, precision, recall and F1 value model performance evaluation index, and find that XGBoost model has more significant classification ability, stronger generalization ability, and is more suitable for mechanical equipment fault diagnosis. Finally, the optimal classification model XGBoost is used to compare the classification effect before and after data balancing treatment, and it is found that the fault identification effect of mechanical equipment is better after data balancing treatment.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Information System of Automotive Investment and Financing Platform Industry Chain Based on Computer Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper builds a large-scale automobile industry chain financing platform with independent intellectual property rights. The paper is to construct a collaborative investment and financing model of automobile industry chain based on dynamic alliance. In order to enhance the portability and maintainability of software, a five-level architecture is proposed. This platform can complete and support the business collaboration of the whole industry and provide a good model for its management and construction. A mathematical model of optimal matching between investment and financing platform is constructed by using linear programming and weight scoring method based on greedy algorithm. This model can not only ensure that both investors meet the matching needs, but also improve the operability and effectiveness of investment decisions. According to the enterprise dynamic alliance architecture, this paper studies and develops it. This paper designs and implements a platform management system based on dynamic alliance organization structure. The system is developed and rented by enterprise alliance structure. It can set up a good reference model for the construction and operation of financing platform in the automobile industry.

articleTitle: Research on Mission Simulation and Deduction Techniques Based on Target Posture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Various types of land, air, surface and underwater targets are set up according to different experimental test scenarios, and typical target attitudes are formed based on the course of action and motion parameters. The attitude and its related information are simulated in real time to generate the attitude excitation. At the same time, platform-level device control simulation in a real environment is performed to simulate the target's manoeuvre characteristics, generate route and action parameter information for the platform-level target, and quickly derive a software mission plan based on the latest posture. Finally, the software mission capability is analysed and evaluated based on the derivation process and results.

articleTitle: The Algorithm and System for Habitability Assessment of Emergency Facilities of Nuclear Power Plants in Case of Accidents
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The emergency facilities of a nuclear power plant refer to the facilities used for emergency response purpose. According to relevant documents, the habitability of emergency facilities should be evaluated for nuclear power plant. According to relevant documents, the habitability of emergency facilities should be evaluated for nuclear power plant in the design and safety analysis stage. The existing model and method provide the results of habitability assessment of emergency facility from a probability theory perspective, based on conservative meteorological conditions and other input data. It cannot be applied to actual accident scenarios. This paper proposes a complete set of method for habitability assessment of emergency facilities of nuclear power plant in case of nuclear accidents, and then designs and implements a software system based on it. The feedback from application indicates that the method and system fill the gap in this field, effectively improving the level and efficiency of emergency decision-making.

articleTitle: Enhanced Employee Training Classification Model Using Optimized-HHO Probability Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Prominence has been given to Probabilistic Neural Networks (PNN) due to their proficiency in modeling intricate patterns and dependencies across diverse datasets. However, challenges such as slow convergence and susceptibility to local optima underscore the need for PNN optimization. This study focuses on elevating the efficiency and accuracy of PNN through the application of the Harris Hawk Optimization (HHO) algorithm. An Optimized-HHO approach is introduced to leverage global search capabilities while mitigating pitfalls of traditional HHO algorithms. This optimization process involves a fusion of the Golden Sinusoidal optimization algorithm during the exploration phase and a non-linear exponential decay strategy, enhancing global and local adaptability. The robust capabilities of Optimized-HHO are harnessed to refine the PNN's smoothing factor, achieving superior convergence precision. The paper presents an exploration of the construction and optimization methodology of the Probabilistic Neural Network using the Optimized-HHO algorithm (Optimized-HHO-PNN). Finally, application of Optimized-HHO-PNN to employee training needs classification is presented as a case study to highlight its practical utility and effectiveness. This research contributes to broader understanding of enhancing PNN performance through optimization techniques, with potential applications in various real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Load State Prediction of Host Servers Based on Nonlinear Time Series
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A host server load state prediction algorithm based on nonlinear time series analysis and vector space reconstruction is proposed. The load state of the host server is analyzed discretized by the phase randomization method and decomposed into a statistic containing several nonlinear components. The delay is obtained by using autocorrelation function method in vector space reconstruction. A vector space reconstruction of load state based on mutual information minimum embedding dimension is proposed. By extracting the high-order spectral characteristics of the load in the high-dimensional vector space, the network service is accurately predicted. Simulation experiments show that the proposed method can adapt to the nonlinear characteristics of traffic flow well, and can track the change of network traffic condition better, and its prediction error is lower than that of the traditional method.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperative Control Method of Large Flexible Attachment and Spacecraft Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of large disturbance of large flexible accessories and large error of platform attitude control when the large flexible accessories and spacecraft platform maneuver at the same time, a collaborative control method based on feedforward compensation and interference constraint is proposed. The accessory pointing control and platform attitude control are designed for bandwidth isolation, and appropriate feedforward compensation is added to reduce mutual influence and establish mutual interference constraint conditions. The polynomial trajectory planning design greatly improves the control accuracy during maneuvering. To solve the problem of large amplitude and slow attenuation of flexible attachments during rate damping, a rate damping control method based on input molding is proposed. The amplitude of the attachment approaches zero at the end of the rate damping. The mathematical simulation results show that the cooperative control method based on feedforward compensation and interference constraint can effectively improve the attitude control accuracy and the pointing accuracy of flexible accessories during maneuvering. The algorithm is simple and suitable for on-orbit real-time calculation of satellite-borne computer, and has important engineering application value.

articleTitle: Software Technology Immersive Education Research and Practice Based on Spark Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: From the perspective of education informatization, a teaching resource sharing system with huge storage space and computation amount is established. When the user accesses the teaching materials, it constructs the database with a large number of users through instant access to the data. This project intends to study an optimization scheme that does not require any intermediary output based on Hadoop and combined with Spark's parallel computing mode, so that it can make better use of Spark's iterative computing capability. It realizes the efficient recommendation of teaching resources. A hierarchical resource model based on collaborative filtering is proposed. The unrated resources predicted in this way are imprecise. A time function is added to the prediction process for non-rated resources to reflect the change in user interest over time. The index function is used to describe the change of time. The practicability of the Spark-based in the recommendation of teaching resources are verified by the research.

articleTitle: Multibeam Measurement Line Model Based on Computational Geometry and Objective Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A multi-beam sounding system is an essential technology in ocean exploration, which expands the range of measurement depth and improves efficiency by transmitting multiple acoustic beams simultaneously. This paper, starting from the relevant theory, analyzes the geometric characteristics of multi-beam sounding and gives the calculation method of the coverage width of multi-beam sounding and the overlap rate of adjacent bands in various sea areas to optimize the line design and ensure the efficient acquisition of seawater depth data. Specifically, this paper first uses the geometric analysis of measuring lines on two-dimensional and three-dimensional space and seabed slope mathematical model, then considers the irregular sea reality, using the Newton-paper method, based on sounding data line design, to minimize the total length and adjacent strip overlap rate and maximize the sea area.

articleTitle: Research on DC Motor Speed Control System Based on Double Closed-Loop Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: DC motors have the advantages of reversibility, large speed range, small static difference, good speed smoothness, small dynamic speed landing, and fast starting and braking, which are widely used in modern industry. However, with the continuous improvement of the requirements of DC motor speed control system, so more advanced DC motor speed control system needs to be further studied. This paper firstly explains the working principle of DC motor and derives the model equations; secondly, an improved DC speed control system with double closed-loop speed-current control is proposed, and its static and dynamic characteristics are analysed; finally, the main circuit model and control circuit model of the system are established based on the simulation platform, and the current and voltage of the armature, the speed of the motor, and electromagnetic torque are analysed, and good control results are achieved, and a good control effect was achieved.

articleTitle: The Design and Research of Collaborative Robots Based on Solidworks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the investigation and summary of the performance parameters of mainstream collaborative robots in the market at home and abroad, the performance indicators and design principles were formulated according to the functional requirements of man-machine collaboration scenarios in the field of light industry. The configuration analysis was carried out with the method of “arm-wrist separation”, and the three-dimensional design software Solidworks was used to select and design each component. Finally, a six degree of freedom collaborative robot model similar to UR is assembled. Through the analysis of the virtual prototype technology parameters such as mass, center of gravity, on this basis, a selection method of joint structure and transmission system based on the modular concept was proposed, and the selection and strength check of key components such as motors and reducers were completed. And the Finite Element Analysis software is used to verify and analyze the rationality of the material and structure of the body, and complete the system design of the mechanical part of the cooperative robot.

articleTitle: PV Generation Prediction Based on EEMD-IWOA-LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The power of photovoltaic (PV) is related to many factors, and power prediction is of vital significance to maintain the stable operation of the power system. A prediction model of PV power based on EEMD-IWOA-LSTM model is proposed herein. EEMD decomposition is used to decompose the historical power generation, and various factors such as wind speed and IMF component obtained by plate temperature decomposition are used as prediction dimensions to train the LSTM network. Meanwhile, the parameters are optimized by an improved whale optimization algorithm. We pick the best model. The model comparison results show that the prediction accuracy of power generation is improved by about 20%.

articleTitle: Modeling and Solving of Seafloor Terrain Detection Based on Multibeam Bathymetry
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Multibeam bathymetry, as an advanced method of ocean topographic sounding with higher measurement accuracy and efficiency, is able to overcome the limitations of traditional methods and offers new possibilities for research and application in the field of marine science and engineering. The development of this technology will further promote the accuracy and comprehensiveness of marine topographic exploration and provide strong support for the development and application of marine-related fields. In this paper, the coverage width W of the strip is first defined as the spacing between the intersection points of the two beams at the edge of the strip and the seafloor surface multiplied by the slope cosine value. Any position is taken, and the mathematical model of the coverage width W is deduced by plane geometry based on the water depth D, the transducer opening angle θ, and the slope a at this time. Finally, according to the established model of overlap rate and coverage width, and the formula for calculating the seabed depth, the water depth of 64.76m, coverage width of 224.81m, and the overlap rate with the previous line of 14 % are obtained at +200m from the center point. Then, the spatial coordinate system was established, and the analytical equation of the associated slope and the analytical equation of the cone formed by the bathymetric beam were obtained to acquire the analytical equation of the ellipse formed by the oblique intercept cone of the seafloor slope. Then solve the analytical equation of the survey line projection in the spatial coordinate system. Then a plane rectangular coordinate system on the slope surface is established, and the ellipse and the analytical equation of the projection are transformed into space rectangular, which coordinates to obtain the analytical equation of the two in the plane. A calculation results in a coverage width of 451.43 when the distance of the survey vessel from the center of the sea is 0.3 nautical miles and the angle of the direction of the survey line is 45.

articleTitle: Aspect Target Sentiment Classification with Instance Retrieval-Based Prompt Template Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aspect Target Sentiment Classification (ATSC) aims to predict the sentiment polarity of a sentence's specific aspect terms. Fine-tuned pre-trained language models (PLMs) that achieve excellent results in ATSC typically use a large amount of training data from the same domain. However, annotation is a costly task. To address this issue, we propose a retrieval-based instance-level prompt template selection method that better solves the ATSC problem through natural language prompts. This method uses an external retrieval source to measure the quality of prompt templates and performs the prompt template selection task as a sentence correctness judgment process. To avoid deviating from the real low-resource scenario, we use a large language model to generate a pseudo-label dataset as the external retrieval source for our method. Our experiment shows that, in the zero-shot setting, our method outperforms the baseline prompt method by 8.21 % in accuracy and 9.68% in macro-Fl. In the few-shot setting, our method also significantly surpasses it. In addition, we also demonstrate that our method can solve cross-domain data issues.

articleTitle: Integrated Testing System for Substation Relay Protection Devices Based on Cloud Date Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the expansion of the power grid, the number of secondary equipment in intelligent substations has significantly increased. We should put forward higher requirements for the quality and speed of equipment testing and maintenance. In response to the lack of integrated testing methods for cross bay equipment in intelligent substations, and the existence of missed, over checked, and blind inspections in the maintenance for protective devices, we have built an integrated testing system for secondary equipment in substations based on cloud data interaction, and adopted an intelligent substation integrated testing method based on cloud data interaction to achieve integrated testing of cross bay equipment in intelligent substations.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Ant colony algorithm was proposed by Marco Dorigo in his doctoral thesis in 1992, inspired by the behavior of ant colonies discovering paths while searching for food. In the process of studying ant foraging, ants release a substance called “pheromone” along their path. Ants in the ant colony have the ability to perceive “pheromone” and walk along paths with higher concentrations of “pheromone”. Each passing ant leaves behind “pheromone” on the road, forming a mechanism similar to positive feedback. The entire ant colony will follow the shortest path to reach the food source.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling in Employee Satisfaction: An Approach with RA-SSA-SVM-Based Machine Learning Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper presents RA-SSA-SVM, an innovative optimization framework for Support Vector Machines (SVM), addressing challenges in determining optimal parameter values, including the penalty parameter and the kernel function. Leveraging the Sea Squirt Algorithm (SSA) for global and local search, RA-SSA-SVM mitigates issues associated with conventional parameter tuning methods. The proposed RA-SSA algorithm, incorporating reflected backward learning and an adaptive control factor, prevents algorithmic stagnation in latestage SSA searches. Applied to an enterprise's regression prediction of employee satisfaction, the RA-SSA-SVM demonstrates enhanced convergence accuracy compared to traditional SSA. This research contributes to machine learning field by providing a solution to SVM parameter selection, emphasizing improved predictive modeling performance.

articleTitle: A Predictive Method for Enterprise Market Competitiveness using LR-GWO-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative approach to enhance the predictive accuracy of BP Neural Network. Leveraging the Grey Wolf Optimization algorithm, the proposed methodology refines the initial weights and thresholds of the BP Neural Network, addressing traditional GWO limitations. To overcome diminishing accuracy issues during iterations, the LR-GWO algorithm is introduced, featuring a segmented adjustable decay factor and a probability-based selection mechanism for leadership-level grey wolves. This strategic enhancement significantly strengthens the algorithm's global and local optimization capabilities. In practical application, the LR-GWO-BP neural network proves effective in predicting market competitiveness within enterprises. Experimental results demonstrate a consistent reduction in overall error, highlighting the potential of this novel approach in transforming predictive modeling within enterprises. The combination of BP Neural Networks with the optimized LRGWO algorithm emerges as a solution for predictive modeling.

articleTitle: Attention Mechanism Feature Fusion for Bearing Fault Diagnosis in Noise Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Rotating machinery is a crucial component and plays a vital role in ensuring system safety and stability. Fault diagnosis in such systems can be challenging due to environmental noise. Previous research has effectively improved fault diagnosis performance in noisy environments by enhancing the quality of feature representations. This paper introduces an innovative approach for fault diagnosis, named Attention Mechanism Feature Fusion (AMFF), employing an attention mechanism to construct two distinct features. These features, namely Mel-frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs) and Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), respectively capture time-evolving spectral characteristics and frequency-domain data. The channel-spatial attention mechanism highlights salient features, minimizes redundant information, and thereby mitigates the noise impact. The method can effectively extract high-quality features and maintaining precise classification performance in noisy environments, as demonstrated through experimental validation. This study has far-reaching implications for improving diagnostic capabilities in noisy environments and providing potential for numerous industrial applications.

articleTitle: Study on Marine Information Model Under Marine Ecological Technology of Computer Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper proposes a socket transmission mechanism, message mechanism and completion port mechanism based on multithreading. Then the system designs a network based Marine observation data transmission technology scheme. The scheme has many functions such as transmission service management, file discovery, standardized storage, file sending and receiving, state acquisition, etc. This project will provide a new networking mode for the newly increased Marine monitoring stations in China's sea area. So that the sea area monitoring data in China's sea area can be multi-level and multi-level real-time inquiry and transmission. The simulation test shows that users can access and browse at any time and any place on different platforms.

articleTitle: Research on Learning Terminal System for English Teaching Practice in Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper is mainly for the English test terminal research and development. It has realized the functions of question bank, examination, examination statistics and so on. The main feature of the system is that the whole process of using cryptography and digital signature technology, the paper generation process and the content of the examination questions are more fully processed, and also provides a safe and flexible authorized access control mechanism, a complete function of dynamic query and statistical analysis, intelligent paper design. It converts speech recognition and English into Chinese intonation, and designs and develops English translation system at the same time. The deviation between the basic frequency curve of the established tone system and the original sound is only 0.02, and the basic frequency curve is very close. This method can obtain good speech production results, and the generated sounds are diversified and accurate. The CPU usage of this system is 27.8%. Compared with the mobile terminal system and the WEB system, the CPU usage decreased by 19.0%.

articleTitle: Application Research on Automatic Mapping of Distribution Networks Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To solve the problem of automatic mapping of single line diagrams in distribution networks, a large amount of manual adjustment is required to meet practical requirements. This article is based on automatic mapping of a distribution network in Yunnan. The system introduces machine learning technology from the big data Spark framework to the single line graph layout algorithm, and conducts application research. Firstly, this paper introduces the automatic mapping system's Technical architecture, explaining the application environment of machine learning technology, proposing the construction of a decision tree machine learning model based on the iterative binary tree 3rd generation (ID3) algorithm. The distribution network data is used as training samples to describe the construction process of the decision tree model. Furthermore, the graph adjusted sample data is used as the training set to train the layout algorithm library. The algorithm for the layout angle of the child devices is related to the parent device. Finally, it validates the machine learning model and layout algorithm using a single line diagram data instance of the distribution network. As a result, after machine learning, the generated single line diagram runs horizontally and vertically, with balanced layering of the station building and a reasonable and beautiful layout effect, which proves big data and machine learning technology and shows the effectiveness of application in automatic layout of single line diagrams.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis Method for Distribution Network Operation and Maintenance Based on Improved Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the quality and efficiency of the distribution network emergency repair failure quantity, this paper proposes an improved random forest algorithm to evaluate the distribution network emergency repair failure quantity. A distribution network emergency repair failure system is designed, including the monitoring master station, the communication module and the fault location monitoring module. The three parts use fault location monitoring technology to realize rapid repair of Distribution network faults through data communication and processing, and use an improved random forest algorithm to evaluate the amount of emergency repairs of distribution network faults. Experiments show that the evaluation accuracy of the system's emergency repair failure volume studied in this paper fluctuates around 90%, the maximal value reaches 97%, which improves the evaluation capability of the distribution network emergency repair failure volume.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Algorithm Evaluation Technology of AI Software
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: AI software is regarded as the key to the formation of new domain and new quality combat capabilities in the future. In response to the characteristics of randomness, autonomy, and learning of AI software, traditional testing methods lack comprehensive coverage of non-functional requirements, test data is difficult to obtain and annotate, and evaluation indicators are not comprehensive. This paper focuses on the research of intelligent algorithm evaluation technology, proposing a multi-perspective and multi-attribute evaluation method for intelligent algorithms from four aspects: accuracy evaluation, efficiency evaluation, data robustness evaluation and algorithm coverage evaluation. This can effectively support future AI software evaluation work and improve the AI software testing technology system.

articleTitle: A Prediction Model for Electricity Consumption in the Beijing-Tianjin-Tangshan Region Based on Informer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Currently, the Beijing-Tianjin-Tangshan region is in an important period of transformation, with the construction and promotion of the electricity market requiring more diverse and accurate electricity services. In the prediction, climate change has a certain impact on medium to long-term changes in electricity consumption. However, due to the large amount of meteorological data and difficulties in processing, previous studies have found it difficult to consider multiple meteorological data. In this paper, the meteorological data is firstly clustered and analyzed by clustering algorithm named DBSCAN, and then the data in the same cluster is dimensionality reduced. Then, based on the dimensionality reduction data, the informer model is trained using the electricity consumption data and the meteorological data. Finally, based on the case study using the data sets from Beijing-Tianjin-Tangshan region, the prediction model for electricity consumption proposed in the paper is compared with other models to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Big Data Technology in Marine Ecological Diversity Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the Access2000 software is used for classification entry, statistical analysis, comprehensive assessment and external input of Marine ecological data. VB-ADO data access mode is used to manage the database. We call the corresponding data for processing to build a complete Marine fishery ecological environment information database. This database can realize the input of phytoplankton, zooplankton, fish eggs and larvae, residual toxins of organisms and so on. It has many services such as statistical query, comprehensive evaluation and output printing. The system can carry out the investigation and assessment of the fish resources in the sea area of China. This system has important theoretical and practical significance for the ecological environment assessment and management of Marine areas in China.

articleTitle: Design of Marketing Analysis System Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper designs a power marketing data analysis system based on data mining technology. Then the software and hardware of the scheme are optimized respectively. The main contents of this paper include: data collection, data mining and data processing. Then a new multi-level clustering method based on implicit Markov pattern is proposed. The method converts the time series of a time series into a likelihood space in which the likelihood value is identified by a symmetric KL distance. A symmetric KL migration matrix is constructed, and the access modes of users are divided into different levels by the idea of hierarchical clustering. Then a complete power grid enterprise information system is established, which is an important part of the power grid marketing system. Online analysis technology is used to ensure the whole logic input, so as to ensure the normal operation of the power marketing management system. The experiment shows that this method can realize the comprehensive processing of all kinds of electricity information, and will not cause large fluctuations.

articleTitle: Research on Single-Object Tracking Algorithm for Thyroid Nodules Based on NanoTrack
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of technology in the medical industry, hospitals have begun to introduce AI medical devices for auxiliary diagnosis. Among these, ultrasound AI medical imaging analysis technology has started to play a very important auxiliary role in the daily case diagnosis of doctors. This paper will use deep learning neural network technology to build a single-object tracking deep learning neural network, applied in the field of ultrasound imaging, to achieve single-object tracking of thyroid nodules. The algorithm will use three networks in a cascade. In the first frame of the video, the backbone network will extract deep features of the selected area of interest as the standard template. Starting from the second frame, the areas of interest in the image and the expanded regions of the image are sent into two different scale base networks for feature extraction. Finally, the features extracted by the two different base networks are fused and sent into a cascade network for classification and bounding box regression. This method locates the target by searching for the area that best matches the target template in each frame. It is a lightweight, high-speed tracking network. Experiments are deployed on the embedded device Jetson Nano, with a processing speed of up to 625 fps per second.

articleTitle: Research on Route Planning Model of Green Agricultural Cold Chain Logistics Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The improved ant colony algorithm has been widely used. In this paper, combined with the green agricultural product cold path system, the quality, identification and temperature of agricultural products are monitored in real time, and the efficiency and accuracy of storage and transportation are greatly improved. Then, by considering time, fuel consumption, fines and other indicators, can ensure the cost of goods and freshness of goods. The transfer rule is improved and the influence function of time heuristic factor is introduced. The goal is to quickly find the optimal transport route under complex transport conditions in terms of solving path planning. The limitations of ant pheromone collection, initial solution construction, path selection and pheromone updating were studied. Finally, MATLAB software and improved ant colony algorithm are used to verify the transportation process. The feasibility of this method is proved by comparing with the basic ant colony algorithm. The hybrid heuristic algorithm is also studied. By changing the pheromone updating rules in the algorithm, the ant colony algorithm is easy to fall into the local optimal solution in the search process. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by software.

articleTitle: Digital Media Art Design Model Based on Semantic Guided Bayesian Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Digital media art design plays an important role in the field of contemporary art, but traditional art design models face the limitations of low accuracy and low stability, and a digital media art design model based on semantically guided Bayesian algorithm provides a potential solution. This study uses a digital media art design model based on semantically guided Bayesian algorithm as the research object. By experimenting and tuning the algorithm, the article evaluates the computational efficiency, stability, and accuracy of the model. The research results show that the computational efficiency of this method is between 83 % and 92%. The digital media art design model based on semantically guided Bayesian algorithm has potential and prospects. It can generate high-quality, expected artistic design works, which can enhance user satisfaction and wide application.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Alarm Location Technology of Underground Cable Based on Multi-Source Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This project intends to study the new SSTDR detection technology applicable to the characteristics of low-voltage distribution network by analyzing the existing online fault detection technology of distribution network, combining the importance of distribution network, the complexity of scene and the low resistance of large cross-section. A new technology of subsection fault detection and location for multi-branch power networks is studied. This project collects the actual data of transmission lines in the high-voltage transmission system to locate the start-up fault in real time. Multiple segment ends are located synchronously by a time-domain echo generator with spread spectrum. This solves the problem of multiple branch delay in T-shaped connection and branch in HV transmission system. By using PSCADEMTP software, the fault locations under different fault types and different grounding modes are analyzed. Thus, the correctness and adaptive ability of the algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: Challenges in Implementing Power Losses Model for an Inverter in an EV Traction Emulation System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the total power losses of the inverter in an Electrical Vehicle (EV) traction emulation system are investigated under three different implementation methods. The first method involves implementing the power losses model within a subsystem constructed under the dSPACE processor board DS6001, using the general Simulink platform. The second method entails implementing the model within a subsystem built on the dSPACE FPGA board DS6601 platform. In the third method, the model is implemented within a control subsystem integrated into DS6001 but triggered with switching frequency. The simulation results of each method are presented and compared accordingly. Hardware results are also provided to verify the optimised method. The advantages and limitations of each implementation method are discussed. Finally, suggestions are proposed to give guidance to researchers who need to work on model development in hardware-in-loop (HIL) platforms.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in Complex Marine Environment Water Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper proposes a real-time monitoring system for offshore water environmental quality. This project combines LoRa wireless communication technology, sensor technology, Web technology and WeChat application technology to achieve long distance and high anti-interference ability. The system can collect, process, transmit, store, share, display, manage and control the environmental quality of offshore waters in real time. The system can be used for coastal water quality monitoring, fishery aquaculture monitoring and aquaculture monitoring. The experimental research proves that the system can realize the real-time, intelligent and long-term monitoring of offshore water environmental quality. This method can solve the problems of short observation distance, high cost, flexible deployment and weak anti-interference ability in Marine real-time monitoring.

articleTitle: A Clearing Model Considering Start-up and Shut-down Curves of Thermal Units with Minimum Generation Cost in Day-ahead Market
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Affected by the high infiltration of renewable resources in the power system, the existing coal-fired units are facing the challenges of peak load shifting and frequent start-up and shut-down. Therefore, it is vital to enhance the flexibility and economy of coal-fired units in the electricity energy market. This paper proposes a clearing model that specifies the cost during start-up and shut-down stages based on the minimum generation cost declared by market players. An example is built to verify the reliability of the total cost and behavior of units.

articleTitle: Exploring the Effect of Fin Shape on Fin-Propelled Robot's Swimming Efficiency Based on Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Marine garbage pollution and pipeline leakage seriously affect the fragile marine ecosystem; using humor labor to solve these issues is not only dangerous but also inefficient. In order to tackle this engineering problem, this paper develops an efficient underwater robot based on sea turtle's multi-legged structure and fin-propelling dynamics. The first-generation robot designed in this project has a main unit based on a cylindrical sealed capsule, and its quadrupedal structure enables the robot to not only swim underwater, but also to walk on the seafloor to perform tasks. The bionic legs of the robot can move up and down as well as forward and backward, which in turn enables the main unit to swim in a manner similar to that of sea turtles and other marine organisms. At the same time, a peristaltic pump is used to realize sinking and floating by changing the robot's self-weight. The robot can be remotely controlled by cell phone via Wi-Fi. In the second generation of the robot, this project aims to improve the robot's swimming efficiency through a combination of numerical simulation and physical experiments, exploring the effect of different shapes of fins on the swimming speed of the robot. By selecting and installing the best shape of fins on the robot, combined with the redesign of the leg linkage structure and the adjustment of the robot's center of gravity position, the robot's swimming speed significantly increases from 0.0357 m/s to 0.133 m/s. Finally, in the process of iteration, the project optimizes the control algorithm of the mechanical arm to realize precise operation, and adjusts the robot's turning radius and speed so that it can move around underwater pipeline more flexibly, thus achieving the realization of the robot's application scenarios for underwater garbage collection and pipeline inspection.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Information Dynamic Identification Monitoring Method Based on Active RFID
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The current information identification monitoring methods mainly use barcode and other carriers to realize the static identification monitoring, for the multi-information dynamic identification error and unit efficiency will be affected by the carrier reading rate and other factors, the practical application is limited. In order to improve the defects of current information identification monitoring methods, a multi-information dynamic identification monitoring method based on active RFID will be studied. After collecting the model parameters of RFID chip, a multi-dimensional information evaluation model is established. The evaluation results are output to determine the optimal chip and identification dynamic parameter monitoring standards, control the identification dynamic reception in RFID time slot, and realize the monitoring of multi-information identification. Through experimental research, the monitoring method of active RFID reduces the relative error greatly, shortens the time cost by nearly 20%, and has higher credibility in practical application.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction Algorithm of Dissolved Oxygen in Aquatic Products Based on Improved LSTM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper discusses a prediction method for dissolved oxygen in aquatic products based on the maximum information coefficient (MIC) and the long short-term memory (LSTM) algorithm. Firstly, the paper emphasizes the importance of dissolved oxygen in aquaculture, which is a key factor affecting the survival and growth of aquatic organisms. Despite the complexity of factors such as temperature, light, water mobility, and biological activity that influence the dynamics of dissolved oxygen, predicting its precise levels remains a formidable challenge. To address this issue, we present the maximum information coefficient (MIC) as an innovative tool for correlation analysis. Unlike traditional correlation coefficients, MIC is able to detect linear, nonlinear, and many-to-many relationships, which is useful for revealing potentially complex relationships between dissolved oxygen and other environmental variables. By calculating the MIC values between environmental variables and dissolved oxygen, we can screen out the most influential factors for the prediction of dissolved oxygen. Subsequently, long short-term memory (LSTM) neural networks were employed to predict dissolved oxygen using selected important environmental variables as inputs. LSTM is a unique recurrent neural network known for its distinctive gating mechanism, which allows the network to effectively capture long-term dependencies in time series data. We input historical dissolved oxygen data and relevant environmental variables into a trained LSTM model to predict future dissolved oxygen levels. The experimental results indicate that the prediction method utilizing MIC and LSTM exhibits strong performance in predicting the accuracy of dissolved oxygen, surpassing traditional statistical models and several other machine learning methods.

articleTitle: Wireless Monitoring System for Storage Environment of Electric Instruments Based on RFID Chip
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Affected by the low transmission power of the RFID chip, the wireless monitoring of the instrument status in the storage environment of the electric appliances often loses information, and the status recording of the instruments is inconsistent with the actual storage situation. Therefore, based on the working parameter characteristics of RFID chip, combined with the storage environment data of electric power instruments, the monitoring system is newly designed. Design is divided into two parts: hardware framework design and software function algorithm design. The hardware framework mainly designs the hardware interface required for monitoring, Standardization through the RFID interface. The full framework interface supports various sensor access based on RFID chip protocol, ensuring the accuracy and stability of wireless monitoring data to the greatest extent; The software algorithm is mainly designed for the position determination of power tools based on RFID technology, the position information encryption calculation based on RFID technology, and the hierarchical communication transmission based on RFID technology. By giving full play to the hardware performance, reasonable allocation of parameter resources makes the system more stable and reliable. Through the comparison experiment of data indicators, it is proved that the design system has the ability to improve the monitoring accuracy, enhance the perception sensitivity of the storage environment, and optimize the wireless transmission quality.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Location in Distribution Networks Based on Graph Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, the development of the national economy allows the power demand of our country to increase, and enables the scale of the distribution network to further expand. How to accurately judge the faults in the complex distribution network is an important research direction in this field. Solving this problem is of practical significance to promote the safe and stable operation of the distribution network. Locating faults in distribution networks aims at finding the specific location of a fault through appropriate data analysis technology, which is the core technology in fault detection of distribution networks. The traditional fault location methods of distribution networks are mostly based on the analysis of the characteristic information of a single node, and so lack the utilization of the spatial structure of the distribution network. Therefore, once the collected data are inconsistent, inaccurate, interference, noise, and so on, the accuracies of fault location may be significantly reduced. Using a novel technology called Graph Convolutional Neural Network, this paper presents a model of fault location in distribution networks based on deep Graph Convolutional Neural Networks. This location technology can make full use of the information aggregation function and topological structure of a distribution network, in order to find and locate faulty nodes by combining the characteristic information of neighborhood nodes. Therefore, it can effectively improve the accuracies of fault location in distribution networks.

articleTitle: Research on Chemical Laboratory Information System under Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper designs and develops a set of information and equipment management system for chemical laboratory based on big data computer technology. The system mainly includes: user account management system, instrument and equipment management system, chemical management system, scientific research management system and information management system five modules. C/S structure and modular design method are adopted, and each functional module is designed according to the whole process of reagent management. It includes the whole process of reagent management. Then a genetic algorithm for mining chemical pattern classification extraction rules is proposed systematically. The rules of chemical classification extraction are deduced into the rules of population evolution. The fitness function and parameters are also set based on the rules of discrete chemical data and continuous chemical data extraction. Simulation results show that the algorithm has good performance in solving chemical pattern classification problems. At the same time, the system is object-oriented, easy to operate and has perfect functions.

articleTitle: Research on User Demand Mining and Repurchase Behavior Prediction Algorithm Selection Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the text data of authoritative skin care community, this study analyzes the user's needs and summarizes six topics on the premise that it has the option of repurchase intention. We need to calculate the emotional scores of six topics of each text data and contact the repurchase intention, thus constructing a feature data set, and then exploring which machine learning method is used to predict the repurchase behavior of online community review texts, which is relatively more accurate and reliable.

articleTitle: Research on Speech Recognition Technology Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: An automatic speech recognition software based on STM32FI03 is developed. The purpose is to solve the problems in the storage and processing of speech recognition. A language processing method based on quantitative deep learning is proposed based on the analysis of language. Firstly, the difference between the characteristics of speech and the background noise in the time domain is used to set the corresponding threshold to achieve the recognition of the target. A method of speech feature extraction based on Mayer transform is proposed, which cannot solve the complex speech features effectively. Meier cestrum and Mel-Meier cestrum coefficients are calculated for different types of speech signals, and mixed feature parameters based on Fisher criterion are constructed. This paper presents a speech recognition method based on convolutional neural network. Compared with common English language, it is found that this method has better accuracy and achieves better results in a shorter time. Because the system is small in size and easy to carry, it can easily operate language on various devices.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer AIGC Technology in the Basic Platform System of Photography Specialty
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduces the video art creation and acquisition system based on AIGC. This paper first describes the development of image, image art creation and collection system of characteristic indicators, as well as image evaluation standards. Secondly, a complete image collection system is designed by combining this method with image creative collection. This paper introduces how to call SWF file conveniently and effectively, and focuses on the design ideas of exposure, focusing, metering, depth of field and virtual studio, and applies them to actual shooting. Through the research of 3D modeling technology, Flash animation technology and interactive technology, the paper makes an in-depth study of Unity3D virtual simulation technology. This paper analyzes the operation mode of AIGC video art creation and collection system, such as election and inverted index. When the original BoF model is improved by this method, only additional Hamming embeddings can be added to obtain the best performance, but the performance improvement is relatively small after reordering and weak geometry testing are added. Experiments show that the Mig parameter of the interactive virtual camera system proposed in this paper is about 20% higher than that of the conventional virtual camera system, which shows the practicability of the system.

articleTitle: Automatic Pricing and Replenishment Decision Based on WSO-BiLSTM and Nonlinear Programming
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Supermarkets maximize their revenues by formulating appropriate replenishment and pricing strategies to satisfy both supply-side and demand-side conditions. This paper focuses on the restocking and pricing decision-making problem of vegetable commodities, which is solved based on objective planning analysis using simulated annealing algorithm and multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm. First of all, a wavelet analysis model is established, the wavelet variance diagram and quarterly trend diagram are drawn, and Spearman correlation analysis is used to solve the correlation between the sales volume of different categories or single products. Then, the fitting effects of multiple fitting models are compared, the number of independent variables is changed, and the fitting model with the best fit is selected. According to the cyclical characteristics of the total sales volume, the seasonal ARIMA model is selected to predict the total sales volume of each category in the next 7 days, and the predicted value is used as the upper limit of the total sales volume constraint for the subsequent target planning, taking into account the influence of other factors in real life. Finally, taking the total sales volume and cost-plus pricing as independent variables, while considering the influence of the attrition rate and the total number of saleable individual items limit. The objective function of revenue is established, and the order quantity of each individual item needs to satisfy the minimum display quantity as a constraint. The multivariate planning model is established, and the multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm is used for model solving.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Algorithms Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: An intelligent search method based on PSO is proposed. By weighting the proportion of the difference between the current fitness and the largest fitness in the whole particle population, the position of the particle in the global optimal location is determined. This method can improve the existing search engine cannot accurately obtain the required information from the user, so as to greatly improve the search efficiency. This paper aligns data between the client database and the server database. The database of the client is constructed and the file tree of the client is created. It greatly reduces the interaction between client and server. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation experiments. It can work out the optimal scheduling scheme for multiple tasks in the cloud computing environment.

articleTitle: Water Quality Prediction in Zhengzhou City Based on ESN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Environmental water pollution threatens the social production and people's life, and it is of great importance to predict the rapid response of the water quality change to the water pollution ahead of time. Based on the timing of water quality data, echo state network (ESN) was introduced, and 8 kinds of water quality index (TP, TN, NH3-N, pH, conductivity, NTU, DO, permanganate index) data from four surface water monitoring stations in Zhengzhou were taken as samples to construct DO, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{COD}_{\mathbf{Mn}}$</tex>, TP, pH and NH3-N respectively. A multi-trait-based water quality prediction model was constructed using ESN. The results showed that the constructed DO, pH, NH3-N, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{COD}_{\mathbf{Mn}}$</tex> and TP all have high prediction accuracy and are suitable for the comprehensive monitoring of urban surface water environmental indicators.

articleTitle: Design of Cold Chain Storage and Transportation Monitoring System for Fresh Agricultural Products Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on RFID technology, GPS technology and GPRS technology, a cold chain logistics monitoring system based on radio frequency identification technology, GPS technology and GPRS technology is constructed. This system can realize the monitoring of the logistics status and quality of cold chain products, and release the relevant data such as temperature, cargo status, GPS positioning through the network. If the temperature in the transmission box exceeds the specified range, an alarm is issued so that the staff can take measures in time. This paper studies the logistics distribution time of fresh agricultural products under the condition of e-commerce. It is optimized for the shortest lead time. On this basis, a new solving algorithm is established. On this basis, the particle swarm optimization method is used to optimize the logistics path in order to minimize the logistics time. The experimental results show that the new method proposed in this study can effectively protect the transportation and storage of fresh agricultural products and reduce their losses.

Author Keywords: cold chain storage and transportation monitoring system

articleTitle: Research on Computer Fusion Digital Information Processing System for Marine Artificial Intelligence Observation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This project intends to take Argo buoy as the research object, and use big data means to build a set of highly reliable Marine observation network data and processing platform. This project intends to use the idea of “space surface filling” to reduce the dimension of multidimensional buoy data. A table structure suitable for Argo buoy set was constructed to realize the diversity retrieval of massive Argo buoy set. By comparing with classical database reading and writing, its high efficiency is tested. The distortion of echo data under different water depths is simulated, and an adaptive matching filter method is proposed to further improve the accuracy of water depth measurement.

articleTitle: Research on Advanced Automotive Machining System Based on 3D Reverse Design Printing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Automotive globoid CAM is a kind of space undevelopable surface, its shape is complicated, it is difficult to draw by the general mechanical drawing method, and it is easy to produce various problems in the actual processing. A non-contact laser scanning technique is used to measure the geometry of automotive curved cams. The single chip microcomputer LPC1768 used in this system is a single chip microcomputer with ARMCortex-M3 core produced by NXP. In order to realize the subdivision drive of the stepper motor, the A4988 dedicated two-phase stepper motor driver is selected. The subdivision drive circuit of the stepper motor is simplified, the stroke switching circuit is constituted by GK152 infrared light sensor, and the heating temperature of the heating bed and extruder is adjusted by PID method. Finally, the data was post-processed using inversion software Geomatic Studio, and imported into Pro/E software to complete 3D entity reconstruction. Geomatic Qualify software was used to detect and analyze the deformation of the model. The digital reverse design of complex automotive products is realized by combining it with the numerical control simulation software Mastercam.

articleTitle: Research on New Energy Vehicle Use Scenario Based on BTM Improved Clustering Algorithm Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A new energy vehicle usage scenario generation method based on BTM improved clustering algorithm model was established, and the operating cost of new energy vehicles was solved. This project aims at the scenario of high proportion of new energy access to study the coordinated operation of scenery and new energy vehicles. Firstly, based on the study of the operating mechanism of electric vehicle, the model of unordered charging of electric vehicle is established by Monte Carlo simulation method. Secondly, based on the wind power forecast data, BTM and modified clustering method, the daily eigenvalue segmentation model of wind power is constructed. Taking the minimum of equivalent load variance and load tracking factor as the dual optimization objectives, a mathematical model of coordinated operation of wind-new energy vehicles was established. NSGA-II method is used to solve it. The research results will help to improve the matching degree between wind power, photovoltaic power generation and load. We reduce the volatility of the equivalent load of the grid. At the same time, the electric vehicles and other uncertain factors are on the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Economic Marketing Model Based on Computer Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Marketing forecasting is an indispensable part of the production process of enterprises, and the accuracy of its forecasting results has an important impact on the success of enterprises. In this paper, an improved prediction model of BP neural network is established by combining BP neural network and time series prediction. A self-optimizing method based on genetic algorithm is adopted to optimize the algorithm. The main functions of this system are connected with the functional architecture of marketing DSS, and the architecture of marketing DSS based on network is established. The forecast using this model can more accurately predict the company's operating income in the future period. The improved neural network based on genetic algorithm is self-calibrated with reference to the prediction of synchronous time series, and the network structure is simplified. At the same time, the algorithm improves the accuracy of prediction. The results show that the system works reliably and stably. The system has some popularization value in practical application.

articleTitle: Research on Provincial Energy Carbon Emission Prediction Based on PSO-BP Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Henan Province has a large energy consumption and a fossil fuel-based energy structure, and the realization of the “dual-carbon” goal is of great significance for the whole country. Based on the IPCC emission coefficient method, the carbon emissions of Henan Province from 2000 to 2020 are estimated, the relationship between carbon emissions and economic development is explored in depth, and the PSO-BP optimization algorithm is used to simulate and predict the carbon emissions of Henan Province. The results show that the carbon emissions of Henan Province in 2000–2020 show an increasing trend and the intensity of carbon emissions shows a decreasing trend, and the combination of PSO and BP can effectively improve the prediction accuracy of neural network. The prediction results show that under the baseline scenario, low carbon scenario and enhanced low carbon scenario, the results of carbon peaking are predicted, and relevant policy recommendations are put forward.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Space Borne Receiver Power Supply System's EMC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Receiver is an important part of aerospace communication reconnaissance system. With the rapid development of modern electronic technology, modern communication reconnaissance is developing in the direction of extremely wide frequency band, extremely high sensitivity and high power. But the traditional linear power supply system cannot meet these requirements. High frequency DC/DC converter has the advantages of small volume, light weight and high efficiency. It is widely used in the field of aerospace. In the process of voltage conversion and energy transfer of DC/DC converter, the harmonics and noise which were generated by the voltage switching of high-frequency switch and the reverse recovery of output rectifier diode in DC/DC converter will cause serious interference to the receiver and affect the spectral purity of the receiver. In order to obtain high spectral purity of the receiver, the EMC design of DC/DC converter is very important. This paper briefly introduces the mechanism of electromagnetic interference of DC/DC converter and analyzes the principle of input filter and out filter. A set of remote sensing camera power filter based on detailed theoretical analysis are designed, and the calculation accuracy is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Service Scanning Supervision Technology Based on Improved Association Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The scale of data in the Internet environment is becoming increasingly large and complex. Its heterogeneous, dynamic and distributed information characteristics have caused the existing business scanning and monitoring models to be unable to meet its application needs. This project proposes an improved iterative algorithm based on multiple servers. By introducing the idea of local operation of memory nodes, a service scanning and monitoring model that can support concurrency is constructed. A cluster analysis method based on genetic algorithm based on cluster analysis is proposed. It is then synthesized to correlate the largest set of recurring items to achieve data association, extend the iterative service scanning supervision algorithm, and obtain user-interested implicit patterns from server logs. At the same time, personalized service purposes are achieved by recommending implicit interest collections to users. Simulation results show that this method can effectively improve the performance of business search monitoring, and has the characteristics of enhancement as the data size increases.

articleTitle: A Study of Line Arrangement and Recombination Rate Correction for Multibeam Bathymetric Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the survey line layout of multibeam bathymetric system in seabed topographic data acquisition is studied. Firstly, the geometric features under two-dimensional and three-dimensional conditions are analyzed, the measurement models under fixed and variable survey line directions are established, and the survey line distribution adjustment strategy is proposed. Secondly, under the fixed survey line direction, the models of seawater depth and coverage width were constructed by using trigonometric functions, and the correctness and validity of the models were verified by visualization analysis. Next, the model was extended to three-dimensional space, and the angle of the survey line direction was introduced as a new variable to build the model of seawater depth and coverage width, and the reliability of the model was verified by visualization analysis. Finally, the overlap rate model was established by using the collinear theorem and the sine theorem, and the optimal location of the survey line was found by visual analysis. The optimal survey line arrangement was determined by the bisection finding method, which finally resulted in 33 sets of survey lines with parallel north-south directions and a total length of 66 nautical miles.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Python-Based Identification of Abnormal Commodities on E-Tailing Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce, e-tailing platforms have become the main way for people to shop, but e-tailing platforms are also facing some problems, such as untrue information of commodities, false price labeling, and brushing behavior. This paper analyzes and researches the anomaly identification method of e-commerce goods online retail platform. Based on the relevant commodity data and store data information provided by so-and-so big data industry company, the paper firstly adopts exploratory data analysis method, analyzes the characteristics of the data, and draws out the characteristics and causes of abnormal data. Then an anomaly detection method is proposed based on the characteristics of e-commerce goods. This method includes three steps: dimensional organization, extreme anomaly data detection and suspicious data detection, and fully applies machine learning algorithms such as isolated forests to realize the anomaly detection of e-commerce commodity data. Finally, we use the relevant data information provided by So-and-so Big Data Co. Ltd. to verify the effectiveness of the e-commerce commodity (price, sales volume) e-tailing platform anomaly identification method proposed in this paper, and the experimental results show that this system has a high accuracy rate and efficiency.

articleTitle: A Study of Mother-Infant Behavioral Relationships Based on Support Vector Machine Predictive Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper focuses on an exploratory study of the relationship between mothers' physical and psychological conditions and infants' behavioral characteristics and sleep quality. The study was conducted through data preprocessing, including outlier exclusion and missing value treatment, to ensure the accuracy of the data. First, the patterns of the effects of mothers' physical and psychological indicators on infants' characteristics were identified through box-and-line graph visualization and scatterplot analysis; second, Pearson correlation coefficients were introduced to further confirm the relevance of these effects. Next, a support vector machine (SVM) model was used to classify and predict infant behavioral characteristics. In addition, optimization models were constructed to minimize the treatment costs of CBTS, EPDS, and HADS. Finally, an entropy weighting method was used to comprehensively evaluate infant sleep quality, and a multiple linear regression model was constructed to predict infant sleep quality, providing new perspectives and methods for future research.

articleTitle: Optimized Design of Heliostat Field Efficiency Based on Finite Element Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the optical efficiency model of tower solar fixed-sun mirror field is established by using the finite element differential method, and various parameters of the fixed-sun mirror field are investigated. First of all, according to the spatial geometric relationship, we establish the mapping model of solar altitude angle and solar azimuth angle with the incident light direction vector under the mirror field coordinate system (referred to as the field system), which can be calculated at each moment of the solar incident light vector, and solved by using the matlab software, so as to get the solar incident light vector model. Then, the shadow shading efficiency calculation model was established by using finite element analysis. We construct the mirror coordinate system (referred to as the mirror system) in the fixed-sun mirror, establish the coordinate mapping model of the mirror system coordinates to the field system coordinates, do the finite element discretization of the mirror, so that each finite element has a corresponding coordinate in the mirror system.
