We use the coordinate mapping model of the mirror system coordinates to the field system coordinates to get the field coordinates of each finite element, using the finite element's field coordinates, the incident and reflected light line vectors of each mirror, it can be obtained that the equations of the incident reflected rays of each finite element in the field system. We calculate the intersection point of the incident and reflected light rays in the field system with the plane where the surrounding 4 mirrors are located, convert the field system coordinates of this intersection point into the corresponding mirror system coordinates, determine whether this coordinate is in this mirror, and determine the loss of shadow occlusion of this mirror by cyclically traversing whether the light rays of each finite element are in the shadow occlusion region. Based on the HFCAL truncation efficiency model in Ref. and through geometric reasoning, it is concluded that the truncation efficiency in an isotropic heliostat field is a function of the distance between the heliostat and the absorber tower, the truncation efficiency of the heliostat at distances from the absorber tower is calculated to be 100m, 150m, 200m, 250m, 300m, and 350m, and the relationship between truncation efficiency and the circumferential radius of the circle where the heliostat is located is established by fitting the function. The relationship between the truncation efficiency and the radius of the circle where the heliostat is located is established by fitting the function, and the model of the truncation efficiency of the heliostat field is established.

articleTitle: Research on English Teaching Content Generation and Evaluation System Based on ChatGPT Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A semantic association database for English translation was constructed based on ChatGPT. It uses vocabulary and association space to describe words and their context in a structured way, and uses massive prediction data to learn from associated data. The rich information obtained from the large-scale English corpus is screened and stored as the information basis for quantifying the similarity between words in the future. It can be used as the intelligence basis for future lexical similarity measurement. The Corpus database is used to extract and store the associations among words contained in massive English texts, thus laying a foundation for the quantitative calculation of lexical associations. This paper presents a method for calculating lexical similarity based on semantic association vector. First, the maximum entropy method is used to identify basic noun phrases, and then the recognition results with high accuracy are used as the initial labeling results in English translation methods. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Application Research of High Reliability Small Heap Pass Risk Control System Based on Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: According to the needs of production process and operation management of fast reactor power plant, a monitoring system for air temperature and waste between various important devices in the workshop was developed. This topic takes Siemens S7-300 PLC as the core. Touch screen serves as the display interface to monitor the entire production process in real time and in real time. The method of decentralized control, centralized management and modular control is adopted, so that it has high automation and reliability. The reactor can obtain a suitable temperature and humidity environment, a temperature and humidity sensor is installed at the fan inlet. At the same time, a temperature sensor is installed at the outlet of the fan to control the blowing condition by cooling dehumidification and equal humidity heating. Through the reasonable arrangement of ventilation layout and air flow, the temperature and humidity of the medium and low-pressure chamber can be best controlled by the equipment of the fast reactor.

articleTitle: A Detection Method for Typical Component of Space Aircraft Based on YOLOv3 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A solar panel recognition method based on YOLOv3 deep learning algorithm is proposed to address issues such as inaccurate recognition of traditional algorithms in space solar panel detection. First, this paper scales the dataset images to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{416} \times \mathbf{416}$</tex>, then uses Labelme to annotate the data and transform the bounding box position information, and finally uses the YOLOv3 algorithm framework for model training. The results show that the recall, F1 score and accuracy of YOLOv3 algorithm are all above 80%. The YOLOv3 deep learning algorithm meets the requirements for real-time detection of solar panels in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent System of Remote Cooperation Information Sharing in Human Resource Management Based on Wireless Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Combining Delphi's development method, a HR management system suitable for small and medium-sized enterprises is designed and implemented. According to the actual needs of enterprises, the system is divided into four functional modules, and the data and information flow of each module are designed in detail. The SQL Server 2008 is constructed for this system. The entity, attribute, relationship, connection mode and constraint conditions based on rules are defined, and the personnel information base of the enterprise is constructed, so as to achieve the purpose of personnel management of enterprises. Data mining algorithm is introduced to standardize the system documents, standardize the database and connect the database. The scientific decision of personnel scheduling was made. Then the method of data mining is introduced to develop a HR management system suitable for enterprises in order to promote the sustainable development of domestic health undertakings. The effectiveness of this scheme is verified by comparison experiments. The system can realize hundreds of people online at the same time, and there will be no abnormal conditions such as stuttering and flickering.

articleTitle: A Novel Model Based on PSO-GA-RBF Approach for Predicting Roll Gap During Unsteady Processes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To enhance the control accuracy of strip thickness in the non-stationary process of cold continuous rolling, a PSO-GA-RBF based prediction model for the non-stationary roll gap is proposed. This model combines big data algorithms with actual production data, including roll gap, rolling force, and rolling speed. A 1450mm series cold rolling production line is selected as the research object. Pearson analysis is utilized to perform a correlation analysis on the original data indicators, while principal component analysis is employed to reduce the dimensionality of the sample data. The optimization process of particle swarm optimization is enhanced by introducing crossover and mutation operators from genetic algorithms. This optimization aims to improve the parameter selection mechanism of the radial basis function neural network, thereby enhancing the model's prediction accuracy and generalization performance. The performance of different prediction models is analyzed, comparing them based on evaluation indicators such as mean square error, average absolute error, and average absolute error percentage. The results indicate that the PSO-GA-RBF based roll gap prediction model demonstrates good predictive ability and generalization performance. To further validate the effectiveness of the prediction model, a comparison is drawn between the prediction model and the roll gap data obtained from engineering practice. The experimental results show a close correspondence in trend and period between the two, verifying the strong prediction performance of the roll gap prediction model. The validated model offers benefits such as reducing the workload of the automatic control system and improving the control accuracy of strip steel thickness.

articleTitle: Large-scale Data Mining Algorithms and Models for Equipment and Power Supply Service Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, the requirements for power quality of power systems are becoming more and more stringent. This article aims to study key issues in the integration of information resources for power supply services. First, this article provides an analysis of current device and communications data sources and their characteristics. Secondly, this article introduces feature selection data mining methods such as multi-user multipath ensemble algorithm, model-based feature extraction strategy and heuristic matching strategy based on task environment. Finally, this article uses Matlab for verification and obtains experimental results. The accuracy of this algorithm is at least 90% and can reach as high as 99%; the memory usage of the model is within 0.06; the stability of the model is between 0.8-0.89.

articleTitle: Intelligent Measurement and Control System Based on New Energy Vehicle Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The transmission system of new energy vehicles is more complex than traditional fuel vehicles, involving multiple components such as electric motors, battery packs, and power electronic devices. For the performance and control technology of new energy vehicle transmissions, the article designs an intelligent measurement and control system and conducted experimental research on system performance. The experiment uses a laboratory environment and simulation platform, combined with the actual hardware equipment or simulation software of the new energy vehicle transmission for testing. By setting different working conditions and scenarios, the response speed and stability indicators of the system are evaluated and compared. Experimental results show that the response speed of this system is 0.1-0.4s. This study shows that the intelligent measurement and control system based on the transmission of new energy vehicles has the potential to improve response speed and stability, and provides useful reference and guidance for the performance optimization and intelligent development of new energy vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on Hydraulic Optimization of Urban High-Temperature Hot Water Heating System based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on simulated annealing algorithm, this paper discusses the optimization of urban hot water heating system with dynamic system theory. By comparing with elastic moving particles, a dynamic system model is established and applied to urban hydraulic analysis. The flow-based method is adopted to solve the optimization problem of pipeline network. The diameter of pipeline is regarded as a discrete variable, the annual cost reduction is taken as the goal, and the hydraulic method is used for constraint. The feasibility of the proposed method is verified by numerical examples. The research results show that the system can obtain a larger heat supply through reasonable design under the premise of satisfying the user comfort requirements. In addition, the method is suitable for discrete variables, nonlinear programming and multi-constraint conditions, and is simple, practical and feasible. However, it should be noted that the parameter selection in the specific problem needs to pass practical testing, and the final solution still needs to be further verified, while improving the solving speed.

articleTitle: Research on Work Order Processing Evaluation Method Based on Power Business Trajectory Logic Construction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Power grid patrol and field operation have the characteristics of mobility and large scope, so it is difficult to supervise their operation behavior in time and accurately. At the same time, the quantitative evaluation data of task workload, task execution, task execution efficiency and operation duration of operators lack effective collection standards and evaluation support tools. Under this background, this paper studies the evaluation method of work order processing based on business trajectory logic. Firstly, the data selling point method and Lagrange interpolation algorithm are used to process and synchronize the job data. Then, on the basis of proper data processing, the job trajectory is constructed based on business trajectory logic. The calculation method of trajectory deviation weight and the evaluation weight of physical efficiency are studied. Finally, the evaluation model and evaluation score of job trajectory tracking are established. This evaluation method can effectively solve the problems existing in the work evaluation and performance appraisal of mobile operators, improve the efficiency of power grid inspection and reduce the cost of human resources.

articleTitle: Research on Elastic Scheduling of Private Cloud Resources in Mobile Social Networks Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Conventional elastic scheduling methods for private cloud resources of mobile social networks mainly use ArcGIS for Server 10.1 for scheduling cluster interconnection, which is vulnerable to single point of server failure, resulting in high CPU utilization for scheduling. Therefore, a new elastic scheduling method for private cloud resources of mobile social networks needs to be designed based on improved particle swarm optimization. That is to say, the elastic scheduling model of private cloud resources of mobile social network is constructed based on the cloud resource service supply object, and the elastic scheduling algorithm of private cloud resources of mobile social network is designed by using improved particle swarm optimization. The elastic scheduling load of private cloud resources of mobile social network is predicted, thus realizing the elastic scheduling of private cloud resources. The experimental results show that the designed elastic scheduling method for private cloud resources of mobile social networks based on improved particle swarm optimization has a low CPU utilization rate, which proves that the designed elastic scheduling method for private cloud resources has good scheduling effect, reliability, and certain application value, and has made certain contributions to optimizing the comprehensive operation performance of mobile social networks.

articleTitle: Optimization of Energy Consumption of UAV Cluster Based on K-Means Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, a path planning method using k-means improved particle swarm algorithm, i.e., K-means-PSO algorithm, is proposed to solve the high energy consumption problem in UAV cluster path planning. By establishing the energy consumption model of multi-UAV flights and the optimised energy consumption function model, the clustering algorithm is used to classify them into advantageous particle swarms and disadvantageous particle swarms based on the fitness values, and the ant colony pheromone mechanism and the reverse update mechanism are used to perform the position and speed updates, respectively. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm is able to minimise the energy consumption of UAV clusters, achieving an energy value of 998.34. This study provides an effective solution for UAV cluster path planning.

articleTitle: The Investigation of Student's Online Learning Adaptability Level Prediction Based on AutoML
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving realm of online education, developing an accurate method for assessing students' adaptability is of paramount importance to the educational field. It enables educational institutions to better understand student performance and needs, allowing for the provision of timely support and resources. Therefore, this study employed Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) technology to predict students' adaptability to online learning. Utilizing Baidu's AI development platform named EasyDL, this research conducted an in-depth analysis of 1, 205 data samples provided by the Kaggle platform. The model's performance was evaluated using key indicators e.g. accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, and it was compared with traditional machine learning methods to establish its superiority. The experimental results demonstrate that AutoML technology effectively predicts students' adaptability to online learning, with the model achieving an accuracy rate of 90.9%. While there is still room for improvement in predicting high adaptability levels in students, the model significantly underscored the importance of critical features such as age, location, type of educational institution, and class duration. These findings not only validate the efficacy of AutoML technology in the educational sector but also lay an empirical foundation for future research.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimal Scheduling of Virtual Power Plants Considering Cloud-Edge Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to effectively improve the operating economy and reliability of virtual power plants, this paper constructs a multi-objective optimal scheduling with dual consideration of energy and information. In the energy aspect, the economy of a single virtual power plant is considered, and the scheduling model is constructed with the goal of minimizing the power generation cost. In the information aspect, the cloud-edge synergy of computing resources in the scheduling process of multi-virtual power plant is taken into account, and the scheduling model is constructed with the goal of minimizing the delay of the cloud-edge system. Finally, the improved particle swarm algorithm is used to solve the model, and the examples verify that the algorithm is adapted to the scheduling problem in the virtual power plant scenario, so that it has the ability to solve the scheduling problem quickly.

articleTitle: Prediction of Calibration Parameters of Platform Inertial Navigation System Based on Grey Combination Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of insufficient utilization of historical test data of platform inertial navigation system (PINS), a calibration parameter prediction method based on grey combination prediction model is proposed. Firstly, the acquired values of PINS calibration parameters are preprocessed, and then an improved Grey Markov Combinatorial Prediction Model (IMGM) with double background value optimization is proposed, and finally the reliability of the model prediction is verified by the actual calibration parameters data. The results show that the forecasting parameter values can provide data support for the performance evaluation, performance prediction and fault prompting of the inertial navigation system.

articleTitle: Research on Inventory Management and Demand Forecasting of E-commerce Platform Based on ARIMA and LSTM Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper focuses on an in-depth study of inventory management issues in e-commerce platforms. Merchants need to balance between the high capital pressure caused by more inventory and the risk of out-of-stock that may be caused by less inventory. Firstly, this paper preprocesses the data of the e-commerce platform, merges the time series data, and deals with the outliers, forecasts the demand for goods through the ARIMA model, and evaluates the model effect by using the RMSE and 1-wmape indicators. Secondly, for the data of new products due to insufficient sample size, this paper used K-means clustering model for similarity classification and predicted future sales accordingly. Finally, for large-scale promotions, this paper predicts the demand under the influence of promotions through data preprocessing and LSTM model, and the 1-wmape indicator shows that the prediction effect of LSTM model is better than that of ARIMA model. The methods and conclusions of this study are of great practical significance for optimizing the inventory management of e-commerce platforms and improving supply chain efficiency.

articleTitle: Lightweight Heterogeneous Convolutional Neural Network for Trash Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Trash classification plays a crucial role in effectively reducing environmental pollution, maximizing resource recycling, and lowering the cost of trash disposal, with profound implications for achieving sustainable development and constructing a clean and healthy society. However, current trash classification heavily relies on traditional manual classification, facing challenges in meeting the growing demands for efficiency and accuracy. The application of deep learning technologies can significantly enhance the accuracy and efficiency of trash classification, enabling automated trash classification. In this study, we constructed a lightweight heterogeneous convolutional neural network (LHN et) specifically designed for the classification of TrashN et. By employing heterogeneous kernel-based convolutions (HetConv) to extract features from the trash images and enhancing feature interaction through channel shuffle, LHNet demonstrated outstanding performance in comparison with multiple models. It achieved an accuracy of 88.13%, a recall of 86.90%, a precision of 85.10%, a kappa coefficient of 85.23%, and an fl-score of 85.77%. Simultaneously, LHNet exhibited a computational complexity (FLOPs) of 1291.4688M and a parameter count (Params) of 9.6902M. LHNet showed significant improvements in accuracy and efficiency, providing a robust approach for achieving automated and efficient trash classification. This not only addresses the escalating demands for trash processing but also contributes valuable technological support to promote sustainable development and the establishment of a clean and healthy society.

articleTitle: 3D Reconstruction of Plant Based on NeRF
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: At present, aiming at the problems of quality and lack of modeling methods in plant 3D modeling technology, an improved fast 3D plant modeling technology based on Neural radiation field (NeRF) is proposed. Taking the simple plant multi view image as the input, the pose of the multi view image is obtained by using SFM. The plant image and pose information are sent to the improved nerf model for training, and the high-quality plant 3D scene is obtained. In order to improve the speed of 3D modeling, this study proposes an improved method of nerf neural radiation field based on instant NGP to reconstruct 3D plants, and a small fusion MLP based on spherical harmonics and multi-resolution hash coding for training and rendering. Compared with the original nerf training time, this method also achieves good rendering quality.

articleTitle: Implementation of Data Mining Algorithm Based on Distributed Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: MapReduce and Hadoop distributed data processing technologies are used for systematic research. The system is interactive in distributed computing, data mining, service response and cloud environment. At the level of data mining, the normalized method is used to normalize the data, so that it has a standardized dimension. The converted signal is denoised by ICA fast decomposition method. Cloud DM takes full advantage of Hadoop's open-source cloud platform, which is able to efficiently process large amounts of data. This provides a service model for the development and operation of distributed data mining system. This paper introduces the core components of the business-based cloud computing mining engine and its implementation methods. Combined with data mining technology in cloud computing environment, large-scale data storage, processing and data interoperability are realized. Experiments show that this method can efficiently mine the spatial attributes of the city and improve the efficiency of data mining to a great extent.

articleTitle: A Study on the Development of the New Energy Electric Vehicle Market Based on BP-ARIMA-Lasso Composite Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the rapid growth and impact of the New Energy Electric Vehicle (NEV) market globally, conducting a comprehensive study using methods such as Grey Relational Analysis and the BP-ARIMA-Lasso composite model on data from 2008 to 2022. Firstly, a comprehensive index system covering economic, policy, resource, technology, and population dimensions was established, identifying 8 key factors influencing the development of the NEV industry. Subsequently, the constructed model forecasts two significant growth points for China's NEV industry in 2025 and 2028, with an estimated NEV inventory exceeding 240 million units by 2032. Addressing the manufacturer's perspective, an evolutionary game model was formulated for NEVs and Traditional Fuel Vehicles (TFV), revealing that NEVs will increasingly dominate the market share, regardless of initial conditions, with government intervention accelerating this trend. From the consumer standpoint, text mining supplemented data and minimized subjectivity in the Analytic Hierarchy Process, indicating a preference for NEVs due to convenience. Overall, the impact of NEVs on TFVs is primarily manifested in market competition.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Operation and Maintenance Risk Early Warning Technology of Information System Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the security and early warning methods of digital twin voltage in power system are studied. A Markov model considering power load is constructed, and the risk assessment method of voltage obstacle crossing under uncertain condition is given. Then the source - charge model is established by Monte Carlo method and Gibbs method based on the ultra-high real-time computing performance of the digital twin distribution network. The distribution network is simulated. Examples show that this method can greatly improve the speed of substation potential fault warning, improve the location accuracy, and play a crucial role in substation potential fault troubleshooting. Using Markov chain method, the source-charge relationship can be accurately described. The Gibbs sampling method is suitable for the forecast scenario in the period of extracting data from the approximate sampling point in the Markov chain. It is feasible to use Gibbs sampling to extract the prediction scenario of the analysis period.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Information System Based on Ant Colony Intelligent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this project, ant algorithm and neural network technology are organically integrated to study a new fault diagnosis method. Then the ant algorithm is used to optimize the weight of the neural network, and the optimal rule set is used to train the neural network to obtain the fault intelligent diagnosis model. The model is applied to an example, which proves that the algorithm is feasible.

articleTitle: Design of Cross-Border E-Commerce Data Acquisition System Based on Python Crawler Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper proposes a Python based Xpath topic extraction method and an automatic identification method of cross-border e-commerce transaction data under BERT mode. This project intends to use BERT model to evaluate the correlation degree of topic content in the network. The ant algorithm based on pseudorandom criterion is used to calculate the probability of the mobile network of each agent. The pheromone concentration of each route is updated, and the optimal solution on the route is selected. By analyzing the feature vector of each data comprehensively and measuring the similarity of related topics, the links with high similarity are selected as the factors influencing the correlation degree of the objects to be retrieved. Experiment on big data collection of cross-border e-commerce is through Python platform. This paper tests the application of Python architecture in cross-border e-commerce, and provides technical support for the subsequent use of Internet crawlers to collect relevant information of cross-border e-commerce websites. Finally, a distributed crawler system architecture based on Python-Redis is proposed. The system includes Schedule and Item Pipeline modules based on Python platform. It is used for the secondary development of cross-border e-commerce projects. The system uses one master computer and four Slave computers. The results show that a distributed crawler can double the collection speed compared to a single crawler.

articleTitle: seUNet-Attention Based COVID-19 Lung Infection Segmentation Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of accurately segmenting COVID-19 lung infections in CT images, crucial for disease diagnosis and treatment. It proposes an improved seUNet-Attention model, enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of segmentation. The model, equipped with an attention mechanism, excels in identifying lung infection features, especially in low-contrast images. Experiments on public datasets show the model's superiority over existing methods, with improved detail preservation and edge segmentation of lesion areas. This advancement significantly supports clinical decision-making in diagnosing and treating COVID-19 lung infections.

articleTitle: Optimized Design of Fixed-Sun Mirror Field Based on Genetic Algorithm and Monte Carlo Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper investigates the optimization design problem in a heliostat mirror field based on genetic algorithm and Monte Carlo fusion. Firstly, the annual average optical efficiency, annual average output thermal power, and annual average output thermal power per unit mirror area of the heliostat mirror field are calculated, and the ray tracing model is established. Firstly, the altitude angle and azimuth angle of the sunlight are calculated, and then, the coordinate systems of different research objects are established to calculate the incident vector, reflection vector and normal vector of the mirror surface, and then the Monte-Carlo method is adopted to simulate the rays, and the various parameters are calculated. Then, the parameters of the heliostat field were designed so that the annual average thermal power output per unit mirror area was as large as possible under the condition of achieving the rated power. Assuming that all the heliostats had the same size and mounting height, the position coordinates of the absorber tower, the size of the heliostat mirrors, the mounting height, the number of heliostat mirrors, as well as the position of the heliostat mirrors were determined. And the optimal values of the parameters were obtained by using the fusion of genetic algorithms and Monte Carlo to solve for the optimal values of the parameters.

articleTitle: Research on High-Definition Sports Event Video Image Processing System Based on Computer Shi-Tomas Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper uses Shi-Tomas method for video search of sports competitions. Firstly, the ONVIF356-8950 4K HD network image data decoding processor is selected, and RS485 interface actuator is used as the main interface. Secondly, we build the running environment of sports game video, extract the similar playback screen of sports game video, and identify the boundary of the result. In the tracking link, this method adds a Hima point which has better ability to describe the object and is insensitive to light and rotation. During the operation of the tracking device, the corner points are tracked by optical flow algorithm, and the deviation test is carried out in two directions. Then the target window position is determined according to the remaining fixed corner points. Experiments show that this method can track the motion and deformation of moving objects effectively. The algorithm can effectively eliminate the motion error caused by smooth vertices and improve the stability of the system. The amount of computation improves the real-time performance by about 20% when encountering fast update scenes. This method can improve the search efficiency and shorten the query speed when the search keywords are exactly the same.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-telecom Fraud Based on Artificial Intelligence and Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper studies the artificial intelligence method based on the collaboration of edge and terminal, integrates the complementary advantages of the local computing and strong computing power of the two, realizes the characteristic recognition of telecom fraud behavior, and realizes the accurate and real-time anti-telecom fraud. By constructing a telecom fraud identification and defense system based on deep learning, the whole life cycle from post-analysis to pre-warning, in-process reminder and even blocking, post-monitoring feedback is realized, and the level of anti-telecom fraud technology is improved.

articleTitle: Optimization of Power System Balance and Short Term Generation Prediction Model Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To achieve balance in the power system, it is necessary to accurately predict the demand for electricity and the ability to generate electricity. In the construction of the entire short-term power generation prediction model, traditional methods are based on statistical models and rules, but these methods often cannot fully consider the complexity and uncertainty of the power system. Therefore, introducing machine learning has become an important way to improve the efficiency and reliability of the power system. This article conducted relevant research on the importance analysis of power system balance and short-term power generation prediction, and used BPNN (back propagation neural network) to optimize and improve the short-term power generation prediction model. Combining variable input module, data processing module, multi task learning module, BPNN module, and power generation prediction output module, a short-term power generation prediction optimization model was designed. Finally, based on the experiment, the following conclusion can be drawn: the power generation prediction optimization model based on BPNN has improved efficiency and accuracy by approximately 14.4% and 9.5% compared to traditional methods. Finally, the power balance system proposed in this article can ensure that the power supply meets the needs of users while maximizing the utilization of power generation resources, which has certain reference value.

articleTitle: Research and Prediction Based on Multiple Linear Regression and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, a multivariate linear regression model is built for prediction based on SBPE Dataset by drawing heat maps to select relevant features. All 80% of the data is used as a training set. The remaining 20% was divided into 5 variants as a test set. The accuracy of the model in estimating the predicted and true values of the different variables was calculated by comparing their RMSE and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> scores. The results show that the precision is different between the different variables. In addition, this paper discusses whether the predictions of the same sailboat are affected by the region and whether they vary significantly across sailboat types within the same region.

articleTitle: Multibeam Line Detection Modeling and Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Multibeam bathymetry is a technique for measuring underwater topography and seafloor features that utilizes multiple acoustic beams to simultaneously emit sound waves into the water and infer the underwater topography by measuring the echo time and intensity. The technology is highly accurate, efficient and real-time, providing important support for marine scientific research, ocean engineering and marine resource development. Compared with single-beam technology, multibeam bathymetry has many advantages and has become a development trend in the field of bathymetry. In this paper, firstly, the mathematical model of multibeam bathymetry is established, and the single bathymetry case is qualitatively analyzed, and the formula for the coverage width and the formula related to the overlap rate are derived, and the results under the given conditions are calculated. Secondly, the seabed depth was calculated based on the angle β between the normal vector projection of the slope and the survey line and the distance traveled, and the slope gradient α, Then, the general relationship between the coverage width and β and other related factors was derived by substituting the expression for the coverage width and the results were obtained from the code operations. Finally, the path planning of the survey line was carried out based on genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: A Study of Multibeam Line Bathymetry Problems Combined with Digital Visualization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, we address the problem of multibeam bathymetry to establish the optimal survey line layout for seafloor bathymetry by using geometric relationships in different situations, combining optimization algorithms and nonlinear planning models as well as data fitting and data visualization. First, a mathematical model of the coverage width of multibeam bathymetry and the overlap rate between adjacent strips is established. Then, the mathematical model of the coverage width of multibeam bathymetry is established in the case where there is an angle between the direction of the survey line and the projection of the normal direction of the seafloor slope on the horizontal plane. Again, a set of survey lines with the shortest measurement length that meets the requirements is designed, and the problem is transformed into a constrained optimization problem, which is solved based on the nonlinear programming method under the given constraints. Finally, the bathymetric data of a given sea area, given the relevant constraints, find the total length of the survey lines, and formulate an optimization strategy to achieve minimizing the total length of the survey lines and maintaining sufficient coverage and controlling the overlap rate, to find the optimal layout of the survey lines to satisfy the survey task. The proposed model is easy to understand, capable of handling complex constraints, and very flexible in practical problems.

articleTitle: A Wind Power Prediction Model Based on Recurrent Highway Network and Multi-Layer Semantic Fusion Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Accurate prediction of wind turbine power generation is of significant importance for the utilization of wind resources and the operational services of wind farms. However, the complex intermittent, and uncertain nature of wind poses challenges to accurate predictions. In this study, an improved algorithm based on recurrent neural networks is proposed, presenting a wind power prediction model (RHN-MSA) utilizing a recurrent highway network and a multi-layer semantic fusion attention mechanism. The model fully exploits hidden state information at multiple semantic layers. Finally, through numerical calculations and analysis of actual wind field data, the results indicate a significant improvement in the prediction accuracy of the RHN-MSA wind power prediction model compared to models such as GRU, LSTM, and RHN. The research provides a more flexible and comprehensive decision basis for the stable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Research on Lithology Recognition Method for Borehole Camera Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Lithology is an important parameter in geological survey of hydropower projects, and lithology identification is an important link in geological evaluation. There is a complex nonlinear relationship between lithology and rock composition. With the continuous increase of hydropower engineering exploration data, how to establish appropriate nonlinear relationships from massive lithology data is the focus of lithology identification. Deep neural networks can construct complex nonlinear functions, and convolution has the ability to extract data features. This article uses deep neural networks to identify lithology. We build a deep neural network based on Le-Net5, take the camera pictures inside the borehole as input, and use data enhancement methods such as translation, rotation, and scaling to expand the training samples; adjust the Dropout parameters and add an attention mechanism to reduce model overfitting, through a large number of experiments Contrast to optimize hyper-parameters. The accuracy of this method for classifying the limestone and slate test sets in the study area reached 97.5%, and the accuracy of the validation set reached 96.0%. Experimental results show that adding an attention mechanism and discarding some fully connected layer nodes can prevent model overfitting and improve the accuracy of in-hole camera lithology identification.

articleTitle: Development Framework Technology of Multi-Cloud Adaptation Micro-Service Based on Customization and Metadata Verification Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of cloud computing, multi-cloud strategy has become an important trend of enterprise digital transformation. This paper presents a multi-cloud adaptation microservice development framework technology based on customization and metadata verification technology, aiming to solve the adaptation and management problems in the multi-cloud environment. The technology uses a micro-service architecture, supports customized configuration and metadata verification, and can quickly adapt to different cloud environments and improve the utilization of cloud resources and the stability of business systems. This paper adopts technical analysis, using the hash algorithm and subtree distribution strategy, and compares different methods in different environments through the processing of spatial data. The experimental results showed that the response time of both the LocationAwareRule strategy and the average response time-weighted polling strategy was below 75ms, and there was little difference between the two.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Cloud Intelligent System Based on Intelligent Virtualization Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper is mainly the smart home system and some other intelligent devices and robot technology organic integration together, so that it can be more comprehensive for the robot service. At the same time, computer cloud computing technology is also integrated with the API of other third-party cloud computing platforms, so that it has more business capabilities. The goal of computer cloud computing architecture is to improve the computing and storage performance of robots with the help of massive data. The integration of third-party cloud computing services with intelligent hardware technology expands the resources and business functions of robots. By using cloud computing simulation technology, the inconsistency between observer and predictor is corrected, and a new cloud computing predictive control algorithm is designed to effectively suppress complex network attacks. Secondly, the D cloud computing system with predictive control mechanism is modeled, and the state convergence criterion in D cloud computing is established by using Lyapunov stability theory and LMI theory. Through remote operation of mobile terminals, the collaboration between mobile terminals based on cloud computing and third-party clouds is realized.

articleTitle: Flow Field Analysis of UAV Power Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: UAV power unit is the most important component in UAV. Its working state will be directly related to whether the UAV can complete the normal and stable takeoff and make it complete the flight action smoothly, so it is necessary to design the test platform for the UAV power device. In this paper, the flow field simulation analysis of the ducted fan and the fan in the state of no flow and fixed position is carried out to explore the theoretical design of the UAV power device test platform. In this paper, Creo software is used to build a geometric model for the test platform of UAV power unit. Then, the flow field of the ducted fan and the fan is taken as the research and analysis object. SpaceClaim modeling software combined with MRF method is used to establish the rotating region surrounding the fan and the static region outside the fan as the calculation domain in the flow field analysis, and Fluent software is used to grid the calculation domain of the ducted fan and the fan. The flow field is analyzed under the conditions of 10000rpm, 9000rpm, 8000 rpm, 7000rpm, 6000rpm and 5000rpm. Finally, the thrust and torque of the ducted fan are the highest when 10000rpm is analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Media Design Fusion Production System Based on Computer Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper proposes a multimedia data storage and sharing scheme based on the network environment. The system adopts MAC data storage and sharing method. The whole structure and function modules of the system are designed based on the actual operation process of university multimedia teaching resources. The structure of functional time series and use cases is studied. The main functions of the software are designed. This project proposes the method of first and second differentiation to realize the boundary detection of multimedia information. The correctness of each boundary point and the interaction between them are determined by the first and second differential curves. Then the boundary fuzzy operator is obtained through Gaussian distribution to identify the boundary points of all kinds of information. The feasibility of this method is verified by functional test. Compared with other algorithms, the proposed algorithm has higher precision and better effect. It has great promotion value.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Automatic Dispatching Strategy of Power Supply Work Tickets Based on Multidimensional Weight Calculation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: There are many types of work orders involved in the power supply, and the method of dispatching work orders is solidified. It is time-consuming and laborious to send orders for many times at the same time, of the same type or at the same site, and it requires on-site personnel to go back and forth to the site many times to handle and return orders one by one. At the same time, the allocation of system work orders at the grass-roots level depends on subjective judgment and familiarity with the business and personnel of the unit. It is often necessary to ask the location of field personnel and the current work completion by telephone, lacking relevant guidance, and the manual allocation of work orders is heavy and unscientific. In order to solve the above problems, this paper studies the intelligent automatic scheduling strategy of power supply working tickets based on multi-dimensional weight calculation. First, a distance weight model is established based on employee and work order data. On this basis, a capacity load weight model and the work order urgency weight model are further established. On the basis of the above weight model, an intelligent automatic scheduling and dispatching strategy of work orders based on multidimensional weight calculation is established. Finally, the validity of this strategy is verified by calculation.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling Method of Anti-Missile Equipment System Based on DoDAF2.0
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Equipment system modeling is the premise of equipment system analysis and evaluation, and the rationality and scientificity of modeling directly affect the determination of the development direction of equipment system. Based on DoDAF2.0 system description, a high-level operational concept diagram model (OV-1), capability vision model (CV-1), capability classification model (CV-2) and capabilityoperational mapping matrix model (CV-6) of the anti-missile equipment system are constructed to provide a scientific and reliable model for the planning, demonstration and effectiveness evaluation of the anti-missile equipment system.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Lightning Current Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, in terms of theoretical analysis, the Bruce and Goldea function model, Heidler function model and pulse function model are analyzed from three aspects: lightning current function model, spectrum and first derivative. In terms of simulation, the full-wave waveform, the wavehead waveform and the amplitude-frequency distribution were simulated, and finally a new mathematical model of lightning current was proposed, which is more in line with the IEC 61312-1 standard issued. The new function model requires about 10us to reach its peak, and about 352us to decay to half peak. The frequencies it contains are chiefly concentrated in the low rate range of 1 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>Hz. Compared with the Bruce and Goldea function model, Heidler function model and pulse function model, the proposed new mathematical model of lightning current is more in line with the characteristics of lightning current. The application of lightning current function model plays a crucial role in lightning protection engineering.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Model Construction Method Based on Geographic Information System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: How to establish large-scale 3D GIS efficiently and accurately has become a key issue restricting the development of urban 3D GIS. A large-scale 3D modeling algorithm for abstract objects such as abstract points, lines and surfaces is studied based on the analysis of the principle of terrain modeling in 3D GIS. The software can create various types of 3D models, display and browse, query spatial properties, interoperate, measure and analyze them. The software can not only conduct 3D modeling under the ground, but also overcome the problems that the existing 3D modeling methods can only display but cannot query, measure and edit. The model has the advantages of simple operation, fast operation and automation. It is of great significance in the modeling of terrain, such as ground, river, road, green space, regular building, underground pipeline, etc. Taking the rapid modeling technique described above as an example, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is proved.

articleTitle: Research on Power Supply Reliability of Intelligent Distribution Network with Automatic Blocking Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The power system can provide users with continuous and stable electric energy. The power supply reliability evaluation of distribution network is a necessary link to ensure the stable work of power system. In order to study the influencing factors of power supply reliability of intelligent distribution network, this study proposes to realize automatic blocking of distribution network by node optimization number, and study the power supply reliability of distribution network by block. The results show that the performance effect of scheme IV is the best among the five schemes in terms of system negative reliability index and system positive reliability index. The closer to the tie line is, the higher the reliability of the load point index is. In other words, factors such as tie line, switch failure, unreliable fuse and maintenance of distribution network equipment will affect the power supply reliability of distribution network. It is hoped that the research results can provide a reference for the in-depth study of power supply reliability of distribution network.

articleTitle: Economic Benefit Estimating Method of Provincial Power Grid Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Demand response is an important means to strengthen the flexibility of the power system and to guarantee the bilateral balance between power supply and demand. Based on the subsidy cost of the provincial power grid to carry out power demand response and its saved grid construction investment, this paper puts forward the method of measuring the economic benefit of demand response, and based on the actual situation of a province, the calculation is carried out, and puts forward the reasonable operation interval of the province's electric power demand response, which provides an effective reference for the actual development of the work of demand response.

articleTitle: Spatial Distribution of Electromagnetic Field of 6005 Aluminum Alloy by Low Frequency Electromagnetic Casting with Dual Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The two-dimensional model of low-frequency electromagnetic casting with dual magnetic field for 6005 aluminum alloy was established by using ANSYS finite element software. The influence of current magnitude and current frequency on the magnetic induction intensity of electromagnetic field and the spatial distribution and magnitude of electromagnetic force was studied by using the method of controlling variables. The change law of magnetic induction intensity and electromagnetic force under the condition of single coil working independently and double coils working simultaneously was emphatically studied. The results show that the current is in direct proportion to the magnetic induction intensity and electromagnetic force of the electromagnetic field. For the casting process of 6005 aluminum alloy with a diameter of 200 mm, the current of 150 A-200 A is suitable; The current frequency is inversely proportional to the magnetic induction intensity and directly proportional to the electromagnetic force. However, the penetration of high-frequency current is poor and the effect on the melt core is not obvious. For the casting process of 6005 aluminum alloy with a diameter of 200mm, the frequency of 20Hz-30Hz is appropriate; The simultaneous operation of dual magnetic fields can effectively enhance the range and intensity of electromagnetic field and improve the effect of electromagnetic field.

articleTitle: Research on substation location selection based on VIKOR method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Substation site selection is a key link in power grid planning and construction. In this paper, for the selection of substation sites to be constructed, an index system containing seven factors, including substation investment, supporting line investment, construction site acquisition and clearing cost, operation and maintenance cost, project implementation difficulty, environmental impact and social impact, is constructed. The basic data of the three station sites in the actual project were processed and evaluated by introducing the VlseKriterijumska Optimizacija I Kompromisno Resenje method (VIKOR). The evaluation results show that Station Site 1 performs optimally in terms of the length and investment of the supporting lines, the construction site acquisition and clearing costs, and the impact on the environment, and is the best choice among the three station sites. The method adopted in this paper is simple and reliable, and provides a useful reference for future substation site selection.

articleTitle: Research on Sports Competition Record System Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper takes NET as the development tool and uses C++ programming to realize the program of basketball game time scoring subsystem based on Windows. The data collected by the basketball game recording system is analyzed by using SQL statement, and the useful technical and tactical information is output to the user. The modular structure ensures that the system can ensure the completeness and consistency of data in information retrieval. This system includes player information entry, foul information record and statistics, player substitution, score record, game time, 24-second countdown, game time and score. The Apriori method is used to find the strategies related to basketball games, and the relevant rules of basketball strategy arrangement are constructed accordingly. It is found that the basketball technology and tactical analysis software of Apriori algorithm developed by NET technology can effectively filter non-game images. This lays a foundation for the study of basketball tactics.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Computer BIM in Prefabricated Building Information System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The Navisworks software in BIM technology is used to integrate and browse the engineering project, and the data structure of the engineering project is given. Navisworks was used for modeling and 3D display. A large-scale building 3D simulation system is established by using CAD solid modeling method. A 3D simulation image of the building was drawn using Navisworks visualization software. Then, the regulation algorithm of energy cost increase of prefabricated buildings based on life cycle is studied. The project cost is predicted by using BIM technology and grey system principle. A dynamic cost management model is established by integrating with the obtained increment index, and the correlation law between various cost growth indexes is obtained by using this model. The model is improved according to relevant strategies. In this way, energy consumption and cost growth in the whole construction process can be controlled. Experiments show that the 3D simulation images of large-scale buildings built by this system have higher definition and lower computing time.

articleTitle: A Multibeam Line Planning Model Based on Differential Evolutionary Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, we study the beam coverage problem of multibeam sounding system and its measurement efficiency in the complex seabed terrain environment, especially in the seabed slope area. Based on the sine theorem, cosine theorem, iterative optimization solution and other methods to model and complete the related work and use the differential evolution method algorithm to solve the model. Firstly, a mathematical model of the coverage width and the overlap rate between adjacent strips of multibeam bathymetry is established, its geometric relationship is described using the sine theorem and the cosine theorem, and the Gaussian elimination method algorithm is used to solve the system of linear equations. Then, a multibeam mathematical model that considers the variability of the line direction is established based on the change of the line direction of the sounding vessel in the sea area by using the linear system of equations. Again, a set of survey lines covering the whole sea area with the shortest measurement length is designed, and the overlap rate between neighboring strips is satisfied, the beam coverage width of multibeam measurement is examined. And the effect of repetition rate is considered by applying the multiplicative influence factor, and it is concluded that the parallel path planning method can get the shortest missed measurement length, and the survey lines can completely cover the whole rectangular sea area. Finally, to design a survey line for a survey vessel equipped with a multibeam bathymetric system, a seawater depth simulation scenario is built based on the difference algorithm, which models the survey path design problem as an optimization problem with the objective functions of total path distance and coverage. Then, the algorithm searches for the optimal solution in the solution space of the problem by simulating the differential evolution process in the solution space.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Power Intelligent Management System Based on E-Assistant
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of marketing informatization of power grid enterprises, companies have strong demand in terms of rapid sharing in information and expanding emerging businesses. Power grid companies need to use advanced and reliable technical means to establish power marketing services mobile operations application systems. This article first analyzes and architectural design based on E-Assistant's power intelligent management system, and then introduces the main application functions implemented by the system. Finally, in combination with the actual situation, it proposes the offline mode and online mode of mobile operations based on E assistant. And the effect of the system after its application in enterprises is analyzed. As for result display, the system design can further enhance the mobile terminal information processing capacity and enhance corporate power supply service capabilities.

articleTitle: MAV/UAV Cooperative Combat Effectiveness Evaluation Based on Matter Element Extension Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: An evaluation method of MAV/UAV cooperative combat effectiveness based on matter element extension theory is proposed. In this method, on the basis of built effectiveness evaluation index system of MAV/UAV cooperative combat, game theory is introduced to balance the subjective and objective components of G1 weight and entropy weight, and complete the comprehensive weighting of evaluation indices; and then the matter element extension evaluation model of MAV/UAV cooperative combat effectiveness is established based on the asymmetric closeness criterion. The numerical example verifies the effectiveness and scientificity of the proposed method, thus providing a solution for MAV/UAV cooperative combat effectiveness evaluation.

articleTitle: Chinese Electronic Medical Records Named Entity Recognition Based on RoBERTa-wwm and MultiHead Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To address the low utilization of entity features and insufficient semantic representation in Chinese electronic medical records named entity recognition, a method based on RoBERTa-wwm (A Robustly Optimized BERT Pre-training Approach-Whole Word Masking) and multi-head attention is proposed. This approach incorporates the pre-trained language model RoBERTa-wwm for semantic representations enriched with prior knowledge. To record both local and global aspects of sequences, it makes use of multi-head self-attention layers and a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network. Named entities are extracted through sequence decoding and tagging by a conditional random field (CRF) layer. Test findings on the “CCKS 2019” dataset show that this technique raises the F1 score to a higher level.

articleTitle: PJ-ADMM Based Parallel Energy Sharing Mechanism Between Prosumer Aggregator and Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Flexible resources such as renewable energy and electric vehicles are expanding. In order to efficiently utilize the energy from various types of prosumers, an energy sharing market mechanism between prosumer aggregator and charging stations is proposed. Based on the PJ-ADMM algorithm, the proposed mechanism is capable of parallel iterative computation to realize market clearing. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed mechanism through a case study. After participating in energy sharing, the social welfare is improved and the resources can be optimally allocated.

articleTitle: Static Human Detection in Clutter Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Indoor human detection using radars is popular as it provides continuous surveillance and detection capabilities. However, the technology also poses challenges such as a higher cost and false alarms caused by non-target signals. In order to tackle it, a novel method is proposed which can removing static noises, time-variant signals and ghost targets comprehensively. Through the experiments and analysis, it can be found the method performs well when a human stands still in a room near a houseplant.

articleTitle: Optimization of Deep Learning Method for Automatic Recognition of Electric Energy Meter Manufacturers and Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The manufacturing and application of electricity meters are constantly expanding with the development and expansion of the power industry. In order to better utilize the function of electricity meters and avoid accidents and malfunctions, this article believed that it is crucial to confirm the manufacturer, model, and even more relevant information of electricity meters through automatic identification. Moreover, this article also used deep learning methods to assist the automatic recognition system in identifying targets. In the final experiment of this article, a comparative experiment was conducted on the accuracy of conventional recognition systems and intelligent recognition systems based on convolutional neural networks (a deep learning technology). The results showed that the average accuracy of the conventional system was 78.79%, while the average accuracy of the intelligent system was 89.05%. Therefore, this study found that deep learning can improve the recognition accuracy of the automatic recognition system for electricity meter related information.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Thinking Neural Signal Recognition and Classification in Personalized Art Computing Library
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Electroencephalogram (EEG) is a key resource for the study of brain function, and the interaction between computer and machine through EEG has become a new computer interaction mode. This project intends to study the EEG - computer interaction model based on facial expression. A neural cluster model based on neural network was used to model the mechanism of facial emotions-induced EEG. The EEG activity induced by facial emotion and its spectral characteristics were obtained. In order to improve the recognition accuracy of emotion-driven EEG, the analysis and recognition algorithm of EEG stimulated by expression is studied by combining wavelet with ANN model. The simulation results show that the correct rate of EEG recognition based on neural network is 88.69%. The recognition accuracy of BP neural network is 76.3%, and its convergence speed is also improved. The experimental results show that this method is an effective method for EEG recognition.

articleTitle: Study on the Possibility of Thermal Breakdown Process of Power Cable
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The withstand voltage test of power cables is a traditional test that requires high test power and a long test time. With the development of partial discharge testing technology, whether partial discharge testing can replace withstand voltage testing has been discussed. The key to whether it can be replaced is whether there are defects that can cause breakdown without partial discharge. This defect exists theoretically. It has low resistance and will not cause partial discharge, but will cause heating and eventually thermal breakdown. But this only exists in theory, and whether it exists in actual cables is unclear. To this end, this article established the most serious heating defect, measured its temperature change during the withstand voltage test, and conducted an equivalence analysis. The research results show that even this most serious heating defect will not cause cable breakdown during the withstand voltage process, which further enhances the possibility of partial discharge testing replacing the withstand voltage test.

articleTitle: Research on Portable Cable Recognition Electronic Equipment System Based on Computer Signal Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This system uses C8051F020 microcontroller. Then the fault detection system of multi-core cable is designed. Then this paper proposes a power cable fault diagnosis model based on neural network and a power cable data processing algorithm based on S transform. The algorithm is based on the eigenvector of complex time-frequency matrix combined with information entropy and SVD. The method takes power cable fault characteristic vector as input. The weights and bias parameters of deep neural networks are modified by using stochastic gradient dimensionality reduction method. This enables accurate identification of cable faults. The insulation status of power cable is monitored in real time by measuring the leakage current, local pulse current, ambient temperature and ambient humidity. The accuracy of this method is verified by computer simulation and field measurement data.

articleTitle: Online Vocational Education Personalized Course Content Push Algorithm Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A collaborative filtering based online teaching recommendation system for higher vocational colleges is proposed. UserCF system for user oriented personalized recommendation and object-oriented personalized recommendation system are established. The concept of multiprocessing is proposed to improve the learning performance of the network. By means of subject modeling, subject dictionary modeling, data preprocessing and behavior dictionary modeling, the dynamic information ontology is extracted. The dynamic ontology of network behavior is weighted by six factors, namely time, content, object, place, behavior, and number of reentries. This results in the decay model of user data in the network. Through the scoring matrix of user data, the degree of similarity between users and the filtering of data is to achieve the best recommendation. And the filtered data has less similarity and better identification, as well as less push delay. Practice has proved that this improved scheme is effective.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of System Strength on Transient Overvoltage for Power Systems with Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Renewable energy sources (RESs) with dynamic reactive power support capability are important reactive power sources that cause the transient overvoltage (TOV) in the power system with high penetration of RESs. The TOV problem is more severe in the weaker system. This paper establishes a mathematical relationship model of the short-circuit ratio (SCR) and the node voltage to quantify the impact of system strength on the TOV. First, the mechanism of the TOV caused by RESs is explained. Then, we use a multi-in feed SCR index to indicate the strength of power systems with high penetration RESs. The analytical expression of the TOV as the function of the multi-infeed SCR is derived. It considers the mutual influence of multi-infeed branches on the TOV level in power systems with RESs. The more significant the grid-connected scale of RESs is, the lower the SCR and the higher the TOV are. Furthermore, the effect of synchronous condensers (SCs) on improving the system strength is also analyzed. The TOV problem can be improved by SCs. Simulations verify the analysis of this paper.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Transmitter-Side Electrochemical Energy Storage on Recipient-Side Phase Change Failure in Ultra-High Voltage Direct Current Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Phase change failure is one of the common faults in UHV DC transmission system, which leads to voltage fluctuation, current inrush and other phenomena, thus causing serious harm to the safe operation of power grid. Studying the influencing factors of phase change failure is a prerequisite for suppressing phase change failure, and electrochemical energy storage at the sending end can suppress voltage fluctuation, mitigate current impact, improve system inertia, and play a certain buffer and auxiliary role in the case of phase change failure at the receiving end. Therefore, this paper establishes a set of UHV DC transmission system model and explores the influencing factors of phase change failure. Based on this model, the influence mechanism of electrochemical energy storage at the sending end on the phase change failure at the receiving end is investigated from the three aspects of output power size, inductance size and energy storage capacity. The results show that: (1) the larger the output force is, the lesser the degree of phase change failure is. (2) The larger the grounding inductance is, the lower the degree of phase change failure is. (3) The larger the energy storage capacity is, the lower the degree of phase change failure is.

Author Keywords: phase change failure at the receiving end

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction of Construction Cost Based on BPNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: It is necessary to accurately predict the construction cost, especially in the early stage of the project. This paper adopts BPNN as a new artificial neural network method, which can effectively solve the problems existing in the current construction project cost prediction. BPNN method can capture the main influencing factors of construction cost and quickly estimate them. The cost of a project is affected by many factors. If these factors are treated as variables, it will not only increase the calculation workload, but also affect the accuracy of estimation. The main factor affecting the project cost is what affects the project cost. If the main cause is ignored, the accuracy of the forecast will be affected. This paper takes the cost prediction of residential projects as the research object. On this basis, it selects the main factors that affect the cost of real estate projects, analyzes and quantifies them, inputs them into the established BPNN model, takes the single cost of the project as its output set, and uses BPNN to predict the cost.

articleTitle: Analysis of anti-ship missile combat effectiveness evaluation based on GA-SVM model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
