abstract: Aiming at the complexity and uncertainty of the influence of marine hydro-meteorology on the combat effectiveness of anti-ship missiles, this paper constructs an assessment model of the influence of marine hydro-meteorology on anti-ship missiles based on the systematic analysis of marine hydro-meteorological elements, combining the support vector machine (SVM) and genetic algorithm (GA). The constructed model is applied to assess the combat effectiveness of anti-ship missiles, and the penalty factors and kernel function parameters in the algorithm are optimized and selected, and finally verified with actual cases. The results show that the accuracy of the model established through the combination of SVM and GA is better, and the model results are more consistent with the actual results. The quantitative results are obtained and the feasibility and scientificity of the method are verified through simulation experiments, which have certain reference value for the command decision-making in modern naval warfare.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Turtle Tank Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduced an intelligent turtle tank management system. This system includes many functions, such as feeding management, water temperature management, water quality management, light management and online viewing functions. It lowered down the cost of pet turtle feeding and also bring the convenience to pet raiser.

articleTitle: Geometric Modeling-Based Study of the Line-of-Sight for Multibeam Bathymetric Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The multibeam bathymetric system is to use the transmitting transducer array to transmit sound waves with wide sector coverage to the seafloor, and this paper establishes a mathematical model to study the multibeam line wiring problem by analyzing the relationship of each index of the multibeam system strip. According to the definition and relationship diagram of each index under the seafloor flat condition, the seafloor slope is introduced to establish the plane geometry model, and according to the plane geometry principles such as the sine theorem and the relationship between the edge and angle positions of plane triangles, the mathematical model of the strip coverage width and the coverage of neighboring strips of the multibeam bathymetric system under the sloping condition is established.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation of Chinese Articulation Using Machine Learning and Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This design uses SPCE061A, SPLC501 and keyboard module to realize speech recognition system. The system realizes the functions of adding, deleting and searching basic information. The data saved in SPR4096 was recognized by voice. A steady state interference noise for Chinese speech audibility detection based on pink noise is proposed, and its frequency is consistent with the speech features recorded in anechoic chamber. The corresponding training samples were obtained by convolution of the Chinese speech audibility test word list with the equivalent binaural chamber impulse response. It is then tuned to a specific signal strength. The objective evaluation of the intelligibility of Chinese speech is done by audiologists. It is found that factors such as reverberation time, signal-to-noise ratio and pronunciation speed play an important role in the intelligibility of Chinese speech. Compared with reverberation time and speech frequency, SNR plays a more significant role in the intelligibility of Chinese speech. Compared with conventional methods, this method has better recognition performance and speed.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Predicting the Strength of 3D-Printable Engineered Cementitious Composites
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The construction industry, grappling with challenges like high costs, labor shortages, and environmental issues, is undergoing a transformative phase with the advent of 3D concrete printing (3DCP). This innovative approach, characterized by automation and sustainability, has introduced 3D-printable engineered cementitious composites (3DP-ECC), enabling the creation of complex structures without the need for traditional formwork or reinforcement. However, predicting the mechanical properties of 3DP-ECC, especially compressive strength, is challenging due to the influence of numerous variables such as printing parameters, material composition, and curing conditions. This paper presents a novel approach using a deep learning methodology, specifically a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architecture, to predict the compressive strength of 3DP-ECC. The study involves meticulous feature engineering, including the selection and preprocessing of relevant input features like printing speed, nozzle diameter, fiber content, and water-cement ratio. The performance of the LSTM model is evaluated in terms of accuracy, precision, and robustness against traditional empirical models. Our results demonstrate that deep learning, particularly RNN with LSTM, offers a reliable and efficient tool for predicting the compressive strength of 3DP-ECC, outperforming conventional models. This research not only highlights the potential of deep learning in advancing construction methodologies but also provides a foundation for future innovations in the field.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Detection of Vulnerabilities in Smart Contracts Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The proliferation of smart contracts has led to a surge in hacking attacks, resulting in substantial financial losses and undermining the healthy growth of the blockchain ecosystem. To mitigate these challenges, this paper introduces a dynamic vulnerability detection approach for smart contracts leveraging machine learning techniques. The proposed method involves the extraction of opcode sequence features through a combination of the N-gram model and a weight penalty mechanism. The core objective is to identify vulnerabilities within deployed smart contracts by analyzing the opcode sequences during their dynamic execution. This approach falls under the category of dynamic detection, aiming to ensure the integrity and security of blockchain-based systems.

articleTitle: Internet + Technology in the Exhibition Market Intelligent Marketing Digital System Research
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article has the enterprise marketing behavior of a variety of factors for a detailed analysis. The database technology and intelligent multi-agent intelligent marketing model are organically integrated, trying to build a set of intelligent marketing strategy system suitable for enterprises. This paper proposes a multi-level application model based on J2EE platform. According to the design requirements of the system, the explicit structural relationship between the presentation layer, the middle layer and the bottom data layer is designed. The business logic of the program is separated from the user interface, giving the user a simple and convenient interface, while not affecting the normal use of the customer. This project intends to study the user modeling method for personalized marketing based on deep neural networks. Through PGBN-based deep neural network and Gibbs up-down sampling technology, this paper establishes and train users' images and interests and other information to achieve the extraction of users' interests and hobbies. This method can better obtain more user attribute information, which is of great help to achieve accurate marketing.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Object Tracking Algorithm for Thyroid Nodules Based on ByteTrack
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The field of medical technology has begun to use artificial intelligence technology for auxiliary diagnosis. This article uses multi-target tracking technology to automatically track and locate thyroid nodules. In the application scenario of ultrasound imaging, this article uses a tracking-by-detection method. The multi-object tracking model ByteTrack performs tracking by associating each detection box instead of only associating high-scoring detection boxes. For low-scoring detection boxes, their similarity to trajectories is exploited to recover real objects and filter out background detections. Using the similarity between the detection frame and the tracking trajectory, while retaining the high-scoring detection results, the background is removed from the low-scoring detection results to discover the real objects (difficult samples such as occlusion and blurring), thereby reducing missed detections and maintain track connectivity. This method uses Yolov7 as the thyroid nodule target detector and ByteTrack as the multi-target tracker of thyroid nodules to ensure that thyroid nodules can be accurately tracked in real-time scenarios, complete the end-to-end input and output of the algorithm, and deploy the algorithm on edge devices, the tracker can process up to 1256 fps.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Portrait Matching System for Accurate Employment of Graduates by Integrating Professional Information
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: User profile is an important means for enterprises to understand and obtain their potential customers. However, the existing statistical analysis algorithms cannot effectively deal with unstructured text information, nor can they deeply dig out the characteristics of users from many aspects. Aiming at the personalized employment needs of college students, this project intends to carry out the research on employer characteristic modeling based on multi-source and heterogeneous job-hunting big data for college students' personalized job-hunting needs. The research and application of evaluation index and labeling system, multi-source data fusion method, evaluation labeling method are mainly carried out. This project intends to use LDA technology to mine network content and build topic modeling through cross-domain collection and classification of book resources. According to user characteristics and content, a service oriented personalized recommendation algorithm is designed. This project proposes a group behavior detection algorithm, which can effectively reduce the group query time and computation amount by classifying the group characteristics. In this way, the purpose of fast and efficient. Simulation results show that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Design of Human Operation Management System Based on Human-Computer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The paper first designs and implements a human resources management system with a good human-computer interface based on JavaEE language. Human resource management aimed at breaking down the barriers that are not conducive to corporate growth. This builds an effective development environment for the company's human resource development. It can well solve the coupling problem between various layers. The system has the advantages of simple interface, safe operation, and good human-computer interaction. It realizes many functions. Then this paper proposes a human resource cost estimation method. By collecting the enterprise's human resource cost estimation data, the paper uses the chaos principle to reorganize it and restore its changing characteristics. The “extreme learning machine” was used to evaluate the company's human resource costs and company performance. The research results show that this method can better reflect the cost change characteristics of enterprise employees and improve the effect of enterprise performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Automatic Material Transport Vehicle Based on Visual Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The traditional material transport truck material transmission mainly relies on manual control, the disadvantage of doing so is that it is easy to cause the underload of the silo, especially in the harsh construction environment, the operator to the roof to observe the material level, which is neither safe nor accurate monitoring of the state of the material, and the manual control of the operation of the transport truck is prone to error. Therefore, this paper studies the design and implementation of automatic material transport vehicle based on visual navigation, aiming to better transport materials through the use of automatic transport vehicle based on visual navigation. Through experiments, this paper tests the improvement of the average accuracy of each operation of automatic material transport vehicle based on visual navigation. The experimental results found that the accuracy of various operations of the automatic material transport vehicle was improved by 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> to 35% on average. From this experimental result, it can be seen that the visual navigation automatic material transport vehicle can play a good role in the material transport.

articleTitle: Research on Music Creation System Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: According to the structure of sound type library, this paper gives the realization method of multi-characteristic music creation system. Firstly, the whole architecture of music creation is realized by using the modules of computer, memory card, display, computer and sound. An effective multidimensional audio timing modeling method is established by constructing a deep learning method based on long-term memory network based on recurrent neural network and combining with supervision mechanism. Through this model, the music style of the famous singer Justin is generated. The algorithm was compared to Justin's music library, which had a maximum similarity of 98.25%, with 84.15% of the works receiving expert reviews.

articleTitle: An Improved Image Deblurring Algorithm Based on GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the limited number of original data sets cannot be fully close to the real data distribution, thus affecting the effect of image deblurring. This paper proposes the method of generating adversarial network image deblurring based on data set expansion. Firstly, the generated adversarial network is used to expand data sets; Secondly, in order to solve the problem, the expanded data set is expanded again by traditional methods to generate kuochong data set; finally, the GoPro data set, kuochong data set and Kohler data set are input into the network model for training and testing. The experimental results show that the peak SNR PSNR value increased by 19.8%, and the structural similarity SSIM value increased by 2.5%.

articleTitle: Rotating Target Motion Parameter Measurement Using 77GHz Millimeter Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Environmental perception and target detection are important application scenarios for radar. Millimeter wave radar is a commonly used target detection method, which is a radar technology that uses the millimeter wave frequency band for measurement. It has the characteristics of high resolution, high precision, and strong anti-interference ability. This paper provides a detailed introduction to the working principle of millimeter wave radar and designs a rotating target velocity measurement experiment. In the experiment, this paper measures the speed and rotational speed of the constructed rotating target and evaluates the accuracy of millimeter wave radar speed measurement.

articleTitle: Detection and Analysis of Thermal Runaway Acoustic Signal Characteristics of Energy Storage Lithium Battery
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Acoustic signal is commonly generated in the thermal runaway process of lithium energy storage batteries. In order to understand the acoustic information of the lithium batteries, an experimental platform is designed to test the thermal runaway sound signals of different type of lithium blade batteries. The sound variance process of thermal runaway is recorded. Time-and-frequency-domain methods are used to analyze the acoustic characteristics of the batteries. It is found that thermal runaway can be detected with sound test method. The research result validates that acoustic method could be used as a new technology for early and ultra-early safety warning of lithium batteries, which is of great significance to the safe operation of energy storage stations.

articleTitle: Equivalent Capacity Assessment of New Energy Storage in Power and Electricity Supply in Provincial Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to assess the equivalent capacity of new energy storage in provincial power system, this paper forecasts the power demand, power supply scale and structure, and the development of the new energy storage in provincial power system in the middle and late stages of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan. It is the first time to use 5-minute power data to carry out production simulation analysis, and analyze the profit and loss distribution of power and electricity on the summer heavy load day, which breaks through the defects of the conventional power production simulation for the hourly analysis. In this paper, according to the new energy storage operating hours of 2 hours, AC side efficiency of not less than 85% of the way to measure, in 2024, 2025, the province respectively configured a new energy storage 7.15 million, 11.09 million kilowatts, the day of the discharge of electricity only accounted for the province's power shortfall of 45%, 35%. Therefore, only rely on new energy storage cannot completely solve the problem of power supply, the province needs to synergize its efforts in the source-network-load-storage to enhance system stability.

articleTitle: The Application Direction of Data Communication in High-Voltage Power Cable Grounding Box Based on Optical Sensing Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: How to increase the speed of data transmission and reduce energy consumption are two important and difficult issues in current grounding boxes. This article uses research based on optical sensor communication technology to improve the stability and reliability of grounding boxes. This study uses a combination of experiments and simulations to explore optical sensor communication technology in data communication applications in high-voltage power cable grounding boxes by optimizing the design and algorithm of the optical sensor communication system. In the experiment, high-speed light source and modulation technology were used to optimize fiber transmission loss and attenuation, and a low-power optical receiver was used. Through case analysis and testing, the results show that the research in this article can enable the data transmission rate of the grounding box to reach a maximum of 10.9 Gbps. Through research on the data communication application of high-voltage power cable grounding boxes based on optical sensing communication technology, the data transmission rate is significantly increased and energy consumption is effectively reduced, which can improve the energy efficiency and sustainability of the grounding box.

articleTitle: Influence of Interface Moisture on Insulation Properties of Power Cables
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Cross-linked polyethylene cables have been widely used in urban distribution networks. Due to the complex structure of the intermediate joint, it may get damp during operation and installation. After getting damp, the interface formed by the silicone rubber and the main insulation of the cable will have moisture intrusion. This will have an impact on the insulation resistance of the interface. To this end, this paper studies the simulation method of the intermediate joint interface, constructs a simplified model of the interface, and studies how to apply pressure to the interface. Then the insulation resistance of the interface under different pressures was measured when moisture penetrated the interface, and its change with time was observed. Research results show that when the interface is dry, the measured interface resistance is infinite. Once water penetrates the two poles, the resistance immediately drops to several megaohms; the interface pressure can inhibit the evaporation of interface water and make the insulation resistance value change more stable; pressure has a significant impact on moisture. The distribution plays an important role. When there is cotton cloth or cotton thread, the pressure will squeeze the water out of the cotton. When there is only pure water in the interface, the pressure will squeeze the water to spread around.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of User Reviews on Bert-Based E-Commerce Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The task of e-commerce platform user review sentiment analysis is to collect user reviews on various e-commerce platforms to make a dataset, and then manually annotate them with labels to perform sentiment analysis using deep learning methods. In deep learning-based sentiment analysis, embedding generation of text and feature extraction are the core parts, and this paper chooses to study these two parts and proposes a deep learning model based on bert-bigru-textcnn.

articleTitle: Prediction of Plunger Lift Dynamics Using a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network with an Innovative Forecasting Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Plunger lift is commonly applied to both conventional and unconventional gas wells to address issues such as liquid loading, which can result in liquid accumulation and even cease production. By leveraging machine learning (ML) algorithms, well surveillance data can be utilized to predict the condition of gas wells utilizing plunger lifts, facilitating decisionmaking in gas well deliquification. In this paper, a recurrent neural network (RNN) based on long short-term memory (LSTM) for production process data analytics was employed to capture the temporal dynamic behaviors of time-series data. Our findings indicate that the bidirectional LSTM combined with the encoder-decoder architecture (BILSTM-AE), multiforecast average bidirectional LSTM (ABILSTM), and noisesmoothed bidirectional LSTM (SBILSTM) achieved root mean square error (RMSE) values of 1.20%, 1.09%, and 0.95%, along with R-squared (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) scores of 95.49%, 96.97%, and 96.38%, respectively. A further statistical comparison revealed that the ABILSTM model demonstrated superior performance compared to the other models. With high-precision minute-level forecasting, this study has the potential to significantly improve production forecasting, operational adjustments, and hazard prevention in practical processes.

articleTitle: A Financial Decision Support Optimization System Based on Artificial Intelligence and Data Mining Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Effective financial decision-making is crucial for organizational growth, yet it is often impeded by limitations in information availability and subjective biases. While traditional computer-based financial decision support systems (FDSS) have marginally enhanced decision quality, they still need further improvement with data inaccuracies, limited analytical capabilities, and slow response times. This paper examines the potential of advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) and data mining algorithms to revolutionize FDSS. We critically analyze the shortcomings of current FDSS and introduce an innovative approach incorporating AI-driven data mining into electronic financial decision support frameworks. This integration aims to create more sophisticated, agile, and intelligent tools, addressing the evolving demands of financial decision-makers. Our study highlights the transformative impact of AI and data mining on FDSS and sets the stage for future advancements in intelligent financial decision-making.

articleTitle: Global Self-Supervised Graph Learning for Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, Comparative Learning (CL) has driven a series of effective research in the recommendation domain, and it excels in dealing with the data sparsity problem in recommender systems since no data labeling is required in CL. The typical model flow of the approach consists of structurally perturbed augmentation of the user-item bipartite graph, and model optimization by maximizing the consistency of node representations across different graph augmentations. Although the model has been shown to be effective, we believe that existing contrastive learning research and applications are not yet sufficient. To enhance the global nature of contrast learning, we introduce global graph view self-supervised graph learning (GSGL). This method adds an auxiliary self-supervised task to the traditional recommendation supervision task to realize multi-view contrast learning. Specifically, each node builds enhanced views by three data enhancement methods (node loss, edge loss, and random noise) and performs two-by-two comparison learning on these views. Through empirical studies on three benchmark datasets, the effectiveness of the GSGL algorithm is demonstrated, which not only leads to a more uniform view embedding spatial distribution and improves the recommendation accuracy, but also exhibits strong robustness to interaction noise. The code and used datasets are released at https://github.com/LX-Moon/GSGL.

articleTitle: Research on vehicle Object Detection in Aerial Photography Based on Improved YOLO Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The historical mission of transportation personnel is to build a strong transportation nation. The most important component of an intelligent transportation system is vehicle detection and analysis, which involves gathering information and monitoring the status of vehicles using advanced technologies to achieve effective allocation of transportation resources. In recent years, methods based on convolutional neural networks have made rapid advancements in the field of image processing. Addressing the challenges in small object detection, this paper proposes an improved algorithm for small object detection based on YOLOv3. Building upon the single-stage object detection algorithm YOLOv3, several improvements are made. Firstly, a modified K-means clustering algorithm is used to analyze and generate anchor boxes, providing an improved evaluation metric. Secondly, addressing the weak feature extraction capability and low detection accuracy of the backbone network for small objects, a lightweight network called EfficientNet is employed. EfficientNet-B6 is selected as the backbone network for experimental analysis based on the characteristics of the dataset. The proposed algorithm is validated using public datasets and compared with the improved Faster R-CNN algorithm, demonstrating that the improved YOLOv3 is suitable for real-time object detection. The detection accuracy achieved is 86.8%, with a detection speed of 39.5 frames per second on a 16GB GPU.

Index Terms: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge

articleTitle: Research on Online Shopping Mall Product Classification Recommendation Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The practical application of graph neural networks in online shopping malls is a significant area within real-life scenarios. As neural network technology continually advances, an increasing emphasis is being placed on how to efficiently leverage graph data for enhancing the functionality and performance of these e-commerce platforms. Nonetheless, prevailing methodologies commonly employ conventional adjacency matrices or basic attention mechanisms to consolidate and model data pertaining to items, users, and their interactions. To some extent, these approaches overlook the intricacy of graph structures and prove challenging to implement effectively on a grand scale. Running on graph data requires a large amount of computing resources, leading to performance issues. To address these issues, we propose a new method based on hierarchical transformation aggregation model to process graph data in online shopping malls more efficiently. This method first selects nodes at various levels and regions through random walks, and then uses graph convolutional neural networks (GCN) for information aggregation. Upon acquiring node features for each layer, a transformed attention mechanism is further introduced to more effectively consolidate the node features from every layer, thereby obtaining the ultimate representation of each node. This method better captures the local and global characteristics of graph data by considering node information at different levels, improving the performance and user experience of the mall. Ultimately, we substantiate the dependability of this model through multiple real-world dataset validations, thereby evidencing its practical application feasibility in online shopping malls. This method based on the hierarchical transformation aggregation model provides a more efficient way for malls to process and analyze graph data, and is expected to improve the performance of recommendation systems, personalized recommendations, and user shopping experience.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Fruit Detection, Ripeness Assessment, and Mass Estimation Using YOLOv7, ResNet, and ViT Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: China became the world's largest apple producer, accounting for over 50% of the global planting area and output. The increasing urbanization has led to a decline in agricultural workers and higher labor costs, prompting the inevitable trend of employing picking robots for apple harvesting, supported by the widespread use of computer vision technology in agricultural automation. This paper employs a comprehensive approach using YOLOv7, ResNet, and ViT models for fruit detection, ripeness assessment, and quality estimation. Initially, the YOLOv7 model processes input images to generate detection boxes identifying apples and further quantifies the number of apples in each image. Subsequently, based on the detection boxes from the YOLOv7 model, color analysis is performed to calculate fruit ripeness, presenting the results in the form of a histogram for a more intuitive understanding of ripeness distribution. Next, by calculating the red pixel area of identified apples, the study estimates fruit quality and presents the results as a histogram, illustrating the distribution of fruits of varying quality. Finally, the ResNet and ViT models are used for image classification, comparing their accuracy on a validation set to evaluate their performance differences in fruit image classification tasks. This integrated process provides a comprehensive and accurate analysis for fruit detection and assessment, offering robust support for subsequent research in fruit quality analysis and classification.

articleTitle: A Clustering Method of Electric Power Customers Based on DBSCAN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Providing personalized services for electricity users with different needs has become an important part of deepening the reform of the electricity sales side market system, and achieving efficient and accurate electricity customer clustering is an important foundation for improving personalized services. In order to achieve efficient and accurate power customer clustering, a power customer clustering method based on DBSCAN algorithm is proposed in the paper. Firstly, the data in the power dataset is preprocessed and feature values are extracted from it. Secondly, a power customer clustering model based on the DBSCAN algorithm is constructed. Finally, the results obtained from the clustering model are visualized and analyzed. The experiment shows that when the parameter Eps of DBSCAN clustering algorithm is 0.006 and MinPts is 10, the overall clustering effect is good. At this time, the number of clusters is 5, and the profile of these 5 customer groups is obtained. This provides strong support for personalized power supply services for power enterprises and meeting the different needs of power customers.

articleTitle: Classification Techniques of Tongue Manifestation Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the ongoing advancement and refinement of medical theory, the exploration of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) tongue inspection is gradually becoming more profound. However, the subjectivity inherent in tongue inspection leads to a lack of objectivity and standardization, significantly impeding its clinical application. This paper introduces the utilization of deep learning models for tongue inspection and presents a two-stage classification technique for tongue manifestations based on deep learning models. Initially, the UNet image segmentation model was employed to segment the original tongue images for more precise classification. Subsequently, the ResNet101 model was utilized to establish a deep learning-based lingual classification model. The outcomes indicate that this approach offers fast processing speeds and high classification accuracy, effectively supporting TCM tongue inspection. Recognizing the scarcity of accessible datasets, this study also developed a new tongue classification dataset by selecting expert TCM texts and employing web crawler technology to acquire tongue images and corresponding labels. Evaluation of ablation experiments reveals that training the model on the new tongue manifestation classification dataset significantly boosts performance compared to the original open-source dataset. When compared to the ResNet50 and VGG 19 network models, the ResNet101 model demonstrates superior training and testing outcomes. Furthermore, the segmented dataset outperforms the unsegmented dataset, achieving an accuracy and recall rate of 87.6% and 85.2%, respectively. The model and dataset utilized in this study are openly accessible, and the training and testing process were carried out on the domestic accelerated card light DCU Z100L.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>

articleTitle: Life Expectancy Prediction Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Support Vector Machine Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This study delves into the application of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithms in the parameter optimization of Support Vector Regression (SVR) models to enhance the accuracy of predicted average life expectancy. An adaptive PSO algorithm augmented with random perturbations is introduced. Through a fitness-function-guided dynamic adjustment mechanism, this method circumvents the premature convergence issue typical of conventional PSO, locating the optimal penalty parameter C and kernel parameter for the SVR model. These parameters are then incorporated into the SVR model for training and regression prediction, achieving optimal data fitting and generalization effects. Comparative analysis reveals that the PSO-enhanced SVR model outperforms the traditional SVR across various performance metrics. Notably, there is a marked improvement in the coefficient of determination, a significant re-duction in root mean square error, and mean absolute percentage error, affirming the advancements of the improved PSO-SVR model in prediction accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Load Resource Regulation Methods for Demand-Responsive Air Conditioning Clusters with Two Types
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Air conditioning load, as a crucial demand-responsive load resource, possesses significant regulation potential. During the peak summer period, it can be centrally controlled to effectively reduce the peak load, achieving a peak shaving effect for air conditioning clusters. However, due to variations in users' air conditioning models, adopting a uniform control strategy may not only impact user comfort but also result in the loss of demand-responsive resources and increased costs. To develop a sound control strategy, this paper introduces a method for regulating the load in air conditioning clusters, encompassing two distinct types of air conditioning systems. Initially, by leveraging a second-order equivalent thermal parameter model and integrating the operational characteristics specific to both types of air conditioning systems, we establish corresponding models for air conditioning loads. This enables a more targeted simulation of the temperature load curves for each type of air conditioning system. We construct an optimization scheduling model by imposing constraints on user comfort and the air conditioning adjustment range. Subsequently, we formulate compensation strategies based on variations in comfort levels. Subsequently, based on the aforementioned model, this paper quantifies the regulation capabilities and adjustment costs of the two types of air conditioning systems, generates regulation strategies according to the adjustment potentials of the two types of air conditioning systems. Finally, this study validates the proposed strategies through experiments. The results indicate that the generated strategies exhibit a notable peak-shaving effect and effectively enhance regulation capabilities while reducing costs.

articleTitle: A Meta-Learning Based Resource Allocation Algorithm in Vehicular Edge Computing Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of intelligent transportation systems, in-vehicle edge computing networks serve as key infrastructures to provide strong support for vehicle communication and coordination. However, the traditional resource allocation methods face many challenges due to the changing network topology, the uncertainty of data load, and the spatio-temporal relationship between traveling vehicles. Therefore, in this paper, a meta-learning based resource allocation algorithm is designed to overcome these problems. By introducing meta-learning, the aim is to enable the system to quickly adapt to different scenarios and requirements so as to improve the resource utilization. The algorithm not only fully considers the network performance index, but also comprehensively solves the real-time and reliability requirements to achieve comprehensive optimization. The resource allocation algorithm based on meta-learning designed in this paper simulates different car networking tasks during the training process, so that the network learns a more robust resource allocation strategy, which not only fully takes into account the network performance index, but also comprehensively solves the real-time and reliability requirements and achieves comprehensive optimization. Through a large number of simulation experiments and comparisons in Telematics, the algorithm proposed in this paper outperforms the current state-of-the-art algorithms by 20% in terms of request acceptance rate, and leads by 15% in terms of overall gain. The experimental results show that the algorithm in this paper outperforms the current state-of-the-art algorithms in solving the resource allocation problem for car networking applications in edge computing networks.

articleTitle: A Multi-Platform Compatible Remote Control based on Gesture Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of information technology, one pressing concern lies in how to make electronic devices more user-friendly across diverse scenarios. This article proposes a novel gesture-based remote control system built on the Android platform, utilizing deep learning, the SSD algorithm, HOG features, and an SVM classifier. The system aims to foster the advancement of smart classrooms, medical command systems, smart homes, and other fields, while also enhancing accessibility for special groups by improving their interaction with mobile phones and other electronic devices. Through accurate gesture recognition and rapid response, it will provide users with a more convenient and efficient operating experience, thus promoting the wide application of artificial intelligence technology across various domains.

articleTitle: Analysis of Vegetable Sales Volume Distribution and Pricing Strategy: A Study Based on Nonparametric Kernel Density Estimation and Neural Network Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this study, the distribution pattern of sales volume of each category and individual product of vegetables is analyzed by firstly using the non-parametric kernel density estimation method to obtain the kernel density estimation curves of the daily sales volume of each category and individual product of vegetables, and analyzing them in combination with statistical indicators. Secondly, based on the visualization of the monthly sales volume of each category of vegetables over time and the seasonal component plot, the sales trend is studied. Finally, Spearman rank correlation analysis is utilized to explore the correlation between the sales volume of each category and individual product of vegetables. Based on this, the total sales volume of each vegetable category is further analyzed in relation to cost plus pricing, and the sales volume is predicted by a time series model optimized by a neural network model to develop a pricing strategy for the coming week in order to maximize revenue.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of AI Based on Entropy Weight Method of TOPSIS on Students' Academic
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: On the basis of the existing research data, this study deeply analyzes the influence of artificial intelligence on college students' learning by establishing a mathematical model, and discusses the complex relationship between the two. First, according to the data characteristics of the problem, it is subdivided into three categories: no sequence feature, sequence feature and multi-label. Then, different methods such as label coding, serial number coding and multi-label coding are used to digitize the data. Factor analysis and Bartlett test were used to conduct in-depth analysis of the validity and reliability of the data, and the reliability and validity of the data were verified. The reliability coefficient Cronbach's <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha$</tex> reached 0.857. Then, according to the characteristics of the survey respondents, the impact of artificial intelligence, and future prospects, the data is divided into three categories using cluster analysis based on the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{K}$</tex> -means algorithm. On this basis, the TOPSIS comprehensive evaluation model based on entropy weight method is established. Combined with the selected indicators, the respective weight coefficients are calculated, and the TOPSIS method is used to solve the comprehensive score of each student, so as to evaluate the specific impact of artificial intelligence on learning. Through the comprehensive use of a variety of analysis methods, this study deeply explored the mechanism of artificial intelligence's influence on college students' learning, and provided an important reference and guidance for further understanding and application of artificial intelligence in the field of education.

articleTitle: Supplier Management Decision Support System Under Data Mining Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article proposed a supplier management decision support system based on data mining algorithms, aiming to help enterprises select the best supplier to improve procurement efficiency and reduce procurement costs. The system used data mining algorithms to analyze and mine the historical data of suppliers. It established a supplier evaluation model and combined it with AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Process) to conduct supplier evaluation. At the same time, the system also used fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method and TOPSIS (Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to ideasolution) method to sort and select suppliers. The experimental results indicated that the system could quickly and accurately evaluate suppliers, and improve procurement efficiency and reduce procurement costs, which has practical application value. This article also discussed and prospects the research, and proposed future research directions.

articleTitle: Research on Fire Alarm System Problems Based on Comprehensive Evaluation Method and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Machine learning applied to fire alarm systems is an increasingly common optimization problem. In this paper, a method based on comprehensive evaluation and machine learning is proposed. Firstly, relying on the literature and data sets, 10 indicators such as the number of fires, the failure rate, the accuracy rate, etc. are extracted to comprehensively evaluate the performance of each type of alarm component, and the entropy weight method, the information weight method and the TOPSIS method are used to derive the performance level rating of each component, and the fire alarm intelligent research and judgment system is constructed. Then, a BP neural network was used to build a training model and test the alarm data set for a certain region, and finally predicted the real number of alarms of each test device with an accuracy of 95.4%. These results can help the government plan to select more reliable fire detector types and improve the fire alarm accuracy to further optimize the fire alarm system.

articleTitle: Calibration of Space Robot Parameters Based on Base Coordinate System Errors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A motion error parameter identification method is proposed to address the issue of insufficient absolute positioning accuracy of a seven-degree-of-freedom space robot based on the geometric parameter errors of the robotic arm and the position errors of the base coordinate system. Firstly, the kinematic model of the space robot is established based on a modified complete and parametrically continuous model, and the mapping relationship between the geometric parameter error of the robotic arm link and the end-effector pose error is obtained using the pose differential transformation method. Then, taking into account the base coordinate system's positional error, a novel model for the space robot is developed, based on the errors associated with the base coordinate system. Finally, the identification of kinematic parameters is accomplished using the Levenberg-Marquardt optimization algorithm. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: the position errors of the base coordinate system

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Excess Yield by Quantum Annealing Algorithm on QUBO Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper establishes a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) model for portfolio optimization with excess returns. Initially, we decompose the portfolio optimization problem with excess returns and select the QUBO model. Following this, we utilize the iterative quantum annealing algorithm to find the global optimal solution. Lastly, we further discuss the challenges faced in the practical application of the QUBO model. It will not only helps to reveal the potential advantages of the QUBO model in dealing with portfolio optimization problems but also provides references for further research, intending to achieve efficient application in portfolio optimization with excess returns.

articleTitle: Discovering Named Entities at Scale of a Data Mining Perspective on Large Text Corpora
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The need to protect sensitive data is expanding and becoming more and more critical, in part because of the regulations and directives that the European Union has enforced. While efforts to create automated systems are ongoing, human or semi-automated processes are usually used to support them. In this study, we have created a component that can identify and extract sensitive information from unstructured European Portuguese text. Creating a solution that helps companies understand their data and comply with security and legal obligations was the aim. We examined a hybrid approach to the Named Entity Recognition problem in Portuguese. We propose a novel security framework, the entity recognition model, which relies on regular expressions, known-entity dictionaries, randomised conditional fields (RCF), and four feature templates. This model is known as RDF-RCF. To further enhance recognition performance, the RCF-based extractor makes use of the entities found by the rule-based and dictionary-based extractors. Specific and common security entities may be retrieved using the known-entity dictionary. The phrase based on rules is able to match security entities with good accuracy in simpler scenarios. SIGARRA News Corpus, DataSense NER Corpus, and HAREM Golden Collection were the corpora that were used for testing and training. The outcomes of the experiments demonstrate that can outperform cutting-edge techniques in terms of performance.

articleTitle: A Study on the Pricing of Used Sailboats: Utilizing Random Forest Models to Analyze the Impact of Multiple Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This study explores the impact of various factors on the valuation of sailboats. The research delves into the mathematical correlation between the prices of secondhand sailboats and 11 specific factors. Initially, any missing values were removed, outliers were substituted, and box plots were utilized to validate the precision of the sample data. Furthermore, five supplementary parameters were sourced from public websites, encompassing displacement, draft, beam, material, and GDP. Subsequently, after organizing the data, categorical variables were encoded using sequence and label encoding. Following this, multiple linear regression models, ridge regression models, and random forest models were constructed using the entire dataset. Through a comparative analysis of the three models' accuracy, the random forest model was chosen as the ultimate model for elucidating the pricing of each sailboat. The predictive precision of the random forest model was scrutinized, yielding a prediction accuracy of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{R}^{\mathbf{2}}=\mathbf{0.786}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Industrial Steam Quantity Prediction Model Based on Grid Search-Optimized Support Vector Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Support Vector Regression (SVR) is a machine learning regression method that draws on the principles of Support Vector Machines (SVM). SVR is widely used in regression analysis in several fields because of its excellent performance in dealing with nonlinear, high-dimensional, and noisy disturbed data. In this study, SVR was used as the core model, and the data collected by the boiler's sensors were utilized. Following the removal of aberrant data points through the application of a Ridge Regression model, the SVR model was optimized using a grid search algorithm and a comparison of various kernel functions, ultimately resulting in accurate prediction of steam volume. The experimental results have shown that the SVR model achieved an MSE of 0.1102 and an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R^{2}$</tex> value of 0.8879. When compared with the eXtreme Gradient boosting (XGBoost) regression and Random Forest regression models, the SVR model has demonstrated excellent performance in predicting steam quantity, with high accuracy and strong generalization capabilities. The contribution of this study is to provide a feasible method for steam volume prediction in the industrial field and a new idea for improving the operational efficiency of industrial boilers, which is expected to have a substantial impact in saving resources and improving industrial productivity.

articleTitle: Intelligent Optimization Analysis of Automatic Pricing and Replenishment of Vegetable Products Based on Combinatorial Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the idea of market demand and supply, this paper establishes a combined machine learning model by determining the indicators such as sales volume, demand, supply, etc., with the goal of maximizing the interests of the superstore, and adopts an intelligent optimization algorithm to realize the optimization analysis of automatic fixing and replenishment for vegetable commodities. First, Spearman correlation coefficient is used to quantitatively analyze the correlation between different categories to quantify the degree of correlation between different vegetable categories, and K-means cluster analysis is used to analyze the sales data of each category of vegetables, and different vegetables are divided into different clusters based on sales volume, so as to identify the vegetable items with similar sales volume. Then, XGBoost model and time series autoregressive model were used to construct a combined machine learning model, which realized the prediction of future price data based on historical price data and the prediction of future sales volume by combining the unit price and the price, and carried out the smoothing test and the seasonality test on the data to further optimize the predictive ability of the model. And it realized the prediction of future week's price, and the prediction of future week's price was realized based on the prediction results of the combined machine learning model. Based on the prediction results of the model, an automatic pricing strategy and replenishment strategy function with the goal of maximizing revenue is established, and genetic algorithm is applied to realize the solution of the model to obtain the corresponding optimal pricing. Finally, the objective function is shifted from the overall category to specific commodities, and the constraints adapted to it are set for specific time points, which are still solved by intelligent optimization algorithms and optimization analyses are carried out, and specific replenishment quantities. And pricing strategies are formulated for the commodities, so as to achieve the maximum revenue of the superstore.

articleTitle: Research on user interest prediction and recommendation algorithm based on artificial intelligence algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of the Internet, more and more data are generated by users on the network, and the interests of users are becoming more and more diverse. How to predict the user's interest according to the user's behavior data and recommend relevant content to the user has become a hot research direction in the Internet field. In this paper, “Research on User interest prediction and recommendation Algorithm based on artificial intelligence algorithm”, the user interest prediction and recommendation algorithm is deeply studied and discussed. Firstly, this paper summarizes and analyzes the relevant algorithms of user interest prediction. Traditional user interest prediction algorithms are mainly modeled based on user behavior data and content characteristics, such as collaborative filtering algorithm and content-based recommendation algorithm. However, these algorithms have certain limitations when dealing with massive data and diverse user interests, so it is necessary to introduce artificial intelligence algorithms to improve prediction accuracy and recommendation effect. Secondly, this paper proposes a solution based on artificial intelligence algorithm for user interest prediction and recommendation. Firstly, feature extraction and representation learning of user behavior data are carried out by deep learning algorithm, so as to achieve accurate prediction of user interest. Secondly, the model algorithm is used to optimize the decision-making strategy of the recommendation system, so as to improve the personalization and accuracy of the recommendation. By introducing artificial intelligence algorithm, hidden information in user behavior data can be better mined, and the accuracy and effect of user interest prediction and recommendation can be improved. Finally, this paper verifies the effectiveness of the user interest prediction and recommendation algorithm based on artificial intelligence through experiments. The experimental results show that the introduction of artificial intelligence algorithm can significantly improve the accuracy and effect of user interest prediction and recommendation, which is of great significance for improving the user experience and business value of the recommendation system.

articleTitle: Control System of Bamboo Splitting Machine Based on STM32 and HMI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The general control system of bamboo splitting machine is controlled by Programmable Logic Controller (PLC), which is one of the most expensive devices in industrial automation control system. For some small enterprises or occasions with limited budget, the cost may become a limiting factor. Moreover, the technical threshold is high. Programming and debugging of PLC require professional technical personnel, and a relatively solid theoretical foundation of automation control is needed. Therefore, for some enterprises with lower technical levels, the use and maintenance may pose certain difficulties. To solve this problem, we have designed a set of bamboo splitting machine control system based on STM32 and touch screen. In the selection of HMI hardware, we choose a 2K touch screen with support for ten-point touch on the notebook computer, and equipped with a 64-bit processor chip i5-1135G7 based on the Intel core as the core processor. In terms of touch interface design, we introduce the comprehensive design of database technology and HMI interaction technology. In terms of HMI software interface programming, we adopt the method of object-oriented programming to achieve data communication transmission with the touch screen, upper computer and equipment. Through the Modbus-crc16 communication protocol, direct communication between STM32 and computer touch screen hardware is achieved. After debugging, the system runs stably with fast response speed and wide applicability. It reduces the reliance on traditional HMI hardware and speeds up the product development cycle. The design can achieve the desired display and control effects in the bamboo splitting machine system, providing a new way for the development of the bamboo splitting machine control system.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis in Emergency Calls for Exploring Natural Language Processing for Enhanced Police Dispatch Services
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This talk explores a novel method of sentiment analysis in emergency calls, emphasising how it may be used to improve police dispatch operations. By combining the advantages of joint sentiment-topic detection and Maximum Entropy Discrimination Latent Dirichlet Allocation (MEDLDA), the suggested methodology aims to offer a thorough comprehension of the emotional and contextual aspects of emergency calls. By combining Latent Dirichlet Allocation and Maximum Entropy Modelling, MEDLDA provides an advanced study of latent subjects. By concurrently recognising important topics or issues stated in emergency calls, the joint sentiment-topic identification improves on standard sentiment analysis. Notably, the goal of this method is to optimise resource allocation based on recognised themes and determine the urgency and intensity of issues depending on the caller's emotional tone. This will help police dispatch systems become more successful. The ethical issues of privacy protection and bias reduction are emphasised while the conversation tackles problems like data quality and real-time processing. To further improve the adaptability of the model, future directions include multimodal integration and continuous learning techniques. The suggested approach has the potential to transform sentiment analysis in emergency calls, improving public safety and the effectiveness of police response systems in the process.

articleTitle: Application Research of College Student Employment Prediction Model Based on Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Employment is the cornerstone of people's livelihoods and plays a crucial role in economic development. In recent years, the scale of university enrollment has been continuously expanding, leading to a growing population of university graduates. In 2022, the total number of university graduates reached a historic high of 10.76 million, and the employment pressure on graduates has increased significantly, exacerbated by the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. Therefore, it is of practical significance to apply effective analysis and prediction methods to understand employment trends. This article, based on the decision tree algorithm, establishes an employment prediction model using data related to university students' employment and academic performance, aiming to uncover key factors influencing student employment. The F-value of the employment prediction model constructed using the decision tree algorithm is 0.9026, indicating that the model performs well in predicting the employment status of university students. The results demonstrate that this model can accurately predict students' employment outcomes and identify influential factors including gender, ethnicity, graduation time, and academic performance.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Centralized Control Visual Tension Paying Off Field Early Warning System and Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$a$</tex> core component of overhead line engineering construction, the construction safety of tension wire laying is crucial to the safety and high-quality development of power grid construction. At present, the monitoring method for tension wire laying process is single, and it is unable to timely and effectively monitor the situation of wire running or breakage. The centralized control visualization tension payout on-site warning system consists of wireless self-organizing network transmission equipment, visualization monitoring equipment, digital tensioning equipment, centralized control equipment, etc. It realizes real-time monitoring, evaluation, adjustment, and warning of the entire process of tension payout, greatly reducing the probability of tension payout construction accidents, effectively improving the safety of payout construction and ensuring construction quality. This study investigates self-organizing network technology, tension monitoring equipment, and intelligent monitoring and early warning technology suitable for transmission line circuit sites. It also conducts research and application on a centralized control visualization tension release on-site early warning system. The developed tension release entire process monitoring, control, feedback adjustment, and early warning integrated system breaks through the technical bottleneck in the field of tension release monitoring.

articleTitle: Enhancing Argument Pair Extraction Through Supervised Fine-Tuning of the Llama Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Argument Pair Extraction (APE) represents a crucial task within the domain of argument mining. This process involves identifying argument pairs within dialogue documents and subsequently, creating their associations. The research paper at hand introduces a novel model, designated as the Llama Argument Pair Extractor (LAPE), which applies a generative paradigm based on the Llama2-7b model to address the complexities inherent to the APE challenge. Unlike existing methods that pair arguments in a cascade of tasks, prone to error amplification and insufficient training, LAPE generates argument pairs end-to-end, mitigating these issues. Our methodology initially undergoes a pre-training phase, wherein the model is allowed to learn from a vast corpus of unlabeled textual data. This facilitates the acquisition of a broad spectrum of linguistic knowledge. Subsequently, during the fine-tuning phase, we train the model parameters in accordance with labeled data. It is aimed at enhancing the model's proficiency in executing the Argument Pair Extraction task. Experimental results demonstrate that our model outperforms existing extractive models in the task of Argument Pair Extraction. This not only underscores the superiority of our model but also highlights the advantage and potential of generative models in the realm of Argument Pair Extraction.

articleTitle: A Comparison of YOLOv8 and DEtection TRansformer in the Context of Tear Meniscus Height Calculation Based on Ocular Surface Videos
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This study is the first investigation related to the application of advanced object detection algorithms, specifically You Only Look Once version 8 (YOLOv8) and DEtection TRansformer (DETR), in the realm of TMH detection. The research leverages a dataset comprising 152 ocular surface videos captured by the Keratograph 5M, undertaking a thorough comparison of architectural distinctions, advantages, and drawbacks between YOLOv8 and DETR. Performance metrics, encompassing mean Average Precision (mAP), specificity, recall, F1-score, and Frames Per Second (FPS), were meticulously evaluated, with an input size set at 640x640 pixels. The inquiry delves into the potential benefits of implementing AI-based methods for TMH detection, emphasizing their applications in ophthalmology and the management of dry eye conditions. The utilization of YOLOv8 and DETR algorithms facilitates automated analysis of anterior segment videos, markedly diminishing the manual workload for clinicians. Furthermore, these methodologies yield objective and consistent TMH measurements, thereby refining the precision of assessments and bolstering the reliability of dry eye diagnosis. Additionally, AI-based methods enable early detection of TMH alterations and timely interventions in cases of dry eye syndrome.

articleTitle: Improved DataX Data Synchronization Technique for Distribution Grid Data Middleware Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Nowadays, the data processing efficiency of the distribution network is very low, which is not conducive to further monitoring of power grid data. It is necessary to adopt improved DataX data synchronization technology to further enhance the management ability and work efficiency of the distribution network data center. This article was based on technologies such as big data and cloud platforms to establish a unified data sharing mode, and utilized workflow technology and file online collaboration technology to establish an engineering management process model. In terms of data source collection, this article was based on the data center and utilized improved DataX data synchronization technology to ensure data security. Apart from key query data, big data is no longer stored locally. The data storage capacity of the distribution network data center was 80TB; the data storage capacity of Google BigQuery platform was 43TB, and the data storage capacity of Microsoft Azure platform was 32TB. This article helped to improve the value of electricity data usage.

articleTitle: Phishing Web Page Detection Based on Data Enhancement and Feature Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Phishing, a deceptive cyberattack technique, poses a significant threat to online users by tricking them into disclosing personal or financial information through counterfeit web pages that impersonate legitimate ones. This paper explores data enhancement and feature engineering techniques as a means to improve the performance of phishing web page detection methods. Data enhancement involves methods like data augmentation, oversampling, and undersampling, which aim to balance class distribution and enhance data diversity and quality. These techniques are essential to mitigate the data imbalance issue often encountered in phishing detection datasets. Feature engineering techniques, including feature selection, extraction, and transformation, are introduced to reduce data dimensionality and enhance the discriminative power of features. The proposed approach is experimentally validated, providing a valuable resource for improving online security in the face of evolving cyber threats. This work lays the foundation for future research in the domain of phishing detection, addressing a critical issue in cybersecurity.

articleTitle: False News Detection Based on Adaptive Fusion of Multimodal Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To address the challenge of underutilizing multimodal information in social media news for effective news detection, a false news detection model based on the adaptive fusion of multimodal features is proposed. Initially, semantic features of the news text, emotional features of the text, and semantic disparity features between pictures and text are individually extracted and represented. Subsequently, various features are weighted and fused by incorporating adaptive weight parameters to mitigate redundant information introduced during model concatenation. Finally, the fused features are input into the classifier to distinguish between true and false news. The actual test results demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms current state-of-the-art models in terms of the F1 value and other evaluation metrics. This model significantly enhances the performance of false news detection, providing robust support for detecting false news in social media.

articleTitle: Study of Multibeam Line Measurement Problem Based on Exhaustive Method and Approximate Differentiation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the principle of multibeam bathymetry and its application in measuring the depth of water bodies, this paper explores the optimal design of the line under different circumstances. Firstly, a two-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system is established, and a mathematical model describing the change of multibeam bathymetry coverage width with seawater depth by the motion of the survey vessel is established through the geometrical relationship of the graphs. Then, a three-dimensional spatial coordinate system is established, and a mathematical model describing the variation of the multibeam bathymetric coverage width with the seawater depth and the motion direction angle in terms of the coordinates of the position of the survey vessel is built by using the geometric relationship of the graph, the three-cosine theorem and the two-dimensional motion decomposition. Then, the problem of finding the optimal survey line in a small-scale sea area is solved by an exhaustive method, which is to find the optimal initial survey line from the south side of the sea area through a loop, and then iteratively traverse all the distributions of the optimal survey line, and then use a genetic algorithm to check the convergence of the results obtained by the exhaustive method in order to make sure that the results are the global optimal solution. Finally, the transducer opening angle is calculated as a function of the total length of the line, the overlap ratio of the missed sea area to the total area to be measured, and the sum of the coverage widths, and optimized using the least-squares method to reduce the range of each parameter, and then a more accurate differential model is used to continue to approximate the optimal solution. The proposed model can ensure the global optimization of the solution.

articleTitle: Research on Vegetable Sales Optimization Strategies Based on LSTM and Nonlinear Programming
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the automatic pricing and replenishment decision-making problem for vegetable category goods is studied. Using the K-means clustering model, random forest, LSTM long and short-term memory model, and nonlinear programming, the distribution law and interrelationship of each category and single product of vegetables are analyzed in detail based on the commodity information, sales flow details, wholesale price, and loss rate data of the vegetable category. Firstly, the correlation between the sales volume of vegetable categories and seasons was revealed by analyzing the total sales volume and sales volume of each time, and eight major categories were obtained by cluster analysis, and the combination of strongly correlated individual products was further determined by correlation analysis. Secondly, this paper predicts the sales volume of the vegetable category in the coming week through the random forest model, and further optimizes the pricing strategy by combining it with the LSTM model, so that the superstore can meet the market demand while ensuring the maximization of revenue. Finally, for the sales space limitation, this paper applies nonlinear programming to solve the problem of selecting the most appropriate 27–33 sales items and solves the stocking and pricing strategy that obtains a total profit of 597.13 RMB. Through the combined use of these methods, this paper provides effective strategy suggestions for superstores in market competition.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Fault Identification Method for Transmission Line Traveling Wave Data Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The different types of faults on transmission lines seriously threaten the safe and stable operation of the system. Currently, the fault diagnosis of transmission lines involves very little fault information, only focusing on the zero sequence current information in the fault recording. Therefore, this article proposes a fast fault identification method based on machine learning algorithms for transmission line traveling wave data. The method is mainly based on the obtained traveling wave data of distributed online monitoring devices for transmission lines, and integrates the actual effective fault waveform database and labeled information database of transmission lines. The time-domain function, FFT, and wavelet packet analysis are used to extract the time-domain, frequency-domain, and the CNN-LSTM-SE machine learning algorithm is used to complete fault diagnosis of transmission lines based on time-frequency domain fault eigenvalues. And based on historical trip line fault data, the correctness and effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper were verified through practical examples.

articleTitle: Intelligent Computer 3D Modeling Technology in 3D Printing Manufacturing System
