publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article focuses on exploring the problems faced by 3D printing technology in the work process, and conducts in-depth research on this field by combining computer three-dimensional production technology and using modeling software as a research tool. First, this article analyzes the current status and development trends of relevant domestic knowledge. Then, through an in-depth understanding of its basic principles and characteristics, this article uses three-dimensional modeling software to generate a solid model and complete virtual prototype modeling. In addition, this article also uses CAD (Computer Aided Design) to draw two-dimensional drawings, part drawings and other files to implement the design of the 3D printing system, and verifies the final results through effect testing. The results show that the printing speed of this 3D printing manufacturing system is relatively fast and stable, and its printing resolution is also high, the adaptability of printing materials is good, with the overall adaptability being the lowest 80% and the highest 92 %. These test results ensure the printing quality and stability of the system.

articleTitle: Joint Extraction of Entity Relationships in Walnut Disease and Pest Based on Chinese NLP Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This study addresses the limited application of deep learning techniques in the field of walnut disease and pest and the challenges posed by complex relationships and diverse entity types in this domain. We propose a deep learning-based method for constructing a knowledge graph in the walnut disease and pest domain, incorporating ontologies to establish a conceptual model for the disease and pest knowledge graph. To overcome issues such as relationship overlap (e.g., one-to-many, many-to-many) and loss of relationship chains, we introduce a novel labeling scheme called “based on ontology binding BIESO (Begin-Inside-End-Single-Other)” that directly models triplets. By employing a label matching algorithm, we obtain triplet data. We train and predict on the dataset using an end-to-end model consisting of Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT), Bi-directional Gate Recurrent Unit (BiGRU), and Conditional Random Field (CRF). Experimental results show an F1 score of 75.79%, outperforming models such as BERT-BiLSTM-CRF and word2vec-BiGRU-CRF. We semiautomatically extract unstructured knowledge and store the extracted triplets in a Neo4j graph database, enabling visualization of the knowledge. The research methodology of this knowledge graph can serve as a reference for constructing knowledge graphs in walnut agriculture and developing intelligent question-answering systems for walnut disease and pest.

articleTitle: A Study of the Advantages of Clustering and Gray Prediction Algorithms for the Prediction of Data Metrics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the clustering algorithm is used for the contraction city classification algorithm. First of all, the big data are dimensionless, and by analyzing the growth rate of each factor, the cities are divided into five categories according to the contraction characteristics of each factor. Through the gray correlation analysis, the weights of different factors affecting the contraction of the city are ranked, and the gray correlation can better solve the problem of uncertainty of influencing factors between multiple indicators, and can supplement the defects of the traditional model. Finally, the gray prediction method is used to predict the future development trend. Compared with the traditional prediction model, the gray prediction model requires less data volume, and only a small amount of incomplete information is needed for model building and prediction. Gray system theory is able to deal with poor information systems, with lower requirements on the smoothness of data, and with a wider scope of application. The gray prediction model adopts gray mathematics to deal with uncertainty, which can make the urban development prediction results closer to reality and improve the prediction accuracy. Finally, curve fitting is used to get the development trend of urban shrinkage.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence Mechanism of Technological Strength in the Field of Artificial Intelligence Based on Complex Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The technological strength of a company is crucial for partner selection and investment decisions. A strong technological strength enables the company to seize industry trends and technological frontiers, maintaining a competitive advantage. Open innovation is a method that promotes the development and growth of a company by strengthening connections and collaborative exchanges with the external environment. This study, based on the theory of complex networks, focuses on the research subject of an AI company and explores the relationship between open innovation, network structure, and technological strength. The research findings reveal that open precision has a positive impact on technological strength, while open breadth has a negative impact. Network structural holes negatively moderate the relationship between open precision and technological strength and intensify the negative impact of open breadth on technological strength. On the other hand, network degree centrality positively moderates the influence of open breadth on technological strength. The research results are significant for understanding the mechanism through which open innovation affects the technological strength of a company.

articleTitle: Fine-Grained Sentiment Analysis for Enhanced Financial Distress Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Sentiment analysis aims to identify the sentiment polarity of specific aspects within given sentences or comments, and aspect-based sentiment analysis is considered a fundamental task in sentiment analysis. With practical applications in areas such as product reviews, food delivery evaluations, and public opinion monitoring, sentiment analysis plays a crucial role. This paper focuses on the application of fine-grained sentiment analysis in financial distress prediction (FDP) to enhance early warnings of the management status of companies. In previous studies, there has been a narrow emphasis on using document-level sentiment analysis to extract overall sentiment from text, overlooking the semantic nuances conveyed by sentiments. Therefore, this paper aims to extract fine-grained sentiments from the Management Discussion & Analysis (MD&A) of Chinese listed companies. The proposed model is based on a two-step framework, consisting of an unsupervised aspect-level financial sentiment extraction phase and a model validation phase. Specifically, the former is built on a deep learning model with an attention mechanism, conducting unsupervised aspect extraction, aspect identification, and aspect-level sentiment classification in a sequential manner to obtain fine-grained sentiments. The latter is responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of the newly acquired features on benchmark machine learning models, including SVM, DT, LR, CNN, and DNN. Experimental results reveal that MD&A predominantly covers eight types of aspects, including ownership, business scope, development, capital, sales, management, prizes, and probability. Additionally, it has been observed that fine-grained sentiment features can enhance the performance of FDP. This study represents a significant innovation in existing literature, being the first to introduce aspect-level financial sentiment analysis into the realm of FDP.

articleTitle: Integration of RF and Digital Technologies - The Revolution of RFSoC Technologies in RF Sampling and Tile-Based T/R Module Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of radar technology, this paper investigates the application of RFSoC and tile-based T/R module technologies in radar systems. It highlights the advantages of RFSoC in signal processing efficiency and system complexity reduction. The role of tile-based T/R module technology in enhancing radar system flexibility and performance is explored. Comprehensive data analysis and performance evaluation demonstrate the practical effects of these technologies. Real-world case studies showcase significant performance improvements in different scenarios. The paper also discusses RF sampling theory and mathematical models related to RFSoC architecture. System design, hardware, and software requirements are analyzed, along with a comparative analysis of RFSoC and tile-based T/R module technologies. The profound impact of these technologies on radar technology's future development is summarized, and suggestions for future research directions are provided. The research findings benefit academic research and offer guidance for practical application and future development of radar systems.

articleTitle: Distributed Energy Data Sharing and Privacy Protection Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Energy Internet must be realized on the premise of broad consensus and trust among the participants, therefore, there is an urgent need for a technology that can not only easily and quickly construct distributed applications, but also achieve trusted interaction at a low cost. Aiming at the improvement of the underlying technology and architecture of blockchain in the current energy blockchain research field and analyzing the existing defects, this paper uses a distributed blockchain underlying architecture for energy trading scenarios. In this paper, considering the characteristics of energy transactions concentrated in geographical locations, a transaction scheme based on hierarchical construction of the general ledger by the main sub-chain is presented. The paper studied the transaction confirmation path and data fragmentation storage strategy based on concurrent construction for massive energy transaction data. In different cases, the above scheme is realized and its effect is verified. Compared with photovoltaic power generation, the situation of wind power generation would have some differences, the peak of wind power generation in the afternoon, the user's power generation at 14 o'clock., 15 o'clock peak. In this paper, the key data structure, key algorithm, technical implementation and automated distributed trading scheme in the energy trading scenario are preliminarily described, and their key performance indicators are tested. The key technologies in this paper can be better applied to the energy trading scenario.

articleTitle: Design and Experimental Study of Remotely-Controlled Self-Propelled Turner
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A remotely-controlled self-propelled turner was developed to solve such problems as high vibration intensity, high power consumption, high resistance and easy wear of turning shovel and scattering the pile during turning due to the failure of the turning system to adjust its forward speed and turning speed according to different materials in the use of the windrow turner, as well as high labor intensity, poor working environment and high use cost due to the need of a driver to operate the diesel turner. For cow dung and walnut branches, the results of the test on equipment structure and operation parameters showed that the turning speed had a significant influence on the power consumption; the forward speed had a significant effect on the turning amount; the turning angle had a significant impact on the decrease in the height of the fermentation pile; the forward speed had a significant influence on the power consumption; the turning angle had a significant effect on the turning amount; the forward speed had a significant impact on the decrease in the height of the pile. However, the turning angle had an insignificant influence on the power consumption; the turning speed had an insignificant effect on the turning amount; and the turning speed had an insignificant impact on the decrease in the height of the pile. It was concluded from the analysis by comprehensive balancing that the optimal combination of structural and operating parameters of the turning system of the remotely-controlled self-propelled turner was as follows: turning angle 45°, forward speed 90 m/h, turning speed 150 r/min. The results of the comparative verification test showed that under this parameter combination, the power consumption of the remotely-controlled self-propelled turner, the turning amount and the decrease in the height of the pile were 8.23 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{kW}\cdot \mathrm{h}$</tex>, 124.7 t/h and 1.26 cm, respectively. The research results can provide a necessary theoretical basis for turner design and the production of organic fertilizer from fermented cow dung.

articleTitle: Solving the Optimization Problem of Multi-Beam Sounding Based on Goal Programming Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Multi-beam sounding is to calculate the depth of sea water through the propagation of sound waves in seawater, so as to infer the factors that affect the efficiency and quality of sounding. In this paper, based on the trigonometric function, the mathematical model of the coverage width of multi-beam sounding and the overlap rate between adjacent stripes is established, and the sea water depth, coverage width and overlap ratio in different positions are calculated. Secondly, in order to analyze the change of the coverage width under different measuring line directions, calculate the relationship between the angle and the projection of the coverage width surface on the sea slope and the horizontal plane, the angle between the measuring line direction, the slope and the sea water depth, and establish the coverage width model, the coverage width is calculated when the angle between the direction of the measuring line and the distance between the measuring ship and the center of the sea area changes. Then the optimal solution problem of measuring line layout is required to be solved. Furthermore, the layout of the survey line under the north-south direction and the east-west direction is analyzed, and the north-south direction is selected as the specific situation of the survey line layout, the goal programming model is established, and the genetic algorithm is used to find the optimal solution. The results show that when the angle between the direction and the level is (63.435)/180π and the distance between the lines is 342.784m, the length of the line is the shortest. Finally, the stability of the model is tested, and the variation range of the shortest measuring line length (that is, the objective function) is less than 5% by using the angle β in the direction of the measuring line and the distance d between the two parallel lines.

articleTitle: Economical Operation and Control Methods of Diesel Generators and Battery Energy Storage Hybrid Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The hybrid system integrates two or more energy sources into a comprehensive unit for power generation. This system is increasingly gaining popularity as an independent power system, especially in drilling systems where diesel generators serve as the primary energy source. Energy storage-diesel generator systems are among the preferred solutions for both new installations and existing equipment upgrades. Hybrid power systems offer a clean and reliable power supply, proving to be more cost-effective than a singular diesel generator system. Feasibility assessments of existing energy storage-diesel generator hybrid power systems were conducted using optimal generator power point analysis. A method involving the maximization of the initial start-up generator set output, coupled with the average load sharing by diesel generators, was compared. This approach aims to meet electricity demand while minimizing diesel system fuel consumption. In comparison to strategies focusing on minimizing fuel consumption and minimizing diesel generator set control, the former not only achieves lower fuel consumption but also reduces the requirements for energy storage capacity. The results indicate that integrating energy storage systems with diesel generators can lead to significant cost savings in diesel fuel and energy storage capacity while meeting the operational requirements effectively.

articleTitle: Knowledge Tracing with Soft Labels Via Knowledge Distillation and IRT-Based Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Knowledge tracing models capture student knowledge status through student learning records and predict student performance in the future. Currently popular deep knowledge tracing models are labeled by the rightness or wrongness of a student's answer, ignoring the impact of information such as scores, question difficulty, and individual ability, and using 0 and 1 as labels is too absolute. To this problem, we propose a knowledge tracing model (KDKT) that utilizes knowledge distillation to provide soft labels. The model uses the IRT model as a teacher model to provide interpretable parameters, and then the Rasch measurements to calculate the student's ability value for the corresponding question as soft labels. Secondly, the question information is labeled as difficulty to do self-attention embedded pre-training, and then combined with the answer information is input into the long and short-term memory (LSTM) network for prediction. Enriching the embedding of question information while ensuring that sequential information is not compromised. We conducted numerous experiments on three public benchmark datasets and the results show that our model outperforms other classical knowledge tracing models.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Local Mean K-Nearest Neighbors Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduces the Probability-based Local Mean K-Nearest Neighbors (PLMKNN) algorithm, designed to surpass the limitations inherent in traditional K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) and Local Mean K-Nearest Neighbors (LMKNN) classification approaches. Through adept feature weight computations, this methodology facilitates sophisticated optimization in feature selection and utilization. Post feature categorization, the LMKNN algorithm calculates class-specific probabilities, which is multiplied by pre-established weights, and yielded precise classification predictions. Empirical assessments utilizing the UCI dataset underscore the PLMKNN's substantial performance advantages over other KNN-based strategies, indicating a promising avenue for pioneering developments in the data classification sector.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Market Electricity Full Transaction Settlement Platform Under the Background of Spot Market
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of all types of transaction settlement in multiple markets during the transitional stage of the spot market, a full transaction settlement platform is designed. We analyzed the main types of multi-market power trading business, designed the overall structure and functional framework of the full transaction settlement platform, analyzed the supporting technology of the platform, and designed the medium and long-term transaction mode and power spot transaction according to the basic mechanism of full transaction settlement Mode. This paper analyzes the linking mechanism between medium and long-term transactions and spot transactions, and explains the settlement issues of all types of transactions. Finally, according to the application of the platform in this paper, the application effect analysis is carried out, which illustrates the effectiveness of the platform application.

articleTitle: High-proportion new energy access rural distribution network stands multi-target collaborative planning method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of new energy power generation technologies, a significant proportion of new energy sources is being integrated into rural distribution networks, which often feature weak grid infrastructures. This integration poses several challenges, including inadequate construction of rural distribution grids, low voltage levels, excessive network losses, and difficulties in managing the high influx of new energy sources. This study tackles the integration challenges of high proportions of new energy into rural distribution networks with weak grids. It identifies key issues such as low voltage, excessive network losses, and the efficient management of new energy sources. The authors propose a multi-objective coordinated planning model aimed at minimizing investment and operational costs, reducing voltage deviations, and maximizing the absorption of new energy. Distinct from existing methods, which suffer from low efficiency, this model introduces a rapid solution approach for optimal configurations. Vali-dation on a rural network with 180 nodes illustrates its effectiveness: it significantly reduces annual operating costs by 3,360,400 yuan, decreases voltage deviation by 64.6%, and increases new energy capacity by 31.5 MW, thus enhancing the network's performance and sustain ability.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Performance Evaluation of UHVDC Lightning Active Protection Scheme Based on Fuzzy Optimal Selection Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper investigates a comprehensive performance evaluation method of active protection schemes for lightning strikes in transmission channel of ultra-high-voltage direct-current (UHVDC) system, to improve the scientificity and efficiency in developing the active protection plans. We first explain the principles and implementations of two active protection technologies including voltage reduction operation and emergency power support. A tri-Ievel performance evaluation index system containing thirteen indicators is then proposed in comprehensively considering the economy, safety and reliability of the protective schemes. The weight of each evaluation index is determined by the improved analytic hierarchy process (IAHP) and the membership grade of each scheme is calculated by utilizing the fuzzy optimization method. Numerical simulation results on the Zhexi±800kV UHVDC system of Sichuan power system are provided to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Development Level Classification using Enhanced K-Means Clustering Algorithm based on AC-PSO Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduces an optimized K-means clustering model based on AC-PSO, aiming to address challenges associated with the selection of initial cluster centers in traditional <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{K}$</tex>-means clustering. Leveraging the potent search capabilities of the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm, the AC-PSO algorithm overcomes issues present in traditional PSO, such as a lack of rigorous mathematical foundations and weakened search capabilities in later stages leading to susceptibility to local optima. The proposed algorithm incorporates adaptive update strategies and employs chaotic mapping-based inertia weight selection, providing a more robust optimization process and avoiding the pitfalls of local optima during the optimization journey. Comprehensive tests on benchmark datasets (Iris, Wine, and Breast Cancer) demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed model in terms of precision, fitness values, and convergence speed when compared to traditional K-means and K-means based on PSO. Furthermore, the application of the optimized model to the clustering of logistics development levels across 18 cities in Henan Province for the year 2020 validates its effectiveness in real-world scenarios. This optimized K-means clustering model offers a novel approach to address the challenge of initial cluster center selection, showcasing potential improvements in accuracy and efficiency across various clustering tasks.

articleTitle: A Study of Pricing and Replenishment Decisions Based on Wavelet Neural Network Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Management of shelf life becomes a critical issue in the sale of vegetables in fresh produce supermarkets. Using the provided data, this study provides an in-depth analysis of the sales patterns among vegetable categories and predicts the restocking volume and pricing strategy of vegetable categories in the coming week and on specific dates. In the sales distribution analysis, it was found that none of the six categories of vegetables conformed to normal distribution, and the pattern of sales volume affected by season and epidemic was explored by plotting graphs and calculating Spearman's correlation coefficient. Further, the relationship between total sales volume and pricing was investigated through a multiple linear regression model and combined with a wavelet neural network to predict sales volume, a multi-objective nonlinear planning model was established, and a linear approximation bundle optimization method was applied to solve for maximum profit. For the replenishment strategy on a specific date, a simulated annealing algorithm is used to solve the problem by combining the data features and model constraints, and the replenishment volume and pricing strategy of a specific product are effectively predicted.

articleTitle: Technical Report: Consistency Assurance for Edge-Assisted Multi-Party Computing and Transport-Intensive Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving digital era, we have witnessed the rise of computation-intensive and transmission-intensive applications like multi-party real-time video communication, remote medical surgeries, and online education. Cloud-edge collaborative resource scheduling has been pivotal in enhancing computational efficiency and reducing end-to-end latency for such applications. However, providing services while ensuring system consistency presents a new challenge in multiparty settings. This study focuses on efficient resource scheduling within cloud-edge collaborative environments, especially addressing system consistency. We propose an innovative real-time consistency assurance model based on latency differentiation aimed at optimizing real-time consistency issues in cloud-edge settings while ensuring data accuracy and timeliness. This problem falls within integer programming, which can transform into a convex optimization issue, efficiently solvable via convex optimization methods. The solution effectively addresses consistency in resource scheduling, significantly improving overall system performance and reliability. Experimental results demonstrate that our method is suitable for computation-intensive and transmission-intensive tasks, substantially enhancing the system's consistency performance and providing robust technical support for the design and optimization of practical cloud-edge collaborative systems.

articleTitle: Research on Geotechnical Deformation Prediction Method Based on LSTM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The field of geotechnical engineering is an important research direction in civil engineering, which has important theoretical and practical value for deformation prediction of rock and soil mass. This study aims to propose an efficient and accurate geotechnical deformation prediction method by introducing Long and short time memory network (LSTM) algorithm, so as to improve the traditional prediction model and meet the practical engineering requirements. Firstly, through a detailed literature review, the existing methods and problems of deformation prediction in geotechnical engineering are deeply understood. In traditional methods, because of the complexity and nonlinear characteristics of rock and soil mass, it is often difficult to accurately capture its deformation law, which leads to the instability of the prediction results. In order to solve this problem, the LSTM algorithm in deep learning is introduced in this study, which can effectively process time series data and is suitable for problems with time series characteristics such as rock and soil mass deformation. Secondly, by collecting a large number of geotechnical experimental data, a dataset containing various working conditions and deformation conditions is established. In order to train the LSTM model, data preprocessing and feature engineering are performed to ensure that the data input to the model is representative and interpretable. Through the training and verification of the model, the feasibility and superiority of LSTM algorithm in geotechnical deformation prediction are verified. In the research process, the parameters of LSTM algorithm are optimized to improve the accuracy and generalization ability of the model. By comparing the experimental results of LSTM model and traditional prediction model, the excellent performance of LSTM algorithm in geotechnical deformation prediction is verified. At the same time, through the analysis of different working conditions and rock mass characteristics, the superiority of LSTM algorithm for dealing with different complex situations is revealed. At last, this paper presents a geotechnical deformation prediction method based on LSTM algorithm, and its application in practical engineering is forecasted. This method not only improves the accuracy, but also has better generalization performance, which is suitable for different types of rock and soil mass and engineering conditions. Through popularization and application, the method in this study is expected to provide a new idea and method for the further development of geotechnical deformation prediction, and provide a scientific and feasible reference for engineering practice.

articleTitle: Ensemble Hardness Harmonize Classifier for Imbalanced Fault Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Fault diagnosis is a crucial step to ensure the normal operation of machines and equipment. However, realworld fault data usually presents an imbalanced distribution and low quality, which makes the classification task difficult. To address this problem, this paper delves into the nature of imbalanced classification and finds that in addition to class imbalance, other difficulties such as noise and class overlap also affect the learning of effective classifiers. Therefore, this paper proposes a new imbalanced classification framework that aims to generate powerful integrated classifiers by downsampling and adaptively adjusting the data difficulty. In this paper, extensive experiments are conducted using fault data from oil pumping machines and data from wind blade machine sheets. The results show that the new framework proposed in this paper not only excels in computational efficiency, but also provides robust performance even with highly overlapping fault classes and extremely skewed data distributions. It is important to note that the method in this paper can be easily adapted to existing learning methods such as C4.5, SVM, GBDT, and neural networks to improve their performance on imbalanced fault diagnosis data. This research provides an effective solution for imbalanced classification for practical applications in the field of fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Joint Estimation of SOC and SOH for Lithium-ion Battery Based on Multi-Time Scale
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The accurate estimation of the State of Charge (SOC) and State of Health (SOH) of a lithium-ion battery is crucial to ensuring the safe and stable operation of the battery, and is the key technology of the management system of lithium-ion battery. Aiming at the problem that the model parameters and capacity of the battery will change with the increase of the number of cycles, thus affecting the estimation accuracy of SOC. This paper proposes a method of joint estimation of SOC and SOH for lithium-ion batteries based on multi-time scale. At the macro scale, Health Factor (HF) was extracted from the fragment information of the charging curve, and a battery aging model was established by the Support Vector Machine (SVM) to estimate SOH parameters. According to the estimation results of SOH, the model parameters and capacity parameters of the battery used for SOC estimation were updated. At the microscopic scale, the autoregressive exogenous (ARX) model with online parameter identification was used, and the Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) algorithm was used for real-time estimation of battery SOC, so as to achieve joint state estimation of lithium-ion battery. Experimental results show that the proposed method improves the long-term estimation performance of battery SOC with high accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Optimizing Multibeam Bathymetry Survey for Seafloor Exploration: A Spatial Geometric Modelling Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Seafloor bathymetry is an important ocean exploration project, and multibeam bathymetry systems achieve more accurate bathymetry by overcoming the limitations of single-beam bathymetry. In this paper, we first use plane geometry modelling to establish mathematical models of the coverage width and the overlap rate of adjacent strips for multibeam sounding by geometrically analysing the triangles in the beam plan, using the edge-angle relationship and the sine theorem. Then using spatial geometric modelling, the angle between the projection of the normal vector of the slope surface on the horizontal plane and the direction of the survey line is introduced as a new variable, and the mathematical model is abstracted by establishing three-dimensional graphs and geometric relations, and the coverage width of the survey vessel is calculated under different directions of the survey line. Finally, using the objective optimisation algorithm, the shortest total length of the survey line is taken as the objective, and through the objective optimisation algorithm, it can satisfy the constraints of repetition rate, compare the different realisation methods and get the optimal solution.

articleTitle: Research on $\alpha$-Induced Radioluminescence Detection Technology Based on UVC Solar-Blind Ultraviolet Photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to address the issue of limited detection range in traditional <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$a$</tex> radiation detectors, a detection system based on the UVtron R13192 flame detector and a custom-designed driving circuit was developed. Signal checking, pulse characteristic testing, background testing, and radioactive source measurements were performed. The experimental results were compared with the findings of Crompton et al., and the activity response curves of our designed detection system were observed. It was found that both detector systems responded to Ultraviolet C (UVC) photons. Through calculations, the upper count rate of our designed detection system was found to reach ~9000 cps. The background count level of the detector system fluctuated significantly under ambient light conditions, but remained relatively stable under indoor fluorescent lighting conditions. For the radioactive sources, both detector systems showed significant differences in count rates compared to their respective backgrounds (R9533 probe + C10807 driving circuit: P<0.0001; R13192 + custom driving circuit: P<0.05). A fitting of the activity response curve for our designed driving circuit was performed, and the reasons for the large measurement error at distances less than 2 cm were analyzed. The minimum significant activity (MSA) and minimum detectable activity (MDA) were calculated for different distances.

articleTitle: Pricing Strategy and Replenishment Decision of Vegetable Products based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to explore the replenishment plan for vegetable categories, this paper first establishes a multivariate linear regression model to explore the functional relationship between sales volume and pricing for each category. Then, a time series forecasting model is established to predict the future sales volume and unit price, and a multivariate single-objective planning model is established by combining the daily replenishment volume and pricing strategy, and a genetic algorithm is used to find the optimal solution of the model. In order to explore the single product single day replenishment quantity and pricing strategy, data processing is carried out to determine the single product that meets the total quantity requirement from June 24-30, 2023. It establishes the comprehensive revenue model of each single product, selects the single product that has the greatest impact on the overall revenue, and chooses the entropy weighting method of TOPSIS to make comparisons, and selects the optimal single product representative to ensure the accuracy; meanwhile, the objectives are added to the multivariate single-objective planning model, and the optimal solution of the model is established. Model optimal solution and genetic algorithm is used to solve the problem and derive the replenishment and pricing strategies for different single products to satisfy the maximum revenue.

articleTitle: Optimization of Dual-Blockchain Smart Grid Data Sharing Strategy Based on Reverse Auction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to overcome the payment delay and the difficulty of verifying frontline worker information, caused by the subcontract and the rapid flow of workers in power infrastructure projects, we propose a power infrastructure payroll system framework based on dual blockchain. The framework consists of an identity authentication chain and a data sharing chain, which communicates through smart contracts. The efficient operation of the framework depends on the timely and accurate reporting of various personnel information of workers and enterprise credit information from subcontractors, thus, we construct a data sharing scheme between the frontline subcontractors and power general contractors in smart grids using the reverse auction theory. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed dual blockchain framework and data sharing scheme can promote the data sharing efficiency of frontline subcontractors, and the security and efficiency of payroll payment in the power infrastructure system are also improved.

articleTitle: Civil Aviation Passenger Traffic Prediction Based on IGABP Algorithm Considering Data Volume Limitation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Understanding civil aviation passenger traffic is critical for airlines to make key scientific decisions and feasible plans, and is an important safeguard to ensure successful implementation. An accurate prediction of China's civil aviation passenger traffic will provide effective decision support for airlines, helping them rationalize resources, optimize flight schedules, and improve operational efficiency. In this paper, considering the limitation of the amount of civil aviation passenger traffic data, an IGABP model is established under the condition of grasping the data characteristics, and a Genetic Algorithm (GA) is used to filter the features of the neural network and optimize the input features as well as the number of features, so as to predict the amount of civil aviation passenger traffic.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Predictive Cybersecurity in Identifying Emerging Threats through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With an emphasis on the incorporation of the Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network (WGAN) algorithm, this study examines the revolutionary potential of AI-Powered Predictive Cybersecurity in detecting new risks using machine learning. The adoption of an innovative cybersecurity approach within CyberGuard Bank is investigated in this paper through the use of a fictitious case study set in the financial sector. With the use of cutting-edge machine learning techniques and WGAN-generated synthetic data, the model exhibits improved threat detection, false positive reduction, real-time threat mitigation, and scalability capabilities. The implementation places a strong emphasis on ethical issues, including as bias prevention and privacy compliance, which positions the company as a responsible steward of AI-driven cybersecurity. The results highlight the strategic importance of WGAN and AI in strengthening defences against the constantly changing and dynamic array of cyberthreats.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Integration in e-Government: Insights from the Korean Case
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into e-Government framework, exemplified by Korea's approach, marks a paradigmatic shift in global governmental operations. AI, evolving from its initial theoretical foundations to advanced applications in areas like machine learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing with large language models, is significantly transforming e-Government infrastructures. This transformation, with Korea among the leading nations, led to a study evaluating the potential impact of AI integration in the Korean e-Government system. Employing a robust crosssectional quantitative methodology, the study tested seven hypotheses to examine Korean officials' perspectives on AIenhanced e-Government system acceptance, considering variables such as social influence, trust, and attitude. Methods namely Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling and the Statistical Package for the Social Sciences were used to analyze these aspects addressing research gaps and their implications for AI purveyors, policymakers, and foreign governments. This research is presumed to advance the discourse on the implementation and reception of AI in eGovernment.

Author Keywords: United Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology

articleTitle: An Optimized Genetic Algorithm-based BP Neural Network Model for the Classification of Human Pre-miRNA Subclasses
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Pre-miRNAs, as the precursor forms of miRNAs, possess significant research potential due to their intricate structural features. Accurate classification of pre-miRNAs is crucial for comprehending their roles in post-transcriptional gene regulation processes. This paper focuses on two distinct subclasses of pre-miRNAs: canonical miRNAs and mirtrons. Canonical miRNAs exhibit high conservation across species, whereas mirtrons display species-specific roles and expression patterns. To address the classification task, our study employed a Backward Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) model. While BPNN is renowned for its ability to learn and adapt from non-linear data, it often encounters challenges when dealing with high-dimensional spaces, leading to local optima. To further enhance the BPNN model, our study integrated BPNN with Genetic Algorithm (GA), a type of optimization algorithm inspired by the process of natural selection and genetics. GA is adept at exploring large and complex search spaces, which helps find alternative weight parameters for the BPNN model and thus enhances the model's convergence capability. The original dataset utilized in this study consists of human pre-miRNA sequences accompanied by accurately annotated class labels, sourced from miRBase (v21). A set of 25 features was derived from the original dataset, out of which 10 features were selected using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) technique as the independent variables. GA-BPNN's model performance was evaluated using independent testing datasets split from the pre-processed dataset and compared with other common Machine Learning (ML) techniques, demonstrating improved prediction performances for pre-miRNAs.

articleTitle: Ocean Exploration Model and Analysis Based on Multi-Beam Sounding Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article presents a seabed sounding model that integrates geometric analysis with computational optimization, significantly enhancing the efficiency of multibeam survey line planning. We develop a mathematical model to precisely determine the coverage width and overlap rate for adjacent survey strips, taking into account the seabed slope and survey line direction, which is critical for accurate seabed mapping. Our proposed strategies for the shortest set of survey lines necessary for complete sea area coverage are innovative, with the optimal route from deep to shallow water requiring only 34 lines over 68 nautical miles, demonstrating a potential reduction in time and resource expenditure. The model's robustness is further evidenced by its ability to adapt to seabed undulations, ensuring thorough coverage. This research offers substantial improvements in seabed survey efficiency, with implications for maritime navigation, underwater construction, and environmental studies.

articleTitle: Prediction of Automatic Parking Accuracy Based on PSO Optimized BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Automatic parking technology has been an indispensable part of the assisted driving systems installed in cars in recent years, and the popularity of automatic driving in society is increasing day by day. Based on the problem of low accuracy of automatic parking in complex scenes, this paper introduces the particle swarm optimization algorithm to optimize the BP neural network to improve its parking path prediction performance. By adjusting the search space of network weights and thresholds, continuous optimization, and iteration, the individual optimal value and the group optimal value are obtained, and the experiments are carried out through the fitness value and root mean square error. Compared with the traditional BP neural network and convolutional neural network, the prediction accuracy of the PSO-BP neural network is improved by about 0.04. This research result has positive significance for improving the practical application of automatic parking systems.
